chapters.title: Chapter 251: Freeing The Villagers
paragraphs: "It seems that being left in this realm for so long has made you senile, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] asked mockingly as he spread out his light qi, forming a small dome around him. "My demon rank is indeed not as high as yours, but you and your minions are definitely not a match for my light element."

"Tch!" Arshila became irritated upon seeing Zhang Fei [1]'s light element, which deterred the skeletons and ghosts from approaching him. She hesitated to attack him, particularly after experiencing the intense pain from his kick earlier. 'I have to find a way to avoid his light power, or I will be the one who suffers the worst.'

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head as Arshila looked around their area. "It's useless; you won't be able to break through my light protection, or you can try to break through it if you're not afraid of death."
"Heh!" Arshila smirked slightly before she tried to use her soul manipulation on Zhang Fei [1].
[Ding]
[Someone is trying to control the host's soul.]
[Activating special protection on the host's soul.]

'Oh?' Zhang Fei [1] was surprised by the notification, and he didn't expect that the system would also provide such protection for him. 'Hey, Mei, it seems like there are still features in the system that you yourself don't know about.'

[Master, my job is only to oversee the system, and there are many things in it that are beyond my control. It seems like the creator has indeed deliberately planted some hidden features that might show themselves, just like when Lan Zhe tried to control you, and also this one.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded slightly before speaking to Arshila. "Hey! Your soul manipulation doesn't work on me, you know?"

"What?" After hearing that, Arshila exclaimed in shock, but she couldn't believe it so easily and kept trying to use her soul manipulation on Zhang Fei [1], but her efforts were all in vain. because the system keeps protecting him. 'Damn it! How could this happen? This is the first time my ability is useless against a low-ranking demon!'

Zhang Fei [1] then used the soul connect to borrow Boitata's power, significantly enhancing his strength, before hurling the demon extermination sword into the sky. "Since you're done, I'll attack you now."
*Swoosh*
Instantly, the demon extermination sword glowed white due to Zhang Fei [1]'s light element, and it shot straight towards Arshila.

Panicked, Arshila immediately summoned several skeletons in front of her to serve as shields. However, the demon extermination sword immediately slashed them, causing them to break into several pieces.

'Shit!' Arshila cursed in her heart as she floated away to evade the demon extermination sword, which was eager to kill her. However, the sword continued to pursue her, prompting her to use her dark arts in an attempt to halt it. Unfortunately, her dark arts proved ineffective against Zhang Fei [1]'s light element, as two large trees suddenly swung their branches at her, directly striking her body.
"Gah!"
*Slash*

"Argh!" Arshila screamed in pain as the demon extermination sword slashed her back, and a bit of Zhang Fei [1]'s light element seeped into her body, causing her to fall to the ground. "Cough... Cough..." 'Shit! I never imagined that I would be toyed with by a demon weaker than me!'.
'Hey, do you want to eat this demon?' Boitata responded to Zhang Fei [1]'s question by emerging from the beast space in her beast form, and all the fiery eyes on her body glared at Arshila.

Arshila, who was shocked by Boitata's appearance, immediately crawled backwards, especially after she saw all the fire eyes on his body. 'Crap! This beast is too strong! I am no match for her, as her strength should be comparable to that of my lord.'

Arshila then glanced behind her to find a way to escape, but several trees immediately moved to block her path, which shocked her even more. 'How can that demon also have the ability to control trees? If I remember correctly, only those tree demons can do such a thing.'

"Ahh!" Arshila screamed in fear as Boitata coiled her tail around her body and clamped her down quite tightly, and she tried to punch her tail repeatedly to free herself. However, her punches only tickled her, and her expression turned horrified as she faced her. "Let me go!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed and leapt onto Boitata's tail, then grabbed Arshila's cheeks. "Do you think I will let you go after you killed so many humans? Indeed, I am a demon, but I am different from you or the demons in the Netherworld Realm, especially since I am also a human. I do not know those villagers, but they are still my human fellows, so I will avenge their deaths by killing you."
"No! Don't-Mhn!" Arshila was shocked when Zhang Fei [1] kissed her. 'Ugh! This humble demon!'
[You succeeded in mimicking the necromancy of a Lich named Arshila.]
As soon as the notification appeared in his mind, Zhang Fei [1] immediately stopped kissing Arshila and jumped down from Boitata's tail. "You can eat her now."
"No!" Arshila let out her final cry as Boitata threw her into her mouth, immediately swallowing her alive.
"Yuck! Her flesh is really disgusting, and it tastes like a corpse." Boitata complained as she returned to her human form.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed upon hearing that, and they turned towards the skeletons that had fallen to the ground after Arshila died, and the ghostly appearance of the villagers was also no longer as ferocious as before. "Now that the demon is dead, you guys can rest in peace, and I hope that all of you will have a better life after your reincarnation."

The villagers nodded with a smile at Zhang Fei [1], and they gradually vanished from his sight, causing him to exhale in relief before reverting back to his human form. In addition, he deactivated the soul connect, and his cultivation immediately returned to its original level.
"Return!" Hearing that, the demon extermination sword flew towards Zhang Fei [1] before entering his forehead and turning into a tattoo again.
Then Boitata questioned Zhang Fei [1]. "Hey, husband! Do you intend to take any more missions after this?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in response, instructing Mei to open a portal to the training space, after which he took the six unconscious women out. "I plan to take on a few more missions later, especially since I still need a lot of sect points to buy some items. Anyway, go inside and continue the seclusion with my real body."
Boitata said nothing and entered the training space, and Mei immediately closed the portal. Afterwards, Zhang Fei [1] channeled his light qi into the bodies of the six women to wake them up.

Before long, they started to open their eyes, but they immediately jumped to their feet and observed their surroundings with vigilance, making Zhang Fei [1] laugh at their antics. "All right, you guys can relax now because I've gotten rid of that female demon, so this area is safe now, but we won't get any points from this mission."

However, their expressions turned gloomy, particularly as they struggled to recall the events that followed Arshila's manipulation of their souls, prompting Mu Lingshu to question Zhang Fei [1]. "What happened to us? Why are we unconscious?"

Zhang Fei [1] let out a soft sigh before answering Mu Lingshu's question. "You don't have to think about it, okay? I already knew about that female demon's ability to manipulate souls, so I was prepared from the start, and your attacks didn't hurt me. Anyway, I'll send you all back to the sect now so you can rest for the day, and we'll report on those missions tomorrow."

After they agreed, Zhang Fei [1] immediately created a portal that connected them to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, surprising Mu Lingshu. Without questioning him, she followed the other women back to their sect. After closing the portal, he sat cross-legged on the ground, his gaze fixed on the scattered skeletons before him.
[Do you intend to use necromancy on those skeletons, Master?]

"At first, I did want to do it, but I thought they would be useless to me, so I won't waste my time on them." Zhang Fei [1] considered several options before asking Mei. "Which beast techniques do you think are useful for me now?"

[Most of the beast techniques in the system shop are related to the light element, and they are very useful for you to deal with demons, master. However, I would suggest you buy the light shield for defense and the exorcismus for offense.]

"Hmm?" After hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows, particularly considering that he could protect himself with light qi and didn't believe he needed the light shield. However, the exorcismus piqued his interest, but he ultimately decided to buy both. "Buy both, then."
[All right.]
{You got Light Shield Ability x1}
{5,000 lower-grade beast cores have been deducted from your balance}
{You got Exorcismus Ability x1}
{200,000 beast essences have been deducted from your balance}
"Sigh! An advanced ability is truly expensive." Zhang Fei [1] said with a bitter smile before reading the two abilities.
[Light Shield: This ability has three levels, and each level will add one more shield.]
[Exorcismus: This ability is an AOE attack, and its attack range is 10 meters away from the user.]

"Three shields, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] muttered before trying to use the light shield, and three white shields instantly appeared around him, circling him. "Hmm? Do you think these three shields can withstand the attack of the black Amaris?"
[I'm not sure about that, Master. It would be better if you tried it yourself.]
"God damn it, Mei! You'll kill me if these three shields can't block her attack!" Mei responded to Zhang Fei [1] with a laugh, causing him to sigh helplessly, and he then tried to use the exorcismus.
*Swoosh*

A white light suddenly shot out from Zhang Fei [1]'s body towards the sky, and it quickly spread out and formed a huge light formation. He gazed upwards, scrutinizing the light formation intently, before activating it.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Instantly, countless white lights rained down on the area under the formation, brightening it for a while before disappearing.

Zhang Fei [1] released a low sigh afterward. "Unfortunately, there are no demons in this area that can be used to test the power of this ability, so I don't know for sure about its attack power against demons. However, this ability is an advanced ability, so its attack power shouldn't be small, right?"

[Well, that's true. Furthermore, the exorcismus ability's power will continue to increase with your evolution, so I'm sure it will have a significant impact on demons. However, its current power might not be enough to kill a demon like the Amaris Twins, let alone kill a demon like Oz.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding before closing his eyes to complete the daily quest while waiting for morning, and he planned to meet Chu Xing afterward.

Meanwhile, two women hurriedly entered a room in the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and one of them immediately reported to the man who was enjoying a blowjob from another woman. "Brother Ruhui, those five women just returned to our sect, but I don't see Zhang Fei [1] among them."
"Oh?" Du Ruhui immediately looked at the two women. "Where are they now, Ba Xiu and Fei Xuan?"
Fei Xuan immediately answered him. "They're in the inner disciple area now, brother. Do you want us to do something to them?"

After giving it some thought, Du Ruhui threw two items to the two women, who immediately caught them. He then explained the items' purposes to them. "You two can now return to the inner disciples area and find an opportunity to use those items on those five women."
"Yes, Brother."
After they left, Han Xuenai asked Du Ruhui. "What exactly are your plans for those five women? What kind of items did you give them just now? Are you going to snatch them away from Zhang Fei [1]?"
"Haha." Instead, Du Ruhui laughed as he pressed Han Xuenai's head down to suck his dick again. "You don't need to ask anything and wait for the results."

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Meeting Four Women
paragraphs: After they returned to the inner disciple area, Ba Xiu and Fei Xuan carefully crept into Zhang Fei [1]'s room, especially since the five women were resting there.

Regrettably, they were oblivious to the fact that Lin Hao had been observing Du Ruhui for the past three days, which meant he already knew all of her plans. He quickly moved behind the two women before knocking them unconscious.

However, Lin Hao was not alone; his dear daughter, Lin Dong'er, accompanied him. Both of them supported the two women, who were already unconscious. "Father, what're you going to do with them? What about Yin Tong?"

"They are just Du Ruhui's tools, so I won't punish them too severely, and I will imprison them in the punishment hall for a while." Lin Hao then turned towards Yin Tong's room before speaking to his daughter again. "As for that Yin brat, I will wait for him to make a move first before I can arrest him, and his future depends on Madam Xueyi's decision."

Lin Hao then shouldered Ba Xiu before pulling Fei Xuan from his daughter's arms and carrying her on his shoulder as well, but Lin Dong'er then asked again. "What exactly does Yin Tong plan to do to them?"

"Du Ruhui gave something to that brat three days ago, but his target is not the five little girls; his target is only Zhang Fei [1], so you don't have to worry about him." Lin Dong'er pouted her mouth in response to her father's secrecy, but Lin Hao ignored her and took the two women directly to the punishment hall.

After that, Lin Dong'er proceeded directly to Mu Lingshu's room, which was located directly across from Zhang Fei's room. Upon entering, she discovered her best friend deep in thought on her bed, prompting her to sit down on the side of the bed and inquire. "What are you thinking about? Did that pervert do anything to you?"

"Nothing." Mu Lingshu answered with a shake of her head before sitting down beside Lin Dong'er. "I'm just upset with myself because I was too careless, and I attacked Zhang Fei [1] without realizing it."

"Hmm?" Lin Dong'er looked at her with a raised eyebrow, so Mu Lingshu immediately told her about the incident in the remote valley. "How can there still be demons in our realm? Moreover, there is not only one but a few others, including the one in the cave near the southern ocean.
Besides, the senior cultivators are unaware that they are constantly lurking in our realm, and their presence is truly dangerous to our people."

"Yes." Mu Lingshu nodded in agreement with that. "Fortunately, Zhang Fei [1] has already cleared out the demons in that cave, and he has also killed the demons that attacked us in that valley. However, he surmises that there are still numerous demons hiding in various areas of our realm, but he himself is still uncertain about their numbers and hiding places.

That's why we must warn Vice Sect Master Luan'er and the elders about this matter, so that they can be more selective in accepting missions submitted to our sect. Otherwise, the disciples in our sect will be in trouble if they take on trap missions, especially since those demons are powerful and have unpredictable abilities."

Without hesitation, Lin Dong'er told her father about the situation, and Lin Hao immediately relayed the information to Shen Xueyi and Yan Luan'er, who promptly instructed the elder in charge of the mission hall to review all the missions that their sect had accepted.
In addition, Shen Xueyi instructed several sect elders and her clan members to depart from the sect in order to search for the disciples who were outside the sect.

"Mistress Xueyi and Vice Sect Master Luan'er must have made their move by now, and my father also asked us not to leave our sect for the time being." Mu Lingshu let out a sigh of relief after hearing that, but Lin Dong'er looked at her with a suspicious gaze, feeling that her best friend was hiding something. "Is there something you haven't told me?"
"Hmm?" Mu Lingshu raised her eyebrows for a moment before telling her. "Zhang Fei [1] is not an ordinary human, and he is actually a beast—a four-tailed fox beast to be exact."
"Are you joking with me? How can he be a fox beast?" Lin Dong'er exclaimed in a high-pitched voice as her eyes widened in shock.

"I'm not joking with you." Mu Lingshu spoke with a shake of her head. "When those villagers were about to attack us, Zhang Fei [1] transformed into a half-fox, and I thought that he was a demihuman. However, Luo Yu and the others told me that he was actually a fox beast, and his light element became stronger when he used that form.
Besides, he is also a good swordsman, but he seems to have not practiced swordsmanship for long, so his fighting style is still too random."

Mu Lingshu's words left Lin Dong'er stunned, especially since she herself did not know Zhang Fei [1] that well, so she did not know anything about his identities or abilities. Soon, she came back to her senses and muttered under her breath. "No wonder he could command those two Earth-Rank beasts to attack those bandits; both of them looked terrified of him.
However, beasts are different from us humans, and a beast can only suppress other beasts if it has a higher bloodline, which means his fox bloodline is much higher than theirs."
"That's true, but I personally don't know anything about his fox bloodline, so I don't know how strong his bloodline is."
Lin Dong'er let out a soft sigh before standing up. "You just got back, so I'll be leaving now, and you can get some rest."

After her best friend left her room, Mu Lingshu laid down on her bed again as she stared at the ceiling, her mind filled with questions about Zhang Fei [1]'s other identity, especially since Luo Yu and the others had intentionally hidden it from her. "Sigh. Forget it. I should not be overly concerned with his other identity; we are merely sect mates, and I have only known him for a few days."

After she left Mu Lingshu's room, Lin Dong'er did not immediately return to her own but went towards Yin Tong's room instead, and she used the artifact her father had given her to hide her presence, especially since she was curious about his plans with Du Ruhui.

However, Lin Dong'er's expression turned annoyed as soon as she peeked into Yin Tong's room, especially since he was dual-cultivating with Ni Weiwei, and Yun Kexin was waiting by the side of the room naked. 'Tch! They are truly like horny beasts! Even though it's still early in the morning, they are already engaged in dual cultivation.'

Lin Dong'er suddenly raised her eyebrows as Yin Tong told Ni Weiwei about his plan against Zhang Fei [1], including the item that Du Ruhui had given him. 'What a fool! Even the Pang Clan's heart-controlling gas didn't work on that pervert, but he actually wanted to use such a potion on him. Hey! I want to see what that pervert will do to him if he finds out about this, so I'll send him a message now.'
After that, Lin Dong'er hurried back to her own room and sent a message to Zhang Fei [1], informing him about Yin Tong and Du Ruhui's plot against him.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 2,800 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 2,800 red jewels sent to inventory]

"Phew." After completing the quest, Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened his eyes and listened to the incoming message from Lin Dong'er, causing him to smile evilly. "Heh! Yin Tong is too envious and jealous of others who are better than him, and I had expected that he would meet Du Ruhui.

However, I won't take any action against the brat from the Du clan for the time being, given that his clan is as powerful as the Liu clan. I'm also uncertain about the support the Pang clan provides, but I will take action against this idiot."
After that, Zhang Fei [1] stood up and cleaned himself before changing his clothes, and he then used the Nine Cloud Steps to go to the southern river city.

As soon as he arrived at the southern river city, Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened his map to search for Chu Xing's location, and he found her on the second floor of a restaurant with Wei Luan and the Hai Twins, so he hurried to catch up with them there.
"Brother in law!" When Chu Xing saw Zhang Fei [1], she immediately called out and waved her hand. "Come here and join us!"
Zhang Fei [1] looked up at them and smiled faintly when he saw Wei Luan's expression, and he hurried to meet them there.
"Why did you just arrive now, brother-in-law? I've been waiting for you since yesterday." Chu Xing immediately complained as soon as Zhang Fei [1] arrived in front of them.

"Sorry, our last mission was not easy, and we only managed to complete it at midnight." Zhang Fei [1] then sat down at the side of the table and explained the previous night's situation, shocking the four women, particularly the Hai Twins.

"It would be better if you contacted your sect members to cancel all missions, especially since we have no information about the other demons that are still lurking in our realm, lest the disciples of your sect fall into a trap mission like us. After all, those demons come from another realm, and they are truly powerful, so they will not be able to deal with them."

The Hai Twins did not dare to take Zhang Fei [1]'s words lightly, especially since they had already witnessed some of his abilities themselves, so they immediately sent a sound transmission to the other elders of their sect and informed them of the matter.

Afterwards, Hao Dongyin curiously asked Zhang Fei [1]. "How did you manage to defeat that demon if he was so much stronger than you? I still remember your fox bloodline, but demons and beasts are different, and you won't be able to use your bloodline power to suppress her."
"Do you have the light element, Zhang Fei [1]?" Hai Dongxin also asked him.

"Yes, I do have the light element." Zhang Fei [1] then stretched out his hand and showed them his light qi, which not only surprised them but also surprised some of the cultivators present there, especially since it was quite bright. "Otherwise, I won't be able to defeat that demon, but I'm not alone in doing so, and I also have the help of my contract beast."

The Hai Twins nodded in understanding, recalling the horror of their fight against Boitata. They had nearly died at her hands if Zhang Fei [1] hadn't intervened, so they were fully aware of her strength.
As he supported his chin with his hand, Chu Xing curiously asked Zhang Fei [1]. "Do you really have fox blood, brother-in-law?"
Not only her, but even Wei Luan also felt curious about it, especially since she could clearly feel that Zhang Fei [1]'s aura was that of a human and not a beast.

"Do you need to doubt your elders' words?" Zhang Fei [1] asked Chu Xing back with a smile. "I do have a fox bloodline, but I won't show it to you in a public place like this. If you are curious to know, I can take you with me and show it to you later."

Naturally, Chu Xing understood that, but he was very curious about Zhang Fei [1]'s fox bloodline, so she immediately nodded in agreement with him. "Since we're still staying in this city today, I'll go with you later, and you'll have to show it to me."
"Sure." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Wei Luan, who also looked curious about him. "What about you? Do you want to see it too?"

"Yes." Wei Luan did not hide her curiosity, but she directly said to Zhang Fei [1]. "Unfortunately, I can't go with you because my parents keep monitoring me, and they hate dual cultivators like you so much, especially my mother."
Zhang Fei [1] was not surprised to hear that, and he then told Wei Luan. "Actually, you don't need to think about your mother, and I can take you away without her knowledge if you really want it."

"No." Wei Luan immediately rejected Zhang Fei [1]. "I am grateful that you have revealed Ying Xiao's affair with You Han, and our engagement has been canceled now. However, I have promised my parents not to have a relationship with you, so I won't go with you, and you can go with Sister Xing."

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, not minding Wei Luan's refusal, and suddenly remembered something before he told the Hai Twins about it. "Anyway, my little sister, like you two, possesses the water element, but she has always trained and cultivated by herself.
That's why I thought of sending her to your sect so she could make new friends and gain experience there, and I hope you two can guide her."

Did that pervert do anything to you?"
"Nothing." Mu Lingshu answered with a shake of her head before sitting down beside Lin Dong'er.
"I'm just upset with myself because I was too careless, and I attacked Zhang Fei [1] without realizing it."
"Hmm?" Lin Dong'er looked at her with a raised eyebrow, so Mu Lingshu immediately told her about the incident in the remote valley.
"How can there still be demons in our realm?
Moreover, there is not only one but a few others, including the one in the cave near the southern ocean.
Besides, the senior cultivators are unaware that they are constantly lurking in our realm, and their presence is truly dangerous to our people."
"Yes." Mu Lingshu nodded in agreement with that.
"Fortunately, Zhang Fei [1] has already cleared out the demons in that cave, and he has also killed the demons that attacked us in that valley.
However, he surmises that there are still numerous demons hiding in various areas of our realm, but he himself is still uncertain about their numbers and hiding places.
That's why we must warn Vice Sect Master Luan'er and the elders about this matter, so that they can be more selective in accepting missions submitted to our sect.
Otherwise, the disciples in our sect will be in trouble if they take on trap missions, especially since those demons are powerful and have unpredictable abilities."

Without hesitation, Lin Dong'er told her father about the situation, and Lin Hao immediately relayed the information to Shen Xueyi and Yan Luan'er, who promptly instructed the elder in charge of the mission hall to review all the missions that their sect had accepted.
In addition, Shen Xueyi instructed several sect elders and her clan members to depart from the sect in order to search for the disciples who were outside the sect.

"Mistress Xueyi and Vice Sect Master Luan'er must have made their move by now, and my father also asked us not to leave our sect for the time being." Mu Lingshu let out a sigh of relief after hearing that, but Lin Dong'er looked at her with a suspicious gaze, feeling that her best friend was hiding something.
"Is there something you haven't told me?"
"Hmm?" Mu Lingshu raised her eyebrows for a moment before telling her.
"Zhang Fei [1] is not an ordinary human, and he is actually a beast—a four-tailed fox beast to be exact."
"Are you joking with me?
How can he be a fox beast?" Lin Dong'er exclaimed in a high-pitched voice as her eyes widened in shock.
"I'm not joking with you." Mu Lingshu spoke with a shake of her head.
"When those villagers were about to attack us, Zhang Fei [1] transformed into a half-fox, and I thought that he was a demihuman.
However, Luo Yu and the others told me that he was actually a fox beast, and his light element became stronger when he used that form.
Besides, he is also a good swordsman, but he seems to have not practiced swordsmanship for long, so his fighting style is still too random."
Mu Lingshu's words left Lin Dong'er stunned, especially since she herself did not know Zhang Fei [1] that well, so she did not know anything about his identities or abilities.
Soon, she came back to her senses and muttered under her breath.
"No wonder he could command those two Earth-Rank beasts to attack those bandits; both of them looked terrified of him.
However, beasts are different from us humans, and a beast can only suppress other beasts if it has a higher bloodline, which means his fox bloodline is much higher than theirs."
"That's true, but I personally don't know anything about his fox bloodline, so I don't know how strong his bloodline is."
Lin Dong'er let out a soft sigh before standing up.
"You just got back, so I'll be leaving now, and you can get some rest."

After her best friend left her room, Mu Lingshu laid down on her bed again as she stared at the ceiling, her mind filled with questions about Zhang Fei [1]'s other identity, especially since Luo Yu and the others had intentionally hidden it from her.
"Sigh.
Forget it.
I should not be overly concerned with his other identity; we are merely sect mates, and I have only known him for a few days."

After she left Mu Lingshu's room, Lin Dong'er did not immediately return to her own but went towards Yin Tong's room instead, and she used the artifact her father had given her to hide her presence, especially since she was curious about his plans with Du Ruhui.

However, Lin Dong'er's expression turned annoyed as soon as she peeked into Yin Tong's room, especially since he was dual-cultivating with Ni Weiwei, and Yun Kexin was waiting by the side of the room naked. 'Tch!
They are truly like horny beasts!
Even though it's still early in the morning, they are already engaged in dual cultivation.'
Lin Dong'er suddenly raised her eyebrows as Yin Tong told Ni Weiwei about his plan against Zhang Fei [1], including the item that Du Ruhui had given him. 'What a fool!
Even the Pang Clan's heart-controlling gas didn't work on that pervert, but he actually wanted to use such a potion on him.
Hey!
I want to see what that pervert will do to him if he finds out about this, so I'll send him a message now.'
After that, Lin Dong'er hurried back to her own room and sent a message to Zhang Fei [1], informing him about Yin Tong and Du Ruhui's plot against him.

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Yi Na Angry
paragraphs: The Hai Twins naturally would not refuse Zhang Fei's request [1], especially since he had saved their lives before, so Hai Dongxin immediately gave him a token and answered him. "If you want your little sister to join our sect, then you can take her to the southern ocean, since our sect's entrance is in that area.
Once you get there, you can use the token to summon us, and we will pick her up, especially since our sect is restricted to women only."

"Have you ever checked your little sister's water element strength?" Hai Dongyin inquired with curiosity, considering that Zhang Fei [1] was significantly stronger than cultivators of his age, leading her to believe that his little sister should possess a similar level of strength.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately shook his head. "Honestly, I have never measured Lin'er's water element strength, and she might still be too weak in your eyes, especially since she started cultivating a little over a month ago. However, her cultivation has already reached the 10 Star Foundation Realm, and she will probably break through to the Core Realm soon."
Zhang Fei [1]'s answer caused the four women's jaws to drop, especially since it was impossible for a cultivator to reach the core realm just by cultivating for a little over a month.

The Hai Twins quickly came back to their senses and exchanged glances, and they were sure that Zhang Fei [1] used his yang qi to help his little sister. Moreover, they remembered that his cultivation was still at the 1-Star Foundation Realm when they first met at Blazing Volcano Mountain, but he had already reached the 10-Star Core Realm in less than a month.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed softly as he realized the Hai Twins' thoughts. "Don't worry; my little sister is still a virgin, especially since she is still 17 years old, so she is still qualified to join the Hidden Sea Palace, right?"

"Even if your little sister is no longer a virgin, I am sure that Big Sis Yuzhen will make an exception for her." Hai Dongyin was the first to answer Zhang Fei [1]. "She is 17 years old, but her cultivation has already reached the 10-Star Foundation Realm, and she achieved it without dual-cultivating with you directly, which means she does have exceptional cultivation talent."

Hai Dongxin immediately supported her twin sister's words. "Although I am not a dual cultivator, I know that your little sister would not be able to cultivate that fast even if you helped her with your yang qi, so I am sure that her talent is indeed above that of the famous young generation like Ye Lian and the others.
If I inform Big Sis Yuzhen about her, I am sure that she will immediately accept her, regardless of whether she is a virgin or not, and she will probably take her as her direct disciple right away."

Zhang Fei [1] himself did not know Hai Yuzhen, but he knew that she was one of the strong cultivators in the southern region. Otherwise, she would not be able to become the sect master of the Hidden Sea Palace, and he was satisfied if a strong cultivator like her was willing to take Zhang Lin as her direct disciple.
"I will bring Lin'er to your sect after we finish our seclusion, which may coincide with the enrollment of new disciples, and you two can check her eligibility directly then."
"All right, we will be looking forward to welcoming your sister to our sect." The Hai Twins replied in unison.

After that, Zhang Fei [1] accompanied them to breakfast as they talked about light matters, but he repeatedly glanced at Wei Luan, who also repeatedly stole glances at him, especially since she was too curious about his and his sister's cultivation speed.

Yi Na, who was enjoying playing her guzheng, suddenly raised her eyebrows. However, after she listened to the incoming voice transmission, her expression turned angry, causing one of the strings on her instrument to snap immediately because she plucked it too hard. "Tch! I forbade her from communicating with Zhang Fei [1], but she met him and had breakfast with him instead.
I know that she is with the elder Hai Twins, but she should have obeyed my prohibition and left them immediately."
After that, Yi Na stood up and left her clan with an angry expression, causing confusion among the people from the Wei Clan. She then rushed to catch up with her daughter at the restaurant.

Sometime later, Yi Na had arrived at the restaurant and rushed to the second floor, and she became even angrier as soon as she saw Zhang Fei [1]. Even her expression was filled with disdain and scornfulness.
Zhang Fei [1], sensing her gaze on him, turned to Yi Na and raised his eyebrows when he saw her expression, making him realize that she was Wei Luan's mother. 'Scan her, Mei.'
[Aye.]
Name: Yi Na
Age: 50
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 10-Star Soul Realm
Element: Water [intermediate stage]
Core: Lower-Rank Water Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique:-
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: Wei Jiang
Likes: Wei Jiang, Wei Luan, Wei Hongtian
Dislikes: Everyone from the Yin-Yang Pavilion

'Her status is inversely proportional to her arrogance, but I didn't expect that her hatred for dual cultivators would be so deep. She even hates everyone from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, which includes me.' Zhang Fei [1] inwardly muttered as he shook his head slightly, and he immediately averted his gaze from Yi Na, who was walking towards them.
Seeing her mother's arrival, Wei Luan immediately stood up and approached her. "Why did you come here with such an angry face, Mother?"

"Don't you already know the reason why I'm so angry?" Yi Na asked back in a high tone as her eyes glanced towards Zhang Fei [1], starting the visitors on the second floor, but they immediately ignored her, especially since they knew her character well enough. "I already forbade you from communicating with a male prostitute like him, but here you are eating with him."
"But-"

"No but!" Yi Na snapped at her daughter before turning to Zhang Fei [1]. "I feel grateful that you saved my daughter's happiness, but I don't want a male prostitute like you to approach her, so you'd better not see her again. Otherwise, I will forget your kindness toward her and make your life miserable."
Hearing Yi Na's last sentence, the Hai Twins let out a helpless sigh because her character was indeed that arrogant, and they glanced at Zhang Fei [1], waiting for his reaction.
"Aunt Yi, you-"

"All right, you don't need to interfere with the matter between us, which wouldn't exist if it weren't for this old woman's arrogance." Yi Na's anger intensified when Zhang Fei [1] referred to her as an old woman, and the visitors on the second floor also laughed at her because of his remarks.

"Honestly, I don't like having problems with other people, and the reason I came here was not to see your daughter. Instead, I came here to see all three of them, especially these twin elders, so your anger towards me is completely unreasonable. You know what? I hate it the most when anyone compares me to a prostitute, and your petty thoughts infuriate me.
Even though I'm a dual cultivator, all of my women are more honorable than an old and arrogant woman like you."
"You-"

"You what?" Zhang Fei [1] fiercely interrupted Yi Na before using his demon charm and special demon pheromone on her, causing her expression to change and her heart to pound as a pink heart symbol appeared in both of her eyes. Nevertheless, the heart symbol was invisible to those around her; it was only visible to him.

Sensing the strangeness within herself, Yi Na shook her head vigorously to dispel it, but Zhang Fei's [1] two techniques were too potent for her, especially his demon pheromone. 'What happened to me? Why am I suddenly attracted to him? Moreover, my lust is beginning to spiral out of control, and I desperately want to pounce at him right away.'

"Do you think your status as the Wei clan's mistress is that great?" Zhang Fei [1] questioned Yi Na once more, continuing to employ his two techniques on her, before pointing at Wei Luan. "Why don't you try to ask your daughter about my wives' identities? She met some of them during our first meeting, and I dare you to brag about your status in front of me after you know their identities."

Wei Luan let out a soft sigh, tugged at her mother's sleeve, and told Yi Na about it through voice transmission, especially considering the large number of people present. 'Mom, Zhang Fei [1] is Liu Hua's husband, so he is the son-in-law of the Liu Clan. Aside from that, Chu Ying and Chu Qing are his wives, so he is also the son-in-law of the Chu Clan.'

Hearing the names of the two clans from her daughter's mouth, Yi Na immediately froze in her spot, especially since both of them were powerful clans in their respective regions, especially the Liu Clan, which resided in the same city as her Wei and Yi Clan.
Yi Na then turned to the Hai Twins, looking for confirmation. When they nodded, she realized her mistake and became fearful of Zhang Fei [1].

"Do you still want to make my life miserable? If you are so confident that you can do it, then you can try." Zhang Fei [1] then grabbed Chu Xing's hand, pulled her up from her seat, and turned to the Hai Twins. "Elders, I will take her with me, and I will return her to you two tonight."
"All right."
Zhang Fei [1] then pulled Chu Xing, who looked overjoyed, to go with him. "Sister Luan, I will accompany you again later."

Wei Luan simply nodded and immediately supported Yi Na, who almost fell as her legs became weak from shock. 'Mom, you were too rash, you know? I know that you hate the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but you kicked an iron plate by insulting Zhang Fei [1] like that, and you even arrogantly threatened to make his life miserable.
Furthermore, our Wei and Yi clans are second-grade clans, and we will never be able to withstand their wrath.'

Yi Na did not say anything in response to her daughter's words, especially since her mind was already filled with lust, and she wanted to go home as soon as possible to relieve it. "Take me home, Luan'er."
"All right." Wei Luan then asked the Hai Twins. "Do you two want to return to our clan, elders?"
"Not now." Hai Dongxin responded by shaking her head. "You should take your mother back to the Wei Clan now, especially since her condition is clearly not good."

After Wei Luan took her mother away, the Hai Twins also left the restaurant, and Hai Dongyin asked her sister. "What do you think Zhang Fei [1] did to Yi Na? Others may not have noticed it, but I can see that she is being controlled by her lust."

"Yes." Hai Dongxin nodded in agreement with that. "Perhaps Zhang Fei [1] used his dual cultivation technique on Yi Na, but I don't know what kind of technique he used on her to make her like that. However, I have a feeling that this matter isn't over yet, and he might have something else planned against her that might mess up her relationship with her husband and daughter."

"Well? That was Yi Na's own fault, especially since she was too arrogant, and she threatened Zhang Fei [1] without knowing the identities of the people around him." Hai Dongyin let out a heavy sigh for a moment before continuing. "However, she was still lucky that he didn't kill her; otherwise, Wei Jiang and Luan'er would have lost him forever.
Perhaps the Wei and Yi clans will also disappear from this city if he really gets angry, especially since Boitata has the ability to do so."

"Forget it. This matter is their problem, so we don't need to get involved." Hai Dongxin then pointed towards the distance. "While we are in this city, I want to enjoy the beauty there, so let's go there right now."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] had already brought Chu Xing to a quiet place, and he then asked Mei to open a portal to the training space before asking his sister-in-law to enter it. "You can go in by yourself, and I'll go take care of something."
"Are you planning something against Aunt Yi?" Chu Xing frowned as she asked, not wanting to see Wei Luan in distress.
"No." Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at Chu Xing. "I do have plans against Yi Na, but I won't do it now, and I'll go take care of someone else."
After hearing that, Chu Xing immediately entered the training space, and Zhang Fei [1] hurried back to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, especially since the sect wasn't far from the Southern River City.

Moreover, they remembered that his cultivation was still at the 1-Star Foundation Realm when they first met at Blazing Volcano Mountain, but he had already reached the 10-Star Core Realm in less than a month.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed softly as he realized the Hai Twins' thoughts.
"Don't worry; my little sister is still a virgin, especially since she is still 17 years old, so she is still qualified to join the Hidden Sea Palace, right?"
"Even if your little sister is no longer a virgin, I am sure that Big Sis Yuzhen will make an exception for her." Hai Dongyin was the first to answer Zhang Fei [1].

"She is 17 years old, but her cultivation has already reached the 10-Star Foundation Realm, and she achieved it without dual-cultivating with you directly, which means she does have exceptional cultivation talent."
Hai Dongxin immediately supported her twin sister's words.

"Although I am not a dual cultivator, I know that your little sister would not be able to cultivate that fast even if you helped her with your yang qi, so I am sure that her talent is indeed above that of the famous young generation like Ye Lian and the others.
If I inform Big Sis Yuzhen about her, I am sure that she will immediately accept her, regardless of whether she is a virgin or not, and she will probably take her as her direct disciple right away."
Zhang Fei [1] himself did not know Hai Yuzhen, but he knew that she was one of the strong cultivators in the southern region.
Otherwise, she would not be able to become the sect master of the Hidden Sea Palace, and he was satisfied if a strong cultivator like her was willing to take Zhang Lin as her direct disciple.
"I will bring Lin'er to your sect after we finish our seclusion, which may coincide with the enrollment of new disciples, and you two can check her eligibility directly then."
"All right, we will be looking forward to welcoming your sister to our sect." The Hai Twins replied in unison.

After that, Zhang Fei [1] accompanied them to breakfast as they talked about light matters, but he repeatedly glanced at Wei Luan, who also repeatedly stole glances at him, especially since she was too curious about his and his sister's cultivation speed.
Yi Na, who was enjoying playing her guzheng, suddenly raised her eyebrows.
However, after she listened to the incoming voice transmission, her expression turned angry, causing one of the strings on her instrument to snap immediately because she plucked it too hard.
"Tch!
I forbade her from communicating with Zhang Fei [1], but she met him and had breakfast with him instead.
I know that she is with the elder Hai Twins, but she should have obeyed my prohibition and left them immediately."
After that, Yi Na stood up and left her clan with an angry expression, causing confusion among the people from the Wei Clan.
She then rushed to catch up with her daughter at the restaurant.
Sometime later, Yi Na had arrived at the restaurant and rushed to the second floor, and she became even angrier as soon as she saw Zhang Fei [1].
Even her expression was filled with disdain and scornfulness.
Zhang Fei [1], sensing her gaze on him, turned to Yi Na and raised his eyebrows when he saw her expression, making him realize that she was Wei Luan's mother. 'Scan her, Mei.'
[Aye.]
Name: Yi Na
Age: 50
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 10-Star Soul Realm
Element: Water [intermediate stage]
Core: Lower-Rank Water Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique:-
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: Wei Jiang
Likes: Wei Jiang, Wei Luan, Wei Hongtian
Dislikes: Everyone from the Yin-Yang Pavilion
'Her status is inversely proportional to her arrogance, but I didn't expect that her hatred for dual cultivators would be so deep.

She even hates everyone from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, which includes me.' Zhang Fei [1] inwardly muttered as he shook his head slightly, and he immediately averted his gaze from Yi Na, who was walking towards them.
Seeing her mother's arrival, Wei Luan immediately stood up and approached her.
"Why did you come here with such an angry face, Mother?"

"Don't you already know the reason why I'm so angry?" Yi Na asked back in a high tone as her eyes glanced towards Zhang Fei [1], starting the visitors on the second floor, but they immediately ignored her, especially since they knew her character well enough.
"I already forbade you from communicating with a male prostitute like him, but here you are eating with him."
"But-"
"No but!" Yi Na snapped at her daughter before turning to Zhang Fei [1].
"I feel grateful that you saved my daughter's happiness, but I don't want a male prostitute like you to approach her, so you'd better not see her again.
Otherwise, I will forget your kindness toward her and make your life miserable."
Hearing Yi Na's last sentence, the Hai Twins let out a helpless sigh because her character was indeed that arrogant, and they glanced at Zhang Fei [1], waiting for his reaction.
"Aunt Yi, you-"

"All right, you don't need to interfere with the matter between us, which wouldn't exist if it weren't for this old woman's arrogance." Yi Na's anger intensified when Zhang Fei [1] referred to her as an old woman, and the visitors on the second floor also laughed at her because of his remarks.
"Honestly, I don't like having problems with other people, and the reason I came here was not to see your daughter.
Instead, I came here to see all three of them, especially these twin elders, so your anger towards me is completely unreasonable.
You know what?
I hate it the most when anyone compares me to a prostitute, and your petty thoughts infuriate me.
Even though I'm a dual cultivator, all of my women are more honorable than an old and arrogant woman like you."
"You-"

"You what?" Zhang Fei [1] fiercely interrupted Yi Na before using his demon charm and special demon pheromone on her, causing her expression to change and her heart to pound as a pink heart symbol appeared in both of her eyes.
Nevertheless, the heart symbol was invisible to those around her; it was only visible to him.
Sensing the strangeness within herself, Yi Na shook her head vigorously to dispel it, but Zhang Fei's [1] two techniques were too potent for her, especially his demon pheromone. 'What happened to me?
Why am I suddenly attracted to him?
Moreover, my lust is beginning to spiral out of control, and I desperately want to pounce at him right away.'
"Do you think your status as the Wei clan's mistress is that great?" Zhang Fei [1] questioned Yi Na once more, continuing to employ his two techniques on her, before pointing at Wei Luan.
"Why don't you try to ask your daughter about my wives' identities?
She met some of them during our first meeting, and I dare you to brag about your status in front of me after you know their identities."

Wei Luan let out a soft sigh, tugged at her mother's sleeve, and told Yi Na about it through voice transmission, especially considering the large number of people present. 'Mom, Zhang Fei [1] is Liu Hua's husband, so he is the son-in-law of the Liu Clan.
Aside from that, Chu Ying and Chu Qing are his wives, so he is also the son-in-law of the Chu Clan.'

Hearing the names of the two clans from her daughter's mouth, Yi Na immediately froze in her spot, especially since both of them were powerful clans in their respective regions, especially the Liu Clan, which resided in the same city as her Wei and Yi Clan.
Yi Na then turned to the Hai Twins, looking for confirmation.
When they nodded, she realized her mistake and became fearful of Zhang Fei [1].
"Do you still want to make my life miserable?
If you are so confident that you can do it, then you can try." Zhang Fei [1] then grabbed Chu Xing's hand, pulled her up from her seat, and turned to the Hai Twins.
"Elders, I will take her with me, and I will return her to you two tonight."
"All right."
Zhang Fei [1] then pulled Chu Xing, who looked overjoyed, to go with him.
"Sister Luan, I will accompany you again later."
Wei Luan simply nodded and immediately supported Yi Na, who almost fell as her legs became weak from shock. 'Mom, you were too rash, you know?
I know that you hate the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but you kicked an iron plate by insulting Zhang Fei [1] like that, and you even arrogantly threatened to make his life miserable.
Furthermore, our Wei and Yi clans are second-grade clans, and we will never be able to withstand their wrath.'
Yi Na did not say anything in response to her daughter's words, especially since her mind was already filled with lust, and she wanted to go home as soon as possible to relieve it.
"Take me home, Luan'er."
"All right." Wei Luan then asked the Hai Twins.
"Do you two want to return to our clan, elders?"
"Not now." Hai Dongxin responded by shaking her head.
"You should take your mother back to the Wei Clan now, especially since her condition is clearly not good."
After Wei Luan took her mother away, the Hai Twins also left the restaurant, and Hai Dongyin asked her sister.
"What do you think Zhang Fei [1] did to Yi Na?
Others may not have noticed it, but I can see that she is being controlled by her lust."
"Yes." Hai Dongxin nodded in agreement with that.
"Perhaps Zhang Fei [1] used his dual cultivation technique on Yi Na, but I don't know what kind of technique he used on her to make her like that.
However, I have a feeling that this matter isn't over yet, and he might have something else planned against her that might mess up her relationship with her husband and daughter."
"Well?

That was Yi Na's own fault, especially since she was too arrogant, and she threatened Zhang Fei [1] without knowing the identities of the people around him." Hai Dongyin let out a heavy sigh for a moment before continuing.
"However, she was still lucky that he didn't kill her; otherwise, Wei Jiang and Luan'er would have lost him forever.
Perhaps the Wei and Yi clans will also disappear from this city if he really gets angry, especially since Boitata has the ability to do so."
"Forget it.
This matter is their problem, so we don't need to get involved." Hai Dongxin then pointed towards the distance.
"While we are in this city, I want to enjoy the beauty there, so let's go there right now."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] had already brought Chu Xing to a quiet place, and he then asked Mei to open a portal to the training space before asking his sister-in-law to enter it.
"You can go in by yourself, and I'll go take care of something."
"Are you planning something against Aunt Yi?" Chu Xing frowned as she asked, not wanting to see Wei Luan in distress.
"No." Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at Chu Xing.
"I do have plans against Yi Na, but I won't do it now, and I'll go take care of someone else."
After hearing that, Chu Xing immediately entered the training space, and Zhang Fei [1] hurried back to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, especially since the sect wasn't far from the Southern River City.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Chu Xing Meet His Wives
paragraphs: "Why are you in a daze? Are you so surprised to see me?" Zhang Fei's question brought Chu Xing back to her senses, and she looked back immediately, but the portal had already disappeared. "The me you met before was my clone, and this is my real body."

"Hmm?" Hearing that, Chu Xing reached out and groped Zhang Fei's face. "How is this possible? You and your clone are completely identical, including your cultivation, and I can't tell which one is the real one."
"Hahaha." Chu Qing suddenly laughed from afar before shouting to her second sister. "Sister Xing! It's easy to distinguish the real Fei from his clone because the real one is always with us."

Chu Xing nodded in understanding before pulling her hand back from Zhang Fei's face, and she then turned to Zhang Lin, Shen Yu, Boitata, Ru Xue, Zhong Yan, Qing Yi, the Wen Twins, Qiao Ran, and Mei Xiang. "Are all of them also your wives?"

"All of them are my wives, except for Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang, who are both my slaves." Zhang Fei then introduced them individually, leaving Chu Xing quite shocked, particularly due to his relationship with his mother and sisters. He then embraced Zhang Lin's shoulders and told his sister-in-law.
"I will send Lin'er to the Hidden Sea Palace soon, so I hope you can help her adapt to the situation there."
"Sister Xing, I hope you can assist me and take care of me after I join the Hidden Sea Palace, okay?" Zhang Lin spoke as she gently shook Chu Xing's hands. "Anyway, nice to meet you."

"Nice to meet you too." Chu Xing replied to Zhang Lin with a nod. "Anyway, you don't have to worry about the situation in the sect, especially since all of the elders and disciples are women, and most of them are good people. However, there are some individuals within the sect who exhibit arrogance and curiosity.
Once you join us, I will provide you with information about those people, so you can be on guard against them.
"I know, I will definitely follow your advice." Zhang Lin replied with a sweet smile.

Chu Xing then turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately transformed into his half-fox form. Her eyes sparkled after seeing his second form, and she circled him as she looked up and down to make sure that his form was real.

Just like her little sister and the others, Chu Xing looked so excited to see Zhang Fei's half-fox form, and she grabbed one of his four tails before rubbing it against her cheek, enjoying its softness. "I've never seen a demihuman before, but I like your form, and your tail is truly smooth."

Zhang Fei could only sigh helplessly in his heart because of Chu Xing's behavior, especially since she and the other women always acted the same when they saw his half-fox form, even more so when they saw his fox form.

Zhang Lin smiled upon witnessing Chu Xing's behavior and then spoke to her. "Sister Xing, you will be more excited if you see big brother become a fox, and his fox form has grown much bigger than before."

Upon hearing that, Chu Xing looked at Zhang Fei with anticipation, causing him to smile wryly before turning into his fox form, which made her eyes sparkle even more, especially since his fur was so white and smooth. She hugged his neck and rubbed her face. "Wow! I've seen all kinds of fox beasts before!
However, none of them are as beautiful as you, and your white fur is so soft compared to theirs, making me really not want to let you go! Can I ride you?"

'Tch! This woman! What is she thinking? She even wanted to ride me like a beast mount!' Zhang Fei inwardly grumbled before using his aura to place Chu Xing on his back. "Are you satisfied now? Even though I'm a beast, I'm not a beast mount, you know?"

"Hahaha!" Chu Xing laughed, laid on Zhang Fei's back, hugged his neck once more, and continued to pot his smooth fur. "Even though I've seen you form myself, I still find it hard to believe it. Moreover, my aunt and two sisters are your wives, so I feel a little strange.

Anyway, I have one question about your relationship with them, and I think it's very important, especially if you have children from them in the future. Will your children be born as humans or as fox beasts?"

Not only was Zhang Fei stunned by Chu Xing's question, but all of his women also looked stunned after hearing that. They had never thought about having children with him before, and her question made them think about their future children.

Liu Hua was the first to come back to her senses and speak to Zhang Fei. "If Xing'er had never asked this, then I would never have thought of it. Moreover, you have three forms, and all three are real, so I feel confused and curious about what our children will look like in the future."
"Zhang Fei's third form? What do you mean by that, Aunt Hua?" Chu Xing asked her aunt with a confused look.

After hearing her question, Zhang Fei glanced at Liu Hua and his other women, who nodded their agreement for him to reveal his demon form to Chu Xing. He then lowered his sister-in-law from his back before transforming into an incubus, but her reaction was beyond everyone's expectations.

"Wow!" Chu Xing let out a loud exclamation upon witnessing this and then extended her hands to caress Zhang Fei's horns, wings, and tail. "How did you become like this? If I remember correctly, your form is a demon form, right? Moreover, you were previously both a human and a fox beast, but I can tell that this form is also real."

"I possess three distinct forms, and you're correct in identifying this as my demon form, specifically a lust demon. However, only my wives and partners know about my demon form, so you should not tell this to others, such as Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin.

After all, many cultivators in this realm despise demons due to their past invasions, and discovering my third identity would only cause me significant trouble. Chu Xing naturally understood this, so she nodded in agreement to Zhang Fei, who immediately returned to his human form, and then answered their previous questions.

"Honestly, I still don't know whether our children will be born as humans or whether they will inherit my fox and demon bloodlines, so we can only find out in the future. Even so, I hope that they will be born as humans, especially since their lives will be difficult if they are born as fox beasts, let alone if they are born as lust demons."
That was also agreed upon by Liu Hua and the others. Although they liked Zhang Fei's fox form and did not mind his demon form, they would much prefer their children to be born as humans.

Chu Ying suddenly spoke to her husband while pointing to the other two women. "However, your children with Big Sis Yu and Big Sis Boitata will probably be born as beasts, especially since they are both also beasts."
Chu Xing immediately turned to Shen Yu and Boitata, looking shocked to learn that the two women were beasts who had transformed into humans. "What kind of beasts are they?"
"Big Sis Yu is a sea serpent, and Big Sis Boitata is a dragon-serpent."

Chu Xing looked curious to see the two women's beast forms, but Shen Yu and Boitata seemed reluctant to show them to her, causing her to pout her lips. She then turned to Zhang Fei and inquired. "What exactly is this place? Why are you guys here?"

"See that?" Zhang Fei pointed to the device in the middle of the room. "This place is my personal training space, and no one else has it. If you train here long enough, your speed will become faster than that of your sect sisters."

"Let me show you." Zhang Lin said this as she pulled Chu Xing to the center. "Brother, you can activate it now, and you better get ready, Sister Xing, especially since the gravity in this area will be heavier than in the side areas."

Chu Xing wanted to ask her, but Mei had already activated the gravity feature, causing her to fall straight to the floor. "Ahh! What the hell is going on here? How could this place become so heavy all of a sudden?"

"Haha." Zhang Lin laughed softly and squatted down beside Chu Xing. "Sister Xing, this is thanks to the gravity feature in this device, and it is still level one, which makes the gravity in this area two times heavier than the outside world."

"Xing'er, all of us have fully adapted to this weight, so it would be better if you started learning to adapt to this gravity." Chu Ying uttered these words as she moved closer to her sister. "If you have adapted like us, then your speed will increase quite significantly, and the disciples of the Hidden Sea Palace will not be able to match your speed."

"Ugh! But this pressure is too much, Big Sis!" Chu Xing complained as she tried to move her hands, but the weight of gravity in the area rendered her powerless. "How do you all adapt to this kind of weight?"

"Naturally, we all struggle hard to adapt to that weight, Sister Xing!" Chu Qing shouted to her second sister from a distance. "Your cultivation is higher than mine, so you should be able to do it too, and you just need to put in more effort! Moreover, we've started training at four times gravity, and I'll far surpass you if I manage to do it."

"Tch!" Chu Xing gritted her teeth after hearing that, and she then shouted back at her little sister. "Humph! If a little girl like you can adapt to this weight, then I can too, and you will never be able to surpass me."

"Hahaha!" Upon hearing that, Chu Qing burst into laughter. "Sister Xing, I'm one step ahead of you now, and you can't possibly stay here forever like us, as you have to return to your sect, so you'll never be able to catch up to me."

Chu Xing's expression turned annoyed after hearing her little sister's answer, as she did not want to lose to Chu Qing, who was younger than her. However, she herself was aware of her own situation, so she let out a heavy sigh and ignored her little sister, and she began to try to get used to two times gravity.
Meanwhile, Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang, who had previously struggled to adjust to four times gravity, felt a sense of relief and started attempting to adjust to two times gravity.

Chu Qing smiled triumphantly after seeing Chu Xing like that, and she then hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "Hehe. Sister Xing's competitive spirit is very high, and she will try harder not to lose to me, so I deliberately said that to her."

"You're so naughty, you know?" Zhang Fei spoke while pinching Chu Qing's nose. "However, it is really good, and Chu Xing looks so enthusiastic now, even though she has difficulty with it, so I believe she can adapt to two times gravity faster."

"Hehe." Chu Qing giggled and asked him. "Are you interested in Sister Xing, Fei? Since Big Sis and I are already your wives, I think it would be better if you also took her as your wife, so that we three sisters can be together forever."

Zhang Fei did not deny that Chu Xing was indeed pretty and attractive, like her two sisters, but he felt that she was quite different from Chu Ying and Chu Qing, and she also seemed more mischievous than Zhang Lin. "En, you are right; I am indeed interested in your second sister, but I don't know if she is interested in me or not."
"In that case, you-"

"No." Zhang Fei immediately rejected Chu Qing's ideas, even though she had not finished her words. "I will not use my lust demon abilities on him, and I will try to approach Chu Xing in the usual way."
Chu Qing pouted her lips in response, and Liu Hua shook her head at her, signaling that she should not force their husband to use his lust demon abilities on Chu Xing.

Chu Xing had just begun to learn how to adapt to the level one gravity feature, so Zhang Fei decided to spar with the Wen Twins and Liu Hua, especially since his combat abilities were still far below theirs.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] had already entered a room, utilizing his invisibility, and he glanced at Yin Tong, who was asleep between his two partners. 'Hey! I hadn't done anything to you, but you actually plotted with Du Ruhui to fight me out of jealousy, so you have to bear the consequences.'

Since group missions give bigger rewards, then I will join them, and I will also invite them to join us."
After he talked with Mu Lingshu, Zhang Fei [1] went to the mission halls and selected a few missions, causing the male elder to sigh helplessly because he took too many missions.
Even so, Min Ren couldn't stop him from taking them, especially since Shen Xueyi had already made an exception for him.

Zhang Fei [1] then reported the results of their previous missions, and he also explained to Min Ren about the female Lich in the remote valley, which had cost him quite a lot of point reward, especially since that mission did not count.
"All right, I will tell Mistress Shen and the others about that demon, so they can move to track down the whereabouts of the other demons that might still be hiding in other places."

"Elder, you can give me my points, and you can give the rest to Gu Yan and the others." After that, Zhang Fei [1] gave his disciple identity to Mi Ren, who immediately distributed the rewards from those missions.
[You obtained 75,000 sect points.]
After receiving his reward, Zhang Fei [1] hurried to the sect gate, met Zefyr there, and took her to the Southern River City.
When he arrived at a quiet place, Zhang Fei [1] immediately asked Mei to open the portal to the training space, and Chu Xing came out from inside.
However, her appearance was too shabby, and her hair was also messy.
"How do you feel after training there?"
"Not bad." Chu Xing replied as she nodded.
"Although I haven't fully adapted yet, I feel that my body is much lighter, and it will be useful when I participate in my sect's internal competition."
"All right, you can go back to the Wei Clan by yourself, and I will go somewhere else right now." After that, Zhang Fei [1] activated the portal to the Blazing Phoenix Sect before entering it.
After her brother-in-law disappeared, Chu Xing let out a soft sigh as he shook his head.
"None of his abilities are normal!
Fortunately, he is on our side, or he would have caused us a lot of trouble if he were our enemy."
Chu Xing then hurried back to the Wei Clan and went to see Wei Luan, who had not yet woken up from her sleep.
She decided to rest by her side, especially since her body was so exhausted by the gravitational pressure in the training space.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] and Zefyr had already arrived not far from the Blazing Moon Sect, and he immediately contacted Zhang Lingxue to come meet him.
They did not have to wait too long, as they saw Zhang Lingxue flying out of the sect in a hurry a few minutes later, and she landed in front of them.
However, Zhang Fei [1] immediately stopped her when she wanted to hug him.
"All right, don't be so excited—this is my clone, so I won't touch you."
"Oh!
I see." Zhang Lingxue nodded in understanding before looking at Zefyr, who was sitting leisurely on Zhang Fei [1]'s shoulder.
"Who is she, Fei'er?
Where did you find her?
Why is her body so small?"

Zhang Fei [1] immediately introduced the two of them, and he also told his wife about his meeting with Zefyr, which greatly surprised Zhang Lingxue, especially since she had never met a natural race before.
"Is Ziqin still in seclusion?"
"Ziqin is still in seclusion now, but she will probably come out in a few days." Zhang Lingxue replied with a nod, but her eyes never left Zefyr's figure.
"Anyway, why did you suddenly come here?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed before opening a portal leading to the deserted valley.
"You can go through that portal now, and you'll love that place."
"Hmm?" Zhang Lingxue looked suspiciously at her husband before entering the portal, and Zhang Fei [1] brought Zefyr after her.
Once they arrived, Zhang Lingxue was immediately stunned by the expanse of various plants and herbs growing abundantly in the place, many of which she could instantly recognize.
Even Zefyr was stunned to see all of that, and she had not expected to find such a place filled with so many precious items in their realm.
After all, she was a fairy, and she could naturally recognize the value of the various plants and herbs in that place.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled because Zhang Lingxue's expression was just as he had expected.
"Actually, I found this place by accident, and I knew you would like it very much.
That's why I deliberately set up a barrier around this entire area so no other cultivators can find it, and you can use everything available here for your alchemy needs."
"This place is truly wonderful, Fei'er!

All alchemists would be so excited if they knew about it, including Big Sis Yao!" Zhang Lingxue shouted as soon as she returned to her senses, and she immediately ran around the place while explaining to her husband about those plants and herbs.
"All of these herbs are useful and valuable for alchemy!
Since they're all old, auctioning them would yield sky-high prices.
However, I won't do that because their prices will increase several times over if I refine them into pills, potions, or medicinal liquids."
Just like her, Zefyr immediately flew off Zhang Fei [1]'s shoulder and circled around the area, picking up some herbs that were useful for increasing her cultivation and wind element.

However, a fairy was a creature that was friendly to nature, so she didn't take too much, especially since it was impossible for her to use them at once, and she only took enough for her current needs.
Seeing Zhang Lingxue acting excitedly like a child who had gotten new toys, Zhang Fei [1] also felt joyful in his heart.
However, he realized that something was missing, so he asked Mei. 'Is there anything in the shop that can be used to connect the two places?
That way, Lingxue won't have to rely on me, and she can go back and forth between the two places by herself.'
[I had anticipated that you would inquire about it, so I have been searching for it since you discovered this place.
I will now purchase it, Master.]
{You got Teleportation Device x1}
{10,000,000 has been deducted from your balance}

'Oh?' Zhang Fei [1] was momentarily taken aback when the notification appeared, and he immediately took the device, which was in the form of two similar metal discs. 'So, we should leave one plate here, and Lingxue can bring the other one with her, right?'
[Yes, Master.
Unfortunately, its functions are limited, so each device can only connect to two different places.
If you want to connect to another place, you have to buy another one.]
'I see.' Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, and he thought about connecting the Liu and Chu Clans so the Liu Sisters and the others could go back and forth between the two clans more easily.
After that, he placed one of the plates in a place that was not covered by the plants and herbs, and then he went to his wife and gave another plate to her.
"Lingxue, you can keep this with you, so you can go back and forth between your sect and this place more easily."
Zhang Fei [1] then explained to his wife how to use the devoce, which made Zhang Lingxue even more excited.
"Hehehe.
Thank you, Fei'er.
I actually have some useful pill recipes that I want to concoct, but I'm lacking some types of ingredients, which are all available here, so I'll concoct them after I get back."
Zhang Fei [1] suddenly remembered something before telling his wife again.
"Anyway, there is a giant octopus beast living here, and his name is Polypus.
I purposely allowed him to stay here to take care of everything, so you can tell him that you are my wife, and he will definitely help you take care of things."
"I see." Zhang Lingxue then said to him.
"Let's go back first, and I'll come back here myself later."
Zhang Fei [1] immediately called Zefyr back before bringing the two women back to the Blazing Phoenix Sect, and Zhang Lingxue rushed back to her sect to look for some things.
Meanwhile, he took the wind fairy to another location, which was the entrance to the Moon Fox sub-realm.
