chapters.title: Chapter 264: Infiltrate The Moon Fox Sub-Realm
paragraphs: Min Ren was rendered immobile by Shen Haoran, who suddenly came along with his ten loyalists. "Tell me, what kind of missions did that brat Zhang Fei accept, as well as their locations?"

'Zhang Fei [1]? Why would someone like him suddenly look for that brat? Is there something wrong between them?' Min Ren wondered in his heart, but suddenly received a voice transmission from Shen Xueyi. Shen Xueyi ordered him to tell Shen Haoran the truth, and he obeyed by informing them of his destination.
After he got the information, Shen Haoran immediately left the mission hall and gave orders to his ten loyalists. "Look for that brat and kill him once you find him."
"Yes, Sir!"

Min Ren, who heard Shen Haoran's order from a distance, immediately frowned. He intended to go see Shen Xueyi, but she had already appeared in front of him first. "Aren't you going to stop them, Mistress Shen?"

"Do you think I would let them pursue him if I didn't know about his abilities and strength?" Instead, Shen Xueyi asked Min Ren back. "You don't have to worry about that kid, Elder Min. Even if Shen Haoran pursues Zhang Fei [1] on his own, he will be unable to do any harm.
Instead, this matter is a favorable opportunity for me to reduce his loyalists, which will weaken him, and we can take action on him quicker than I had planned."

Min Ren himself would be thrilled if Shen Haoran and his loyalists disappeared, but he still had doubts about Zhang Fei [1]. "Can that brat really deal with them at the same time, Madam Shen? After all, their cultivation is at the late stage of the Earth Realm, and his cultivation is still at the Core Realm, so the difference in their strength is too great."

"Elder Min, I already know more or less about Zhang Fei [1]; especially since I have experienced some of his abilities myself, I dare to guarantee that those guys won't be able to do anything to him." After she said that, Shen Xueyi immediately disappeared from the mission hall again, leaving Min Ren dumbfounded.

Before long, Min Ren came back to his senses and muttered to himself. "I don't understand why Madam Shen trusts that brat so much, but I hope he will manage to survive those people's pursuit, and it would be even better if he could kill them."

Zhang Fei [1] and Zefyr had already arrived at a location quite far from the Blazing Phoenix Sect, but the area was completely empty, and he immediately transformed into his half-fox form before trying to contact Hu Lili.

As he expected, Zhang Fei [1] could not contact Hu Lili from the outside, and he had to enter the moon fox sub-realm first to be able to do it, so he immediately took out the necklace that Hu Lili gave him some time ago.
Zhang Fei [1] decided to use his invisibility first because the moon foxes might be hostile towards him, so he didn't want to take such a risk.
"Hey! How could you disappear like that? This? I couldn't even sense your presence at all, Fei." Zefyr inquired in a tone filled with surprise.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled before telling Zefyr. "Invisibility is one of my abilities as a heavenly fox, but I'm not sure if this will also fool the moon foxes."

Zefyr nodded in understanding of Zhang Fei [1]'s worries. "It's okay; you don't have to worry about them, because I'm sure they won't be able to sense your presence like I can. Moreover, you've got me by your side, and I'll definitely help you divert their attention."
"Thank you; I'll leave them to you." After that, Zhang Fei [1] activated the necklace, causing a portal to appear out of nowhere, which immediately sucked them both in.
Moments later, the two were already inside the moon fox sub-realm, and the place was truly spacious and otherworldly, filled with various tall plants and vegetation.

Unlike Zhang Fei [1], who was stunned after seeing that, Zefyr immediately floated high into the air as she inhaled the air inside the place, and her expression clearly showed that she was extremely excited. "Hey! Even though this is only a sub-realm of the Sky Jade Realm, the nature here is much fresher and more fertile, particularly since no humans live here."

Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened his map to search for Hu Lili and Hu Yue, and he found that both of them were in an area that was quite far from his current location. After that, he checked each name of the members of the moon fox race, and he found Hu Dong's name at an even further distance, surrounded by so many moon foxes.
'Hu Gao seems so paranoid, especially since they live in their own sub-realm, but he keeps such a tight guard over his son.'
"So, where are those two women now?" Zefyr asked as he sat on Zhang Fei [1]'s shoulder again. .
"Over there." Zhang Fei pointed in a certain direction, according to the map. "We'll go there right away, and you can prepare to distract them if anyone notices us."
"All right, leave them to me."

Inside the cave, Hu Lili, who was helping her daughter cultivate, abruptly opened her eyes. Her expression was one of shock and disbelief at the same time, especially after she received a voice transmission from Zhang Fei [1], making her realize that he was in their realm.
Feeling the change in her mother's Qi, Hu Yue immediately opened her eyes and asked Hu Lili. "What happened, Mother? Why did your qi suddenly become chaotic?"

"Zhang Fei [1] is here." Hu Lili's answer left Hu Yue stunned. "He really is reckless! I don't know why he was so bold as to come to our realm with his cultivation still being so low, but he really is here now, and he is on his way here."
"Mother-"
*Bam... Bam...*

The soft punching sound on the cave's stone door surprised both women, prompting Hu Lili to immediately withdraw her Qi from her daughter's body, dress up, and open the stone door. However, she raised her eyebrows because she didn't see Zhang Fei [1], and she only saw Zefyr floating in the air by herself. "A fairy? How did you come here?"

"Naturally, I came here with him." Zefyr replied by pointing her little finger into the cave. Hu Lili looked back, but she was still unable to see or feel the presence of Zhang Fei [1], who was still in his state of invisibility.
Even Hu Yue searched her cultivation cave for Zhang Fei [1], but, like her mother, she was unable to locate him.
"All right, let's go in first." Zefyr spoke as she pushed the moon fox mother back into the cave, and Hu Lili immediately closed the stone door once more, looking at her in confusion.

Before they could ask Zefyr, both women were shocked by the appearance of a portal, and they were even more shocked when Zhang Fei walked out of it. His clone also cancelled out his invisibility, causing both women's jaws to drop when they saw them, especially since they looked like identical twins.

Zhang Fei smiled at seeing their reactions, but he immediately lifted Hu Yue to her feet, hugged her, and whispered in her ear. "Hey, my sexy fox. Did you miss me?" I missed you so much and wanted to see you, so I took the risk of coming here to see you."

Hearing Zhang Fei's voice and feeling the warmth of his body, tears unknowingly flowed from Hu Yue's clear eyes, and she immediately hugged him back while sobbing. "Sob... Sob... I miss you so much, Fei. I always wanted to go see you again, but I was never able to, so I'm really glad that you're here now."
"En, I'm here now, Yue'er." Zhang Fei replied in a soft voice as he hugged Hu Yue tighter.
Hu Lili let out a soft sigh, seeing her daughter like that, and she then asked them. "How come there are two of you? Moreover, you guys are like identical twins, including your aura and cultivation."

"He is my clone." Zhang Fei said this as he released Hu Yue from his embrace, wiped the tears from her eyes, pointed to the portal, and then answered Hu Lili. "I have to accompany my wives and family, and they are training inside right now. That's why I used my clone to join the Yin-Yang Pavilion, especially since I need a lot of qi and female essence."

"I see." Hu Li nodded in understanding upon hearing that, but he was also taken aback by his cultivation. "Your cultivation still hasn't broken through to the Core Realm since we last met, which was about half a month ago, but you have already reached the 10-Star Core Realm, and I can feel that you will soon break through to the Soul Realm.

If you continue to cultivate at this rate, then I am sure you can reach the Heaven Realm or the Sovereign Realm in less than five years. You must also be careful when increasing your cultivation, and do not rush to break through, lest your foundation collapse."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed when he heard that. "You are the umpteenth person to remind me about it, and I appreciate all of your warnings. That's why I'm still holding back, or else I would have already broken through to the soul realm by now."

"That's good." Hu Lili nodded in satisfaction, knowing that Zhang Fei was not reckless with his cultivation. "Anyway, what other purpose do you have for coming here so soon? I'm pretty sure that you didn't come here just to see Yue'er, especially since you can't take her away from here right now."
'Mei, buy three sets of those pills and two sets of the pills for beast.'
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Essence Qi Pill x3}
{You got Meridian Cleansing Pill x3}
{You got Dantian Strengthening Pill x3}
{You got Soul Enhanced Pill x3}
{You got Yin Purifying Pill x3}
{You got Beast Body Tempering Pill x2}
{You got Beast Talent Pill x2}
{You got Beast Advancement Pill x2}
{3,000,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance}
{200 Lower Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance} Continue your adventure at
{100 Intermediate Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance}
{20 Advanced Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance}

Zhang Fei then distributed all the pills to Hu Yue, Hu Lili, and Zefyr before explaining the effects of each pill, which shocked them, but their expressions turned to joy after that. "Back then, I didn't have the jewels to buy them, so I used my clone to come here and give them to you two.

This way, Yue'er will be able to break through to the sovereign realm, and you can also break through to the 2-Star sovereign realm. Furthermore, after you two take the talent pills, you guys can cultivate faster, but I'm not sure if your beast ranks can surpass the divine rank.
Even if you two can't, I'm sure you guys will still be stronger than Hu Gao, and we will get rid of him and his son together when I'm ready."
"What about me? Why did you give these precious pills to me?" Zefyr asked with curiosity.

Zhang Fei immediately turned to Zephyr. "We both have a contract, remember? Since we are both bound to each other, you are part of my extended family now, and I will naturally treat you as an equal to them."
Hu Lili was not surprised to hear Zhang Fei had a contract with a fairy like Zefyr, especially since she knew quite a bit about the Heavenly Fox. "Did you come here to ask about your fox race?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Hu Lili. "Zefyr told me about the ten-tailed fox that used to live in this realm, but I had never heard of it before. Given that you were aware of my fox race based solely on Yu'er's memories, I assumed you had some knowledge about it. Therefore, I came here to inquire about it, particularly because of the unusual writing it left behind.

"Unusual writing?" Zefyr immediately told both women about the writing on the stone monument, and Hu Lili nodded in understanding before answering Zhang Fei. "I don't know for sure about the writing, but I know that the ten-tailed fox really existed. In fact, he is the ancestor of all fox races, including our moon fox race."

"Huh?" Zhang Fei and Zefyr were taken aback upon hearing this, particularly because it differed from Oliver's story, and the wind fairy inquired with Hu Lili. "Didn't the ten-tailed fox split itself into two? Both of them are the ancestors of the current heavenly fox, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Hu Lili.
"Zefyr told me about the ten-tailed fox that used to live in this realm, but I had never heard of it before.
Given that you were aware of my fox race based solely on Yu'er's memories, I assumed you had some knowledge about it.
Therefore, I came here to inquire about it, particularly because of the unusual writing it left behind.
"Unusual writing?" Zefyr immediately told both women about the writing on the stone monument, and Hu Lili nodded in understanding before answering Zhang Fei.
"I don't know for sure about the writing, but I know that the ten-tailed fox really existed.
In fact, he is the ancestor of all fox races, including our moon fox race."
"Huh?" Zhang Fei and Zefyr were taken aback upon hearing this, particularly because it differed from Oliver's story, and the wind fairy inquired with Hu Lili.
"Didn't the ten-tailed fox split itself into two?
Both of them are the ancestors of the current heavenly fox, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Hu Yue Breakthrough
paragraphs: "You're not wrong about that." Hu Lili replied to Zefyr as she nodded in agreement. "However, since you and the other natural races aren't beasts like me, you don't have accurate information about the ten-tailed fox. Indeed, he is the ancestor of the fox races, but not in a literal sense, as he was born out of the hopes of the fox races."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei and Zefyr were even more shocked to hear that the fox races could give birth to a new individual because of their hopes.

Hu Lili smiled as she observed their expressions and proceeded with her explanation. "All fox races have always lived oppressed lives in the past, so they hoped for a savior who could save them and bring them a better life, and the birth of the ten-tailed fox fulfilled their hopes.

Since then, the lives of the fox races have undergone significant changes, particularly due to the emergence of the ten-tailed fox as a powerful mythical beast. After that, he challenged all the beasts, including the mythical ones who were as strong as him, in an effort to free the fox races from oppression.

Once the fox races had achieved tranquility, he decided to sequester himself from the public in a secluded realm inhabited only by natural species. However, I don't have any further information about him beyond that point, and your grandfather's story likely continues after he isolated himself in that realm."
"That realm's name was the Heaven Wilderness Realm, but it has now changed to the Sky Jade Realm."

Unlike Hu Yue, who looked surprised to hear Zefyr's words, Hu Lili was not surprised by her words at all. "The first time our moon fox race ancestors moved to this realm, the ten-tailed fox no longer existed because he had split himself into the two heavenly foxes, and they had also left this realm."
"Yes." Zefyr nodded in agreement with Hu Lili, especially since she herself also knew about the early arrival of the moon fox race in the Sky Jade Realm, based on her grandfather's story.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before speaking to them. "Currently, those heavenly foxes reside in a realm called Heavenly Moon Realm, and I know how to get there. However, I wouldn't be so bold as to venture there, as they belong to the same race as me, and their strength surpasses mine, rendering my bloodline useless against them."

"You really shouldn't go there now." Hu Lili replied with a nod. "Just like you, the heavenly foxes are very arrogant and cunning, and they may recognize your identity as a demon, especially since both of their ancestors have already reached nine-tailed. If that happens, then they will hunt you down, and you won't be able to do anything."

"That's why I haven't thought about going to that realm, as I'm fully aware of my strength and limit, so I thought about going there once I reach nine-tailed like their ancestors." Zhang Fei then looked at Hu Yue and rubbed her cheek. "I know it's hard to reach nine-tailed, but I will never give up, and I will try harder to achieve it.
Only then can I protect you and my other wives; I will kill anyone who has malicious intentions towards you all."

Hu Yue smiled and pressed Zhang Fei's hand to her cheek. "Don't worry, I'm sure you can achieve it. Not only will you reach the nine-tailed, but you will also reach the ten-tailed, especially since you are the man inscribed on the stone monument."

"Since you trust me so much, I will definitely not let you down, Yue'er." Zhang Fei then kissed Hu Yue's lips, which she immediately reciprocated, and they kissed for a while. "Honestly, I want to take you to my training space, especially since all of the features there will be useful to you.

Unfortunately, Hu Gao will find out if you disappear now, and it will cause trouble for your mother, so I will take you there in the future. For now, you can swallow the pills, and you will break through directly to the sovereign realm, so you will be one step ahead of Hu Dong."
"All right." Hu Yue replied with a sweet smile on her face.

"I know you still want to be with my daughter, but you all have to leave now." Zhang Fei quickly turned to Hu Lili, who promptly informed him of the situation. "In a moment, Hu Gao's people will patrol this area, and some of them have sensor abilities that may be able to detect your presence even if you are using your invisibility.
That's why it would be better for you guys to leave now, and I hope you don't come back here before you reach the sovereign realm."

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Hu Lili, and he kissed Hu Yue once more before returning to the training space. Meanwhile, his clone attempted to save the location, but was disappointed by the resulting notification.
[Ding]
[Unable to save the location due to too many restrictions.]

Zhang Fei [1] let out a heavy sigh and tried to use his warp portal to return to the southern region. When it actually opened, he immediately brought Zefyr into it, leaving the fox's mother and daughter behind.

"Yue'er, I know you still want to be with Zhang Fei, but you just need to focus on your cultivation and wait for him to come here again, and I'm sure that he will take you away on his second coming." Hu Lili then took off her clothes again and sat down cross-legged. "Let's do it; you can swallow those pills first, and I'll assist you with my qi."

"Yes, Mother." Hu Yue immediately sat cross-legged in front of her mother, and Hu Lili directly pressed her palms against her chest, so she swallowed those pills one by one according to Zhang Fei's instructions.

Soon, a pink aura began to envelop Hu Yue's body, and Hu Lili immediately channeled her qi into her body, causing her aura to gradually become brighter and stronger, especially after she swallowed all the pills.
One hour.
two hours.

Three hours later, Hu Yue's body unleashed a massive shockwave that nearly knocked back Hu Lili, who was sitting in front of her, but she quickly stabilized herself. 'This is good; Yue'er just needs to get past her final barrier.'

A few moments later, Hu Yue floated in midair, and the pink aura that enveloped her body was already extremely bright. Despite this, Hu Lili could see five fox tails dancing behind her daughter's hips. 'She has finally broken through to the sovereign realm.'

"Phew." Hu Yue sighed with relief as she sat back cross-legged on the ground, opened her eyes, and said so happily. "This is really amazing, mother! I never thought that Zhang Fei had such potent pills; otherwise, I would still need some time before I could break through to this stage."

"All right, you should stabilize your cultivation now, and I will swallow those pills." Hu Yue nodded in agreement and closed her eyes once more to stabilize her cultivation, while Hu Lili immediately glanced at the pills in her hands, muttering. '2-Star sovereign realm, huh? If I reach that stage, I only need one more to match Hu Gao.
Unfortunately, most of our race members are on his side, and I won't be able to fight them alone, so I'll wait for Zhang Fei to reach this stage.'

After that, Hu Lili closed her eyes and swallowed the pills in order, but she did not break through to the 2-Star sovereign realm straight away, especially since her cultivation was still far from the wall to that stage. Despite this, the effects of those pills, particularly the beast pill, allowed her to cultivate at a faster pace, which satisfied her greatly.

Yi Na is in the dining room with her daughter, Chu Xing, and the Hai Twins. However, she seemed unfocused and ate very slowly, especially since her mind was still filled with her affair with Zhang Fei, which made her feel very guilty.
As for Wei Jiang, he was still sleeping soundly in the room, especially since Yi Na had given him too many sleeping pills earlier.
"What's wrong with you, Mother? Are you feeling unwell?"
Wei Luan's questions brought Yi Na back to her senses, and she immediately shook her head at her daughter. "I wasn't sick; I was just thinking about things, so don't worry."
"Oh." Wei Luan just nodded and didn't ask any further, especially since she knew her mother's character very well, and she never liked it when people meddled in her affairs.

Unlike her, Chu Xing felt strange about Yi Na's attitude, especially when she noticed the Hai Twins' glances at her. 'Could it be that my brother-in-law has done something to Aunt Yi? Moreover, she's been acting strangely since yesterday in the restaurant, and he's also a lust demon, so I suspect they might have slept together.'
The Hai Twins did not comment on Yi Na's situation, especially since it was none of their business, and they were fully aware that she was already having an affair with Zhang Fei.
Hai Dongxin then spoke to Yi Na. "After this, we'll bring Luan'er and Xing'er back to our sect to prepare for our internal competition, which we hope one of them will win."
"All right." Yi Na nodded, then turned to her daughter. "You have been training specifically for that competition for so long, so you must try your best to win it, okay?"
"Yes, mother."

After they all finished eating, the Hai Twins immediately took the two young girls to leave the Wei Clan. However, Hai Dongyin felt that there was something strange about Chu Xing's movements, so he immediately asked him. "Xing'er, where did Zhang Fei take you yesterday? Did he take you through that portal?"

Since Wei Luan and the Hai Twins had previously seen the portal in the forest, Chu Xing did not hide it from them. "You are right, Elder Dongyin. Behind that place is my brother-in-law's special training ground, and there are many intriguing things inside that are beneficial to my training.

However, I cannot explain it in detail to the three of you, especially since he and the others have forbidden me from telling anyone about that place. Honestly, I still wanted to train there, especially since I still couldn't adapt perfectly, but I didn't want to miss the competition, so I decided to come back. If you are curious about my training there, I will show you the results from yesterday."

After that, Chu Xing used her movement technique, giving the impression that she was dancing. Her movements were much more agile than before she trained in the training space, leaving the three women stunned.
"Hehe." Chu Xing laughed when she returned to them. "What do you three think?"

Hai Dongxin nodded slightly before answering her. "Although your improvement may not be significant, I can observe that your speed has increased, and your movements have become more fluid and nimble. Therefore, I think that Zhang Fei has something related to speed; otherwise, you wouldn't be able to improve like this in just a day of training."

"Haha." Chu Xing laughed upon hearing that. "You're not wrong about that, Elder Dongxin. Actually, there were still some things I did there yesterday, but I can't explain them in detail, and I'll show my other improvements when the competition starts."
"All right, I'll be waiting for your surprise at the competition." The Hai Twins said it at the same time.
After that, the four of them broke their returning jade, and they immediately disappeared from the city.

After he returned to the southern region, Zhang Fei [1] immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps to go to his first mission location, but he frowned as soon as he arrived there, especially after he listened to Yan Luan'er's voice transmission. 'Why did Shen Haoran send his loyalists to kill me? Ten beast cultivators in the earth realm, huh? Since they want to kill me, then I will kill them all.
As for that old man, I will do something about him after I return from my wanderings.'
"So, we'll start our journey from here, Fei?" Zefyr asked him.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod. "At first, I want to finish the mission in this area as quickly as possible, and we'll go to the second location. Unfortunately, some people want to kill me, and their journey to this area will take two days, so we'll wait while I finish my first mission."
Zefyr shook her head after hearing that. "Humans are idiots! They always think of killing other living beings!"

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Demon Fox
paragraphs: After she found some things she needed, Zhang Lingxue went to the deserted valley again, but she was surprised because a giant octopus beast suddenly came out of the hole not far from the teleportation device.

Polypus was also surprised by Zhang Lingxue's presence, but he remembered that Zhang Fei had already set up a barrier around the area, so no one else could enter the place. He then returned to his human form before asking her. "Are you Big Brother's wife, Big Sis?"
"Yes." Zhang Lingxue answered before moving in front of him and lightly patting his head. "You're Polypus, right? My husband has told me about you, and I hope you can help me."

"Hehe." Polypus seemed pleased with Zhang Lingxue's actions, and he nodded repeatedly to her. "Don't worry, I will help you, Big Sis. So which herbs do you want to pick? I will help you pick them, but you have to tell me the correct way to do it first."

"I will teach you how to harvest the herbs, so their effects will not decrease, and the results will be maximized when I use them as alchemy ingredients." Polypus happily followed behind Zhang Lingxue as he listened to her explain to him the benefits, care, and harvesting of each herb. "Are you interested in alchemy?"
Polypus nodded to Zhang Lingxue. "Big Sis, I am really interested in herbs, but I do not have the fire element, so I can't possibly learn about alchemy, right?"
"You are right about that." Zhang Lingxue then told him.

"Actually, you can still do alchemy even if you don't have the fire element, but it will be much harder for you than for humans or beasts with the fire element, especially since you have to rely on external fire to do it." After all, each herb requires a different heat intensity; some require low heat, some require medium heat, and some require intense heat.
If you're interested in alchemy, I can teach you the basics, and I will also teach you how to regulate the heat when performing alchemy."
Polypus pondered for a while before agreeing to that. "Big sis, I want to learn about alchemy, so please teach me everything about it."

Zhang Lingxue immediately took out a book about alchemy and gave it to Polypus. "While I pick the herbs I need, you can read all of the writings in this book and ask me directly if there is anything you do not understand."
"Yes, Big Sis." Polypus immediately sat on the ground and read the book seriously. He also repeatedly asked Zhang Lingxue if he found anything difficult to understand.
In the end, Zhang Lingxue decided to do alchemy in the deserted valley, so she could accompany and teach Polypus about alchemy at the same time.

In the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Zhang Fei [1]'s six partners were gathering with several others, but several of them looked surprised when they saw Yun Kexin's presence among the women, especially since she was previously Yin Tong's partner.

"All right, you guys don't need to be so curious about their relationship." Lin Dong'er shouted to Nanxuan Luoyue, Xia Bing, and Lian Chengyu. "The three of you may not know about this matter, but Yin Tong and Ni Weiwei are dead, and you should be able to guess the culprit based on Yun Kexin's presence among them."
After hearing Lin Dong'er's words, the three of them took a deep breath, and they turned to Yun Kexin, who confirmed it with a nod.

"It would be good if both of them are dead now, so our competition in disciple rank will widen." Nan Xuan Luo Yue suddenly spoke. "Moreover, Yin Tong has always been arrogant, and Ni Weiwei's arrogance is much worse than hers, so I've never liked them."

Xia Bing shook his head before speaking to his partner. "They're dead now, so you don't have to badmouth them anymore, okay? I never liked them myself, but we shouldn't waste time discussing the dead; instead, we should concentrate on our own affairs.

"Well, that's true." Nanxuan Luoyue then asked them. "Are we really going to take on a group mission with this many people? The point rewards from group missions are big, but we will only get a little bit if we split them between the twelve of us."
"Haha." Lin Dong'er laughed upon hearing that. "Hey, you're right if we only take on one mission, but we won't just take on one mission this time; we'll take on several missions at once."

Nanxuan Luoyue and the other three were surprised by this, and Du Yuan immediately explained it to them. "Fei asked us to go on an adventure to gain experience, so we will be away from the sect for a long time. That's why we have already reached an agreement with Lingshu and Dong'er to undertake multiple missions simultaneously.
We will select missions that align with our destinations, ensuring we earn significant points for everyone involved."
"Do you think Elder Min will allow us to take on multiple missions at once?" This time, it was Lian Chengyu who inquired.
"Yes." Gu Yan and the others answered him in unison.

Mu Lingshu then spoke to Lian Chengyu and the others. "You don't need to mind Elder Min; I believe that he will not forbid us from taking on multiple missions at once, especially since Zhang Fei [1] has already obtained an exception from Mistress Shen, and he himself has also left with several missions."

Lian Chengyu and the others smiled wryly after hearing that, especially since they were more senior than Zhang Fei [1], and they had joined the sect for several years, but they had never received such an exception.

"Let's go! We should go to the mission hall now! Otherwise, my father will know that I'm leaving, and he will definitely forbid me from going with you all!" After she said that, Lin Dong'er led them all to the mission hall..

Upon their arrival, they immediately selected various group and individual missions aligned with their destination, which irritated the other disciples who were interested in those missions, especially since there were not many missions left after quite a few had been canceled previously.

However, none of them dared to comment because of Lin Dong'er's presence, especially since they were afraid of her father, who was the elder of the punishment hall, and they were afraid of being punished by Lin Hao.

'Not only is that brat troublesome, but his partners and friends are also problematic.' Min Ren silently pondered over each mission they had selected, yet he acquiesced to their wishes. "Despite your numbers, you must always be careful, understand?"
"Yes, Elder Min!"
Unknowingly, two days had passed in the Sky Jade Realm.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 120 Demons]
[Reward: 12,000 Female Essences]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 3,000 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 30 green jewels.]

Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows after he read the second notification. 'Oh? The daily quest reward has changed from red to green jewels, huh? Although the change is only slight, it's not too bad, especially considering that the rewards will continue to increase.'
Meanwhile, Zefyr, who was lying on Zhang Fei's [1] shoulders, looked annoyed, especially since the people who were hunting him had not yet arrived.

Zhang Fei [1] himself also felt bored waiting for Shen Haoran's loyalists to come to him, especially since he wanted to finish all the missions he had taken as soon as possible. However, he did not want to continue being bothered by those people, so he wanted to get rid of them first before going on other missions.
After some time, Zefyr suddenly looked into the distance before floating beside Zhang Fei [1]'s head and asking him. "Do you feel that?"

"They've come." Zhange Fei [1] responded, gazing at the 10 red dots on his map, all of which were rapidly approaching him. "They are not humans but beast cultivators, and their cultivation is at the upper level of the earth realms."

"Beast cultivators, huh?" Zefyr muttered softly before floating into the air. "Since they are just ordinary beasts, you should be able to handle them on your own. However, I will help you block their escape routes, so they won't be able to escape from you."
"All right." Zhang Fei [1] then stood up and prepared to welcome the people's arrival.

A few moments later, the ten people had arrived at the location, and they immediately surrounded Zhang Fei [1]. However, before they could ask him, a green whirlwind appeared around them and trapped them inside, shocking them.
"You guys are Shen Haoran's loyalists, right?" Zhang Fei [1] inquired with narrowed eyes. "I don't understand why he wants to kill me, but he has sent you to meet your deaths."
"Braggart!" One of them shouted at Zhang Fei [1]. "Do you think you can fight us all by yourself with your cultivation at the 10-Star Core Realm?"

"You know what? Ignorant people are simply too stupid, and you guys act without using your brains." Zhang Fei [1] replied to them with a shake of his head. "Shen Haoran doesn't even know me, so he doesn't know anything about me or my abilities.
Two days ago, someone told me that you guys would come here to kill me, and that person also told me about your strengths, so I purposely waited for you all here."
"Who told you about us? Ugh!"
*Bam... Bam... Bam...*

Those people instantly fell to the ground as Zhang Fei [1] activated his bloodline power to suppress them, causing all of them to look at him in shock, and he responded to their expressions with an evil smile. "Do you all believe that I would wait for you here if I did not have the capability to kill you all?
Your cultivation is indeed higher than mine, but you guys are mere sea serpents, and my bloodline is much stronger than yours."

Just as they were thinking about Zhang Fei [1]'s beast identity, the men suddenly felt a sharp pain on their ring fingers, but their eyes widened as they saw Zefyr floating in front of Zhang Fei with their storage rings circled around her. "You can keep them, Fei."

"Thank you, Zephyr." Zhang Fei [1] immediately grabbed their storage rings and stored them in the system inventory before turning his gaze back to the men. "Do you guys still doubt that I have the ability to kill you? If you still doubt me, then I will show you my true form, so you can die without regrets."

After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately transformed into his fox form. However, his fox form had changed from its usual white color to an adult, five-tailed black fox with blood-red eyes. He had two demon horns on his head and two large black wings on his back, especially since he merged his two bloodlines, changing his form.

'Demon fox!' The people screamed in shock in their hearts as their bodies trembled intensely under the pressure of Zhang Fei [1]'s bloodline, especially when he activated his demon eyes to instill fear in them.

Unlike them, Zefyr was impressed after she learned that Zhang Fei [1] could combine both of his bloodlines, which made him look like a demon fox. 'Hehehe! If he can really reach ten-tailed, I'm sure that he will be able to surpass the previous ten-tailed fox, and he will become the strongest in this universe.'
*Tap... Tap...*
As he stared at them with his blood-red eyes, Zhang Fei [1] walked towards them while showing his sharp fangs, causing them to feel even more terrified of him.
"Ugh!" Two of them groaned in pain as Zhang Fei [1] stepped on them with his front paws, and he wrapped his four tails around the other eight before lifting them up high.

"Even though all of you are just following Shen Haoran's orders, you guys are still my enemies, and I will never spare my enemies, so you all can die now." After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately used his Essence Absorption Technique, and he absorbed their beast essences for his own benefit.
Zefyr took a deep breath as he watched the beast cultivators' bodies begin to dry up, and their skin shriveled up into a dry shell that eventually turned them into dried skeletons.

'Their beast essences aren't bad, but I still need another 100,000 to buy another advanced technique.' Zhang Fei [1] then returned to his human form and turned toward Zefyr. "Let's go; we're going to the second mission location now."

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Two Weeks Later
paragraphs: *Tap... Tap... Tap...*

"Hmm?" Shen Haoran, who was checking his son's condition, immediately turned his head towards the sound of footsteps. He then asked the middle-aged woman who had just arrived. "Why did you come here, Shen Shixi?"

"What the hell are you thinking? Why did you send ten of our men to chase after a young man?" Shen Haoran scowled in response to Shen Shixi's question, but he was shocked when she showed ten broken jades. "These are theirs, which means they are dead now."

"Impossible!" Shen Haoran immediately shouted after hearing that. "Their cultivation is at the Earth Realm, and that brat's cultivation is only at the Core Realm, so there's no way he could kill them!"

Instead, Shen Shixi let out a heavy sigh and shook his head at Shen Haoran. "It appears that your interest in Shen Xueyi has made you so stupid! You didn't even investigate Zhang Fei [1]'s background before sending our men to hunt him down, and they died in vain at his hands."
"What do you mean by that? Does a brat with cultivation in the core realm have such a big influence compared to our Shen Clan?" Shen Haoran asked with a dark face.

"Before I came here, I checked Zhang Fei [1]'s background, and he joined our sect on Liu Rong's recommendation." Her answer momentarily surprised Shen Haoran, but Shen Shixi's next words further shocked him. "For your information, he is Liu Hua's husband, and her two nieces, Chu Ying and Chu Qing, are his wives too. Do you think the Liu and Chu clans' influence is inferior to our Shen clan?

They are indeed weaker than us, but their influence in the two regions is slightly greater than that of our clan, especially since they are more active than us in public. Although I don't know for sure about his relationship with Shen Xueyi, she clearly supports him behind his back, and she even gives him some exceptions, such as taking on multiple missions at once.
Besides, I also heard that he has dual-cultivated with several elders, such as Shi Yue, Tang Rou, Xi Zihua, and even Yan Luan'er."

All of this information left Shen Haoran quite shocked, but he found it difficult to believe that a weak cultivator like Zhang Fei [1] could have a relationship with all those people. "How do you know all that?"

"Unlike you, who always think with your lower body, I always think using my brain." Shen Shixi's mockery made Shen Haoran frown even deeper. "I won't explain to you how I got all the information, especially since the walls have ears too, so I don't want Shen Xueyi and the others to know about my secret.
I've told you the truth, so it's up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but you're the one who will suffer loss if you do not believe me."

Following that, Shen Shixi swiftly departed, leaving Shen Haoran in a contemplative state. 'Even if that brat had a relationship with those two clans, their people couldn't possibly help him kill my people, especially since none of them, including Liu Qingyu, were equal to them.

As for Liu Hua, she is indeed more talented than her sister and brother, but she previously fell into Pang Hong's hands, so I believe her cultivation would not be able to rise that high. Liu Rong and Liu Ming should already be in the demon cave, making it impossible for them to protect him.'

After he pondered for some time, Shen Haoran left the medical hall and returned to the tower, and he immediately sent one of his trusted men, who was also an elder of the Shen Clan, to chase after Zhang Fei [1].
Meanwhile, Shen Xueyi and Shen Yang were standing side by side by a room's window when he asked his cousin a question. "Did you intentionally reveal all that information for Shen Shixi to know?"

"Yes." Shen Xueyi answered with a nod. "For all these years, Shen Shixi always believed that I was unaware of her actions. However, I have been closely monitoring her and those close to Shen Haoran, and I knew that he would be even more eager to kill Zhang Fei [1] once he learned about his background, so I deliberately asked Min Rean and the others not to cover up anything."

"I see." Shen Yang nodded in understanding. "Now ten of them are dead in Zhang Fei [1]'s hands, and Shen Haoran has decided to send Shen Kuo to chase him, but I'm sure he won't be a big problem for him, especially since his bloodline is higher than ours.
Anyway, Shen Hai and Shen Shou have come out of their seclusion, and the others will be out soon, but I've told them to hold back for the time being."
"That's good." Shen Xueyi then turned to Shen Yang. "I want you to chase after Shen Kuo and capture him, but you better not kill him and lock him up in that place for the time being."
"Oh?" Shen Yang was a little surprised by Shen Xueyi's request. "At first, I thought you wanted to let him die at Zhang Fei's hands [1], but you want to capture him now."

Shen Xueyi let out a soft sigh before responding to him. "Honestly, I don't know much about Zhang Fei [1]'s abilities, but he was able to kill those 10 people in a short time. That's why I think he might have a unique ability, and Shen Kuo might be useful to him, so I want you to capture him."
"All right, I'll go now."
After Shen Yang disappeared from her sight, Shen Xueyi immediately left her room and went to meet some people to discuss further plans to deal with Shen Haoran and the others.

Meanwhile, Ashreth walked into the throne room on the top floor of the black and white tower, but she was surprised because she didn't see the white Amaris there, and she only found the naked black Amaris accompanied by the fake Janette, who was also naked.
"What's the result of your investigation in Zygoz's sub-realm? Did you find anything suspicious about Feltia?" The black Amaris immediately asked Ashreth.

"I didn't find anything suspicious about Feltia, my lord." Ashreth then informed the black Amaris about everything she discovered in Zygoz's sub-realm without realizing that Oz, the second demon lord, had prepared all the information.

After hearing all that, the black Amaris raised her eyebrows for a moment, but she herself didn't seem to suspect it, especially since she couldn't possibly monitor Zygoz's sub-realm on her own. "Where is Feltia now?"
"They should be halfway to their mission location." Ashreth then asked the black Amaris. "Do you want me to catch up with them, my lord?"
"No need." The black Amaris responded by shaking her head. "Anyway, my sister and I already have a special plan for Feltia, so I want you to bring her here once she returns to this sub-realm."
The black Amaris's order surprised Ashreth, especially since Feltia's demon rank was still too low and her twin lords had never summoned a demon of such a rank to their tower.
Despite this, Ashreth did not refuse the black Amaris's command but promptly accepted it. "Yes, my lord. When they return from their mission, I'll bring Feltia to you."

Shortly after Ashreth's departure, the white Amaris appeared in the room, displaying a much more cheerful expression that immediately confused her twin sister. "Why are you so happy? Did you find something interesting?"

"Not really." The white Amaris then approached her twin sister, who had just taken off her clothes. She climbed onto his lap, wrapped her arms around her neck, and briefly kissed her. She then cast a sidelong glance at the fake Janette before complaining to the black Amaris. "You always have fun with this young dryad while I'm away, huh?
Even her demon power has decreased a lot because you keep absorbing it, so you'd better hold back for now, or she'll die, and both of us will be the ones to lose."

"Hehe." The black Amaris chuckled before kissing her twin sister, sharing the demon power she had previously absorbed from the fake Janette, which caused the white Amaris' eyes to sparkle. Soon, she separated their lips. "You don't have to be jealous anymore, right? You're my twin sister, so I certainly won't ignore you, and I will definitely share her demon power fairly with you."

The white Amaris nodded with a smile, but she also laughed in her heart at the stupidity of her twin sister, who was still oblivious to her secret. "Anyway, I saw Ashreth leave our tower earlier; did he get any information about Feltia? Does she have a suspicious background?"

"Ashreth didn't find anything suspicious about her." The black Amaris responded by shaking her head. "Anyway, I've ordered her to bring Feltia to us once she returns from her mission, and we'll immediately absorb her demon power once she's in our hands."

"That's good." The white Amaris nodded with a satisfied smile. "I believe that Feltia's demon power is much stronger than Naeth and the others, so I really can't wait to absorb it, and it will probably increase our strength quite a bit."

The black Amaris herself had the same thoughts as her twin sister, so she also couldn't wait to absorb Feltia's demon power. She then waved her hand, causing a cluster of black clouds to appear in front of them, forming a bed, on which she laid the white Amaris before beginning their intimate activities.

The white Amaris naturally did not refuse it and followed her twin sister's game, but the black Amaris did not realize that she was sending something into her body through their mouths. 'Hahaha! I'm sorry, sister. I don't want to share the status of the next demon lord with you, and they also want to get you, so I was forced to do this to you.'

Shen Kuo, who was flying toward Zhang Fei [1]'s first mission location in the Sky Jade Realm, abruptly stopped and looked at Shen Yang, who was blocking his path. "What are you doing here? Why are you blocking my path?"

"Shouldn't you already know my reason, Old Kuo?" Before Shen Kuo could react, Shen Yang had already thrown a net towards him, which instantly wrapped around his body, causing his strength to dissipate rapidly, so he struggled to break free from it. "Futile! You know that the net is made of golden silkworm thread and seals your strength, so you can never escape."

Shen Yang immediately caught Shen Kuo, who suddenly fell to the ground after his strength was sealed. "In the sect, I couldn't do anything to you, but you've fallen into my hands now. However, you shouldn't worry because my cousin doesn't want to kill you yet, especially since you're still useful to someone, so I'll take you to that place for the time being."
"You-"
Without giving Shen Kuo a chance to speak, Shen Yang knocked him unconscious and immediately took him to the place he had previously mentioned.

Nothing significant occurred after that day, but Shen Haoran's panic over Shen Kuo's disappearance led him to believe the veracity of Shen Shixi's information. In addition, he also got news from Zhiyu Fengzhi that his son, Shen Tianyu, had woken up from his abnormal condition.

However, Shen Tianyu's condition was not good, especially since his previous abnormal condition left a worse sequela for him, and his cultivation regressed by one minor stage due to the backlash of his condition, which frustrated him, especially since his cultivation had almost broken through. the Earth Realm.

Shen Tianyu's condition also affected Shen Haoran, causing him to forget his intention to hunt down Zhang Fei [1]. Instead, he focused on helping his son restore his cultivation, and he also ordered some of his loyalists to find the mastermind behind his son's misfortune as soon as possible.

Imperceptibly, another two weeks had passed in the Sky Jade Realm, and Zhang Fei was preparing to break through to the Soul Realm inside the training space. In fact, he should have broken through a week ago, but he was too focused on his training, so he postponed his breakthrough.
Even so, Zhang Fei's decision was not in vain, especially since he had been able to fully adapt to the level three gravity feature, which was eight times heavier than the outside world.
Some of his women have also managed to adapt, but some are still unable to do so, particularly due to their low cultivation and physical strength compared to the others.

Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, Shen Yu, and Boitata sat cross-legged around Zhang Fei. They prepared to help him if he faced difficulty doing so, especially since forming a cultivation soul is more difficult than forming a cultivation core.

Besides, I also heard that he has dual-cultivated with several elders, such as Shi Yue, Tang Rou, Xi Zihua, and even Yan Luan'er."
All of this information left Shen Haoran quite shocked, but he found it difficult to believe that a weak cultivator like Zhang Fei [1] could have a relationship with all those people.
"How do you know all that?"
"Unlike you, who always think with your lower body, I always think using my brain." Shen Shixi's mockery made Shen Haoran frown even deeper.
"I won't explain to you how I got all the information, especially since the walls have ears too, so I don't want Shen Xueyi and the others to know about my secret.
I've told you the truth, so it's up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but you're the one who will suffer loss if you do not believe me."

Following that, Shen Shixi swiftly departed, leaving Shen Haoran in a contemplative state. 'Even if that brat had a relationship with those two clans, their people couldn't possibly help him kill my people, especially since none of them, including Liu Qingyu, were equal to them.
As for Liu Hua, she is indeed more talented than her sister and brother, but she previously fell into Pang Hong's hands, so I believe her cultivation would not be able to rise that high.
Liu Rong and Liu Ming should already be in the demon cave, making it impossible for them to protect him.'

After he pondered for some time, Shen Haoran left the medical hall and returned to the tower, and he immediately sent one of his trusted men, who was also an elder of the Shen Clan, to chase after Zhang Fei [1].
Meanwhile, Shen Xueyi and Shen Yang were standing side by side by a room's window when he asked his cousin a question.
"Did you intentionally reveal all that information for Shen Shixi to know?"
"Yes." Shen Xueyi answered with a nod.
"For all these years, Shen Shixi always believed that I was unaware of her actions.

However, I have been closely monitoring her and those close to Shen Haoran, and I knew that he would be even more eager to kill Zhang Fei [1] once he learned about his background, so I deliberately asked Min Rean and the others not to cover up anything."
"I see." Shen Yang nodded in understanding.

"Now ten of them are dead in Zhang Fei [1]'s hands, and Shen Haoran has decided to send Shen Kuo to chase him, but I'm sure he won't be a big problem for him, especially since his bloodline is higher than ours.
Anyway, Shen Hai and Shen Shou have come out of their seclusion, and the others will be out soon, but I've told them to hold back for the time being."
"That's good." Shen Xueyi then turned to Shen Yang.
"I want you to chase after Shen Kuo and capture him, but you better not kill him and lock him up in that place for the time being."
"Oh?" Shen Yang was a little surprised by Shen Xueyi's request.
"At first, I thought you wanted to let him die at Zhang Fei's hands [1], but you want to capture him now."
Shen Xueyi let out a soft sigh before responding to him.
"Honestly, I don't know much about Zhang Fei [1]'s abilities, but he was able to kill those 10 people in a short time.
That's why I think he might have a unique ability, and Shen Kuo might be useful to him, so I want you to capture him."
"All right, I'll go now."
After Shen Yang disappeared from her sight, Shen Xueyi immediately left her room and went to meet some people to discuss further plans to deal with Shen Haoran and the others.

Meanwhile, Ashreth walked into the throne room on the top floor of the black and white tower, but she was surprised because she didn't see the white Amaris there, and she only found the naked black Amaris accompanied by the fake Janette, who was also naked.
"What's the result of your investigation in Zygoz's sub-realm?
Did you find anything suspicious about Feltia?" The black Amaris immediately asked Ashreth.

"I didn't find anything suspicious about Feltia, my lord." Ashreth then informed the black Amaris about everything she discovered in Zygoz's sub-realm without realizing that Oz, the second demon lord, had prepared all the information.
After hearing all that, the black Amaris raised her eyebrows for a moment, but she herself didn't seem to suspect it, especially since she couldn't possibly monitor Zygoz's sub-realm on her own.
"Where is Feltia now?"
"They should be halfway to their mission location." Ashreth then asked the black Amaris.
"Do you want me to catch up with them, my lord?"
"No need." The black Amaris responded by shaking her head.
"Anyway, my sister and I already have a special plan for Feltia, so I want you to bring her here once she returns to this sub-realm."
The black Amaris's order surprised Ashreth, especially since Feltia's demon rank was still too low and her twin lords had never summoned a demon of such a rank to their tower.
Despite this, Ashreth did not refuse the black Amaris's command but promptly accepted it.
"Yes, my lord.
When they return from their mission, I'll bring Feltia to you."
Shortly after Ashreth's departure, the white Amaris appeared in the room, displaying a much more cheerful expression that immediately confused her twin sister.
"Why are you so happy?
Did you find something interesting?"
"Not really." The white Amaris then approached her twin sister, who had just taken off her clothes.
She climbed onto his lap, wrapped her arms around her neck, and briefly kissed her.
She then cast a sidelong glance at the fake Janette before complaining to the black Amaris.
"You always have fun with this young dryad while I'm away, huh?
Even her demon power has decreased a lot because you keep absorbing it, so you'd better hold back for now, or she'll die, and both of us will be the ones to lose."
"Hehe." The black Amaris chuckled before kissing her twin sister, sharing the demon power she had previously absorbed from the fake Janette, which caused the white Amaris' eyes to sparkle.
Soon, she separated their lips.
"You don't have to be jealous anymore, right?
You're my twin sister, so I certainly won't ignore you, and I will definitely share her demon power fairly with you."
The white Amaris nodded with a smile, but she also laughed in her heart at the stupidity of her twin sister, who was still oblivious to her secret.
"Anyway, I saw Ashreth leave our tower earlier; did he get any information about Feltia?
Does she have a suspicious background?"
"Ashreth didn't find anything suspicious about her." The black Amaris responded by shaking her head.
"Anyway, I've ordered her to bring Feltia to us once she returns from her mission, and we'll immediately absorb her demon power once she's in our hands."
"That's good." The white Amaris nodded with a satisfied smile.
"I believe that Feltia's demon power is much stronger than Naeth and the others, so I really can't wait to absorb it, and it will probably increase our strength quite a bit."
The black Amaris herself had the same thoughts as her twin sister, so she also couldn't wait to absorb Feltia's demon power.
She then waved her hand, causing a cluster of black clouds to appear in front of them, forming a bed, on which she laid the white Amaris before beginning their intimate activities.
The white Amaris naturally did not refuse it and followed her twin sister's game, but the black Amaris did not realize that she was sending something into her body through their mouths. 'Hahaha!
I'm sorry, sister.
I don't want to share the status of the next demon lord with you, and they also want to get you, so I was forced to do this to you.'
Shen Kuo, who was flying toward Zhang Fei [1]'s first mission location in the Sky Jade Realm, abruptly stopped and looked at Shen Yang, who was blocking his path.
"What are you doing here?
Why are you blocking my path?"

"Shouldn't you already know my reason, Old Kuo?" Before Shen Kuo could react, Shen Yang had already thrown a net towards him, which instantly wrapped around his body, causing his strength to dissipate rapidly, so he struggled to break free from it.
"Futile!
You know that the net is made of golden silkworm thread and seals your strength, so you can never escape."
Shen Yang immediately caught Shen Kuo, who suddenly fell to the ground after his strength was sealed.
"In the sect, I couldn't do anything to you, but you've fallen into my hands now.
However, you shouldn't worry because my cousin doesn't want to kill you yet, especially since you're still useful to someone, so I'll take you to that place for the time being."
"You-"
Without giving Shen Kuo a chance to speak, Shen Yang knocked him unconscious and immediately took him to the place he had previously mentioned.
Nothing significant occurred after that day, but Shen Haoran's panic over Shen Kuo's disappearance led him to believe the veracity of Shen Shixi's information.
In addition, he also got news from Zhiyu Fengzhi that his son, Shen Tianyu, had woken up from his abnormal condition.

However, Shen Tianyu's condition was not good, especially since his previous abnormal condition left a worse sequela for him, and his cultivation regressed by one minor stage due to the backlash of his condition, which frustrated him, especially since his cultivation had almost broken through. the Earth Realm.
Shen Tianyu's condition also affected Shen Haoran, causing him to forget his intention to hunt down Zhang Fei [1].
Instead, he focused on helping his son restore his cultivation, and he also ordered some of his loyalists to find the mastermind behind his son's misfortune as soon as possible.
Imperceptibly, another two weeks had passed in the Sky Jade Realm, and Zhang Fei was preparing to break through to the Soul Realm inside the training space.
In fact, he should have broken through a week ago, but he was too focused on his training, so he postponed his breakthrough.
Even so, Zhang Fei's decision was not in vain, especially since he had been able to fully adapt to the level three gravity feature, which was eight times heavier than the outside world.
Some of his women have also managed to adapt, but some are still unable to do so, particularly due to their low cultivation and physical strength compared to the others.
Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, Shen Yu, and Boitata sat cross-legged around Zhang Fei.
They prepared to help him if he faced difficulty doing so, especially since forming a cultivation soul is more difficult than forming a cultivation core.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: The Soul Realm
paragraphs: "Anyway, what do you guys think about Zhang Fei's breakthrough this time?" The Liu Sisters and Boitata immediately looked at Shen Yu. "He must form his cultivation soul in order to break through to the soul realm, but I have little doubt that he can do it. He is different from us because he has four elements and three different forms, all of which are real.

Since I am a beast myself, I have some understanding of how beasts break through, and it's not too different from humans. However, I don't know how demons break through, so I am worried that he will fail."
Upon hearing that, the three women's expressions became serious, particularly due to their lack of knowledge about how demon cultivators form their cultivation souls.

They then turned to Lillea and Janette, who were waiting in the distance, but they let out a heavy sigh, especially since the cultivation of the two female demons was still far from the soul realm, so they couldn't possibly tell them about it.
Liu Hua then looked at Zhang Fei again before speaking to them. "Although we don't know anything about the demons' breakthrough, our husband is smart enough.

When he broke through to the core realm, we didn't even teach him how to form his cultivation core, but he managed to form three cores with his own ability, and he even has four cores now, so I am sure that he will also succeed in forming his cultivation soul without any significant difficulties."
"I agree with you." Boitata replied with a nod. "However, I am curious about his cultivation soul—whether it will take the form of his human form, beast form, or demon form."
Liu Qingyu shook her head upon hearing Boitata's words. "We don't have to wonder, and we will know the result soon. Perhaps he will give us another surprise, and I can't wait to see it."

After that, the four women stayed silent and waited patiently, particularly because Zhang Fei appeared so calm, giving them confidence that he would not encounter any obstacles in forming his cultivation soul.

Zhang Chen and the other women waiting at the side of the training room also looked tense and impatient waiting for Zhang Fei's breakthrough, but they had full confidence in him and were sure that he would be able to get through everything smoothly.

Zhang Fei had sealed all his senses, making it impossible for him to hear their conversation. His mind was solely focused on adhering to Mei's instructions on how to form his cultivation soul. 'I'll do it now.'
[Master, do it slowly, lest you suffer a backlash if you fail to form your cultivation soul, and your cultivation may regress.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei then focused his mind completely to begin forming his cultivation soul, and his four cultivation cores immediately emerged from his body before encircling him, surprising Liu Hua and the others, especially since they were continuously absorbing qi from the air, which caused the four cores to glow according to their respective elements: fire, light, darkness, and wind.

After they waited for some time, they suddenly saw something that shocked them, especially since three transparent figures appeared behind Zhang Fei. One figure was of himself as a human; another figure was an adult white fox with four tails dancing behind it; and the last figure was his incubus form.

Shen Yu and the others raised their eyebrows upon seeing the three figures, and their realization of their husbands' intentions prompted them to exchange shocked glances. However, they immediately smiled, particularly because, if he truly succeeded, he would become the first cultivator to possess three cultivation souls, and his soul would be significantly stronger than that of other cultivators.
The three figures also absorbed qi from the air to solidify their forms, and their absorption rate kept increasing as time went by, making their figures more solid and much clearer in their eyes.

As the minutes passed, Boitata and the others became more and more impatient to wait for Zhang Fei to complete his breakthrough, especially since the three figures behind him were already rock solid. However, they had not felt any signs that he had broken through to the soul realm, and his cultivation was still at the 10-Star Core Realm, which made them feel strange about it.
What followed left them even more perplexed, particularly with Zhang Fei's fox and incubus figures, which started to merge with his human form and eventually merged completely.

The merged form of Zhang Fei's three souls left them in a state of shock, particularly as his soul retained a human appearance. However, his hands and feet changed into fox claws, and white fur adorned his body, giving him a demihuman appearance. Furthermore, he had two black horns on his head, as well as two fairly large black wings on his back.
However, his tails were a bit strange to them, especially since his tails were incubus tails, but he had four tails like his fox form.
*Swoosh*
Zhang Fei suddenly released a powerful qi wave that swept across the entire training space, and a notification instantly appeared in his mind.
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to 1 Star Soul Realm.]

Liu Hua and the others finally felt a sense of relief as Zhang Fei successfully entered the soul realm, and his four cultivation cores returned to his body. However, they were once again shocked when his soul split into three, aligning with his three forms, and all three immediately entered his body, signifying the completion of his breakthrough.

After that, Zhang Fei released the seal on his senses before opening his eyes with a sigh of relief, and he looked at the four women around him with a satisfied smile. "Finally, I reached the soul realm, but this is not over yet, and I have to reach the earth realm as soon as possible."

Hearing Zhang Fei's words, Liu Qingyu and the others were taken aback, particularly because of his remarkable cultivation progress. He was able to reach the soul realm in less than two months, a feat that other cultivators would never achieve.

However, he was still not satisfied with that, and he set a higher target straight away, but they themselves realized that they were no different from him, and they immediately thought about the next major stage every time they finished a breakthrough.

Liu Hua then spoke to her husband. "I understand your desire to become stronger, but you have to stabilize your cultivation souls first, especially since you are the only cultivator with three cultivation souls, and it will be difficult for you to stabilize all three at the same time. That's why you have to stabilize them one by one, and you also have to continue to strengthen each of your souls."

"Yes, you're right about that, and I've been planning it as well. For the time being, we'll stay inside here to continue our training, and I'll also assist you all with my yang qi while I stabilize my three souls." Zhang Fei then clenched both his fists. .net

"The difference between the core realm and the soul realm is quite significant, and I should be able to fight against cultivators who are in the middle stages of the soul realm now. Regrettably, my body technique has not yet advanced to the third stage, and I may need to advance to the earth realm first for that to happen."

"It's okay, Fei. Don't rush things—it could harm you if something undesirable happens." Zhang Fei immediately turned to Shen Yu and nodded to her, and she then told him. "We have been here for three weeks, and my wedding with Shen Tianyu is in two weeks, so I must return before then."

"Two weeks, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "In that case, we should continue our training now, and we will get rid of Shen Haoran and Shen Tianyu at that time. Furthermore, my clone has already eliminated ten of their loyalists, and your mother has also made preparations to eliminate them.
However, it would be better if your grandmother and great-grandmother joined us, so our chances of getting rid of them once for all will be greater."

Shen Yu nodded in agreement. "Since my mother has already planned some things for them, I believe that her loyal followers must have come out of their seclusion by now. As for my grandmother and great-grandmother, they must also have prepared for that day, so we will attack them directly on my wedding day with Shen Tianyu."

"Hehehe." Boitata suddenly laughed and hugged Zhang Fei. "You still have me, husband. I will assist you in fighting those sea serpents, and if they dare to oppose your marriage to Yu'er, I will devour them all alive.
"Count me in, Fei'er." Liu Hua said to him. "I will go to the Liu Clan, and I will bring people from my clan to help you."
'Hey, Mei! Buy another teleportation device.'
[Yes.]
{You got Teleportation Device x1}
{10,000,000 has been deducted from your balance}

Zhang Fei then took the item from the system inventory before handing it to Liu Hua, and he explained its function to her, making Liu Qingyu and the Chu Sisters also feel excited about it, especially since they could travel back and forth between the two clans easily if they used it.
"However, you don't have to go there by yourself, Hua'er.

I will use my other abilities to send you to the Yin-Yang Pavilion later, so you can arrive directly in the southern region, but we will do so after we get out of our seclusion." Liu Hua nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei, and she gave one part of the teleportation device to Liu Qingyu, so she could place it in the Chu Clan, and she would place the other one in the Liu Clan later.
"Let's continue our training, and we will go out in a week."
"Yes!"

While Zhang Fei and the others continued their seclusion, his second clone, Feltia, was busy fighting with many beasts, especially since she had a daily quest to kill 180 demon beasts. However, three other demons—Fyr, Leora, and Eve—assisted Feltia in her fight.

As for Tessa, she still did not like Feltia, so she felt too lazy to help her. Additionally, they were not far from their location, so she decided to move there first, leaving the four of them behind.
[You have killed 180 demons, with 0 remaining.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 180 Demons.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 18,000 female essences are added to the balance.]
"Phew." Feltia let out a sigh of relief after the quest ended, and she immediately collected all the demon cores lying on the ground before storing them in the system inventory.
[You obtained 80 normal demon cores.]

Feltia let out a soft sigh at the notification, especially since not all the beasts she killed had demon cores, and she immediately opened her map to search for Tessa's location. Instantly, a faint smile appeared on her face once she found her, especially since there was a large red dot on her destination. 'Oh? A lava behemoth, and its demon rank is at Earl Rank. Hey! This is my chance!

I'm sure that demon beast will do something to her, but I hope she doesn't die by its hands, or I will lose a source of female essence.' "Do you guys want to continue our journey right now? After all, that faun has already left earlier, and she might be in danger if she's alone there."
"Tch! Let her be!" Leora said it in an angry tone. "We were busy fighting these beasts, but she just left us, so I don't care about her anymore."

Eve nodded in agreement with Leora before answering Feltia. "I know that she doesn't like you, but she shouldn't have acted unprofessionally like that, especially since we're a team. That's why I want to teach her a lesson for leaving us behind, and I hope she can change after that."

"Let's find a place to rest first, especially since the beasts we fought earlier were too many." Fyr then hugged Feltia's arm while winking at her. "Since Tessa isn't with us right now, this is our chance to have some fun, right?"
"Haha." Upon hearing that, Feltia laughed and hugged Fyr's waist before posing a question to the other two female demons. "Do you both want to have fun with us?"
Leora responded to Feltia's question by jumping onto her back before nibbling her ear. "Naturally, I also want to have fun with you, and you have to help me with your succubi abilities, okay?"

"We've been through a lot together this week, and the effects of your succubi abilities have made me very satisfied." Eve said this as she hugged Feltia's left arm. "Moreover, I'm also feeling lonely right now, so I also want to use them on me again."
"All right, we'll do it later." Feltia then pointed towards the distance. "I found a safe place there, so we'll go there now."

paragraphs: Inside a palace built of hot rocks and surrounded by scorching lava, a male with a serious and fierce look sat on his throne. His right hand held a huge double-edged axe, and his black eyes watched the four resting demons in another area through a flame mirror.

"You guessed wrong about Feltia's dream; she is just like us, not interested in becoming the next demon lord, and her dream is much bigger than that." Oz's answer actually made Aries look confused.

paragraphs: "What do you want from me, succubus?" The lava demon asked her, but its body couldn't stop trembling under the pressure of Feltia's bloodline and demon eyes. After all, a demon beast was still a beast, so her heavenly fox bloodline had a very significant impact on it.

Feltia shook her head at the lava behemoth, then summoned the demon extermination sword and pointed it at the demon beast directly. "I don't need anything from you; I only want those fire demon flowers on your head to complete our mission. That's why you should let my friend pick them; otherwise, I'll chop your body into pieces. You shouldn't doubt my words, especially since my sword is truly sharp."

The lava behemoth did not respond to Feltia's words as its eyes were only fixed on the demon extermination sword, and it could feel something unusual from the sword, which put it at a crossroads, especially since whichever path it chose would lead it into death. 'What should I do now? If I don't hand these flowers to this succubus, she will definitely kill me.
If I hand them to her, then Lord Aries will also kill me for not being able to protect them.'

Seeing the lava behemoth continue to hesitate, Feltia looked up into the air at Eve, who immediately flew towards the demon beast before reaching for those fire demon flowers and picking them all at once.
*Roar*
Once it noticed Eve's actions, the lava behemoth instantly let out a loud roar, and it looked up at her before shooting lava from its mouth, causing her to panic.

However, Feltia immediately moved in front of the lava, cutting it in half with her demon extermination sword. She then slashed her sword towards the lava behemoth, causing a white crescent sword qi to shoot out of it. Her attack directly hit the demon beast's chest, leaving a fairly deep slash wound.
*Roar*

Once again, the lava behemoth let out a loud roar, but it was filled with immense pain, especially since Feltia used her light element to attack it. Despite this, she still held herself back, given that Aries had purposefully placed the beast in that area to protect those flowers, and she wished to avoid any confrontation with one of the twelve rulers.
'Damn it! How could such a weak attack cause me so much pain?' The lava behemoth wondered as it looked down on its chest.

Feltia then aimed the demon extermination sword at the lava behemoth once more, and she used her bloodline to further suppress the demon beast, her blood-red eyes glowing brightly. "Trust me; I am not a patient person, and I have been holding back from killing you. However, I will really kill you if you dare to attack my friend again, so you better stop your foolish action."
"You-"
*Bam*

Before the lava behemoth could finish speaking, a huge double-edged axe slammed into the ground between them and stuck itself there, causing a strong tremor in the area, and the demon beast immediately cowered in fear once it realized that its lord had arrived.

Feltia raised her eyebrows momentarily, noting that the system did not warn her of the presence of a powerful demon as it usually did, and whispered to Eve behind her. 'Leave now! Aries is here, and you are no match for him.'
'But-'

'Leave! Take Fyr and Leora with you! Otherwise, you guys will be a burden to me!' Feltia abruptly interrupted Eve as she looked at her map. She saw Aries flying towards them quickly, but she frowned when she saw Oz's name next to it. 'Tch! That old demon must have brought him here.'

'Be careful!' Eve swiftly swooped towards Fyr and Leora, swiftly escorting the two female demons away from the area while enlightening them about Aries' arrival, causing the two to become extremely worried about Feltia's condition.

On the other hand, Tessa's expression while still in Lava Prison also became horrified after she saw the huge double-edged axe, and her body trembled even more violently as her mouth continuously uttered incoherent words.
*Bam*

A loud explosion was heard in the place as Aries landed there, and he looked at Feltia, or more precisely, at the demon extermination sword in her hand with a serious look, especially after he saw her previous attack, which he recognized as the power of light. "Go back to your place."

Aries's words surprised the lava behemoth, which had assumed he was about to kill it, but instead he asked it to leave. Wasting no time, the demon beast immediately burrowed into the ground again before hurriedly leaving the area, especially since its lord's expression was so serious, and it didn't want to die because it lingered there.

"No." Aries responded with a shake of his head. "This succubus is totally different from the others, but I didn't expect her to have the power of light, and you didn't tell me about it before. Doesn't this mean he's the second demon who has it besides Virgil?"
"Haha." Oz laughed at Aries's question. "Feltia is not the second demon to possess the power of light, but she is the third to possess it."
"The third?" After hearing Oz's answer, Aries frowned, especially since he knew that only Virgil the Virgo had the power of light. "Who is the second demon to have it?"

"The white Amaris." Aries' expression turned ludicrous upon hearing the name, especially considering that he and the other rulers had been unaware of it for thousands of years. However, I've been closely monitoring all of you, and it was by accident that I discovered this information.
