"I see." Aries nodded in understanding and didn't doubt Oz's words one bit, especially since he had always been like that, and none of them could stop him from watching them. He then glanced back at Feltia and asked her a question. "Where did you get your light power, little girl?"

'Little girl, your ass! I'm a grown man, you know?' Feltia grumbled in her heart, and she immediately shrugged at Aries. "Although you are one of this realm's rulers and that old man's friend, I have no obligation to explain my abilities to you."
"Haha!" Oz laughed as he patted Aries on the shoulder.

Aries' lips twitched before he pulled his axe out of the ground and spoke to Feltia. "Normally, if other demons spoke to me like that, I would crush them mercilessly. However, you are different from them, and this old man will definitely prevent me from killing you, so I will let it slide."

"Even if that old man didn't stop you, you still wouldn't be able to kill me." Aries narrowed his eyes at Feltia after she said that. "Since you have no other business with me, I will take my leave now, as I must return to the Amaris Twin's sub-realm."

"Wait!" Aries promptly stopped Feltia, causing her to frown. "This old man has already told me some things, but I haven't agreed with him yet, and I came here to confirm your strength by myself before making a decision."

"Oh?" Feltia then asked Aries. "Honestly, I don't like to show off my strength and abilities, but I know that the old man is very cunning, and I also know that you won't let me leave before I show them to you. So, what can I do to prove my strength to you?"
*Bam*
Aries hit his own chest before telling Feltia. "Simple! Attack me with your full power, and I will acknowledge your strength if you can knock me back a step."
Feltia raised her eyebrows, glanced at Oz, who immediately nodded in agreement, and then asked Aries again. "What will you give me if I push you back more than a step?"

"Aren't you overconfident with your strength?" Aries turned to ask Feltia with a frown. "I admit that you are different from other demons, but I am still one of the rulers of this realm. Even not all demon rulers can match my physical strength, let alone a demon at the viscountess rank like you."

"Hehe." Feltia chuckled at Aries's remark. "You are right that my demon rank is still not comparable to yours, but, as you stated before, I am different from other demons, which means I am also different from you and the other demon rulers. Although the other rulers cannot match your physical strength, I am confident in my strength, and I am confident that I can make you fly quite far in one punch."

"Pft! Hahahaha!" Oz burst out laughing, especially since no demons dared say such a thing to Aries, including the other demon rulers. However, he did not doubt Feltia, especially since he had witnessed some of her abilities, and she did not even cower in front of his true form.
*Bam *

Aries banged the end of his axe's handle on the ground with an expression of holding back anger because Fletia underestimated his physical strength. "Fine! "If you can really send me flying from my spot, I'll grant you three wishes."

"Hey, old man! You have listened to his words, so I want you to help me punish him if he dares to go back on his words." Aries became even more irritated by that, especially since Oz also kept laughing mockingly at him. However, Feltia's next action shocked him, and the second demon lord was facepalmed by it, especially since she transformed herself into his true form.

Even Tessa was frightened by the presence of two of the twelve rulers, but she was also stunned when she saw Feltia transform into the figure of the second demon lord, and her jaw dropped as her eyes watched her.

"What the fuck!" Aries exclaimed loudly as soon as he saw the figure of his long-lost leader. "How could you transform into another demon? Moreover, the form you are using is that of the second ruler of this realm, and he has been missing for too long, so a young demon like you should not know his figure."

"I may be young, but I know quite a lot." Feltia replied as she landed in front of Aries and clenched her right fist. "Are you ready to feel the power of my attack? If you are not ready, then you better get ready now, or you will definitely lose our bet."

'Fuck! Where did this little demon actually come from? She is so arrogant and doesn't respect me at all! Moreover, there was no hint of fear in her eyes, and she seemed to be looking down on me!' But alas, Aries knew nothing about the heavenly fox, and the fox race was indeed very arrogant by nature. "You don't have to worry about me, so you can start now.
As for my promise, I am a person who always keeps his word, and I will definitely keep my promise to you."

Feltia immediately took a fighting stance while pulling her right arm back, and she used soul-connect to borrow the power of Boitata, who had been sent into the beast space by her original body. Luckily, Aries and Oz didn't know anything about cultivators or cultivation techniques, so neither of them realized that her strength had increased drastically thanks to it. "Get ready!"

"Do it!" Activating her light element instantly, Feltia delivered a powerful punch to Aries's stomach, causing him to bend forward. The intense pain in his stomach was a result of her light element's effects, and a second later, she sent him flying from his position. "Argh!"
*Swoosh*

However, Aries immediately stabilized himself before landing on the ground; he staggered backwards before stomping his feet to the ground to stop himself, and he immediately held his stomach while screaming. "Her attack is so fucking painful, Zygoz! I've never felt this kind of pain before!"

Unlike Oz, who had already expected the outcome, Tessa's eyes widened after she witnessed it, especially since Aries' strength was equal to her twin rulers, but Feltia was able to send him flying so far with just one punch.
Feltia immediately reverted to her original form, canceled the soul-connect, and then asked Aries a question. "Do you still doubt my power now?"

"However, it would be better if you discussed this matter with Zhang Fei and Yu'er first, so that they can prepare themselves for that day."

After that, Shen Xueyi immediately left the cave and used the returning jade to return to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, while Shen Huang asked her daughter. "Are you still thinking about Zhang Fei's offer to us?"

As for Wansan, he is Yu'er's father, but he is also her uncle.

That's why I believe it doesn't matter if we dual-cultivate with Zhang Fei, as long as we can evolve into a divine beast and break through to the sovereign realm. However, we must first discuss this matter with her, and I believe she won't have any issues with it."

paragraphs: "Is that beast really a hippocampus, big brother?" Zhang Lin asked with a look of excitement.

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to his little sister. "There are four beasts left here: Jie Yuan, the golden monkey who has become Qing'er's contract beast; a wind weasel in Japan; the hippocampus, hiding at the bottom of this ocean; and the fourth is a Thunderbird, living in Amazon Forest."

"Wind weasel and thunder bird?" Once again, Zhang Fei nodded to Zhang Lin. "Are you going to catch those two, too? If I remember correctly, Big Sis Ziqin has the wind element, and Big Sis Yan has the lightning element, right? So I think those two beasts will be the right partners for them."
"Yes, I will also capture both of the beasts. However, I won't do it now because I have other matters." Zhang Fei then turned to Shen Yu. "Please help me catch the hippocampus, Yu'er."
"All right." Shen Yu immediately jumped towards the ocean, transformed into her beast form, and quickly dove towards the bottom of the ocean.
Seeing that, Zhang Lin became even more excited, and she couldn't wait for Shen Yu to bring the beast out from the bottom of the ocean as she clasped her hands together.

"Haha, you're so impatient to ride a hippocampus, huh?" Zhang Fei said as he gently rubbed Zhang Lin's head. "Anyway, I'll take you to the Hidden Sea Palace after this, especially since the disciple registration has already started, and I hope you can train better under the guidance of the Hai Twins.
Moreover, Chu Xing is also in the sect, and she will help you adapt to the environment in the sect, so I think you won't have any trouble with that."

"Yes." Zhang Lin replied with a nod before hugging Zhang Fei. "You don't have to worry about me, Big Brother. I will definitely train well in the Hidden Sea Palace, and I will also make many new friends, especially since all the disciples of that sect are women, so I will have no trouble blending in with them."

"That's good." Suddenly, Zhang Fei remembered something and asked Mei directly. 'Is there anything that Lin'er can use to accommodate the hippocampus? She will be living far away from me, so I can't possibly put the beast in my beast space, and I want the beast to always be by her side to protect her.'
[Master, that's an easy matter; I've already prepared it, so I'll buy it now.]
{Ding}
{You got Interspatial Beast Medallion x1}
{10,000,000 has been deducted from your balance}

Zhang Fei promptly took the item from the system inventory before handing it to Zhang Lin, who immediately bit her finger and dripped her blood on it. He then explained to his little sister how to use the medallion, which made her happy. "This way, you can take the beast with you, so it can protect you when I'm not by your side."

"Haha." Zhang Lin laughed softly and kissed Zhang Fei's lips directly. "Thank you, Big Brother. I won't lock the beast in this medallion, and I hope to release it into the sect so it can live freely."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with that, especially since beasts were still living creatures and needed their freedom, or they would feel stressed if they continued living in captivity.
After they waited for some time, Shen Yu finally returned to the surface, and they saw the hippocampus continuing to struggle in her mouth.
'Scan the beast, Mei.'
[Yes.]
Name: Hai Ma
Age: 250+ Years Old
Gender: Female
Race: Hippocampus
Rank: Core Beast
Cultivation: 10-Star Core Realm
Element: Water [intermediate stage]
Core: Middle-Rank Water Core
Physique: Seahorse Physique
Strong: Water, Fire
Weak: Lightning

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly after he read Hai Ma's status and muttered in his heart. 'Core rank beast with cultivation at the 10-Star Core Realm, huh? Even though it's not as powerful as a quasi-divine beast like Jie Yuan, I believe it's acceptable, especially since I can provide her with the necessary beast pills to transform into a divine beast later on.
Mei, you can buy those beast pills.'
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Beast Body Tempering Pill x1}
{100 Lower Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance}
{You got Beast Talent Pill x1}
{50 Intermediate Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance}
{You got Beast Advancement Pill x1}
{10 Advanced Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance}
Zhang Fei spoke in his heart before he brought Zhang Lin to float in front of Shen Yu, and he used his heavenly fox bloodline to apply a little pressure to the hippocampus.

Sensing that, Hai Ma immediately looked up at Zhang Fei, her body trembling even more. He then took out the three beast pills and showed them to her, and he also spoke to her through telepathy. 'I know that you have never harmed humans, but I want you to be my little sister's beast contract, so I asked my wife to bring you to me.

Anyway, we live in a realm far away from this planet, where you can continue your cultivation. Aside from that, these three pills are beneficial for a beast like you, and if you swallow them, they will strengthen you. However, I will only give them to you if you are willing to fulfill my request.'
Hai Ma seemed interested in the three pills and continued her cultivation, but she felt reluctant to become a contract beast of a human, whom she did not even know before.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before coaxing Hai Ma again. 'Don't you feel lonely staying on this planet? Since your cultivation can't improve, you will die one day, and you will die a lonely death. If you become my little sister's beast contract, I will take you with us to that realm, and you will meet many other beasts living with us there.
Moreover, we will not treat you badly, especially since I am a beast myself, and you can still live freely even if you become her contract beast.'
'Can I really still live freely in the ocean, like on this planet?' Hai Ma finally asked Zhang Fei.

After hearing that, Hai Ma fell into deep thought, but her eyes repeatedly moved between Zhang Lin and the three pills as her mind considered the pros and cons of Zhang Fei's offer. In the end, she chose to accept it, especially since she herself felt so lonely living in the Pacific Ocean alone, and all the aquatic creatures there couldn't understand her.
'All right, I agree to be her beast contract.'

"Lin'er, these are Hai Dongxin and Hai Dongyin, and they will be the ones to guide you during your stay in their sect." Zhang Fei spoke as he pushed his sister forward.
Zhang Lin immediately bowed slightly to the Hai Twins. "Elders, please take care of me."

"All right, you don't need to be like this." Hai Dongyin spoke as she lifted Zhang Lin's head. "A few weeks ago, your brother informed me that your cultivation was still at the 10-Star Foundation Realm. However, your cultivation has now advanced to the 1-Star Core Realm, and you are only 17 years old.
Although dual cultivators can improve their cultivation quickly, none of them can match the cultivation speed of the two of you, which means you are truly a genius."
"Hehe." Zhang Lin laughed softly after hearing Hai Dongyin's praise.

Hai Dongxin then gave a token to Zhang Lin, which is her identity as a disciple of the Hidden Sea Palace. "This way, you can directly become an inner disciple, and you don't need to go through a series of entrance tests, especially since you will be training directly under us.
However, we might transfer you to our big sister, but she is in the demon cave right now, so we will do it after she comes back."
"Yes, Elders." Zhang Lin then turned to Zhang Fei. "Are you going to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, big brother?"

"Yu'er has been away from her place for a month, so I'll send her back there, or those people will be suspicious of her." Zhang Fei responded, embracing Shen Yu's waist, before turning his gaze to the Hai Twins. "I leave my little sister with you two, and I hope you can help her grow faster as a cultivator."
"Don't worry, we will guide Lin'er as best as we can." The Hai Twins answered in unison and nodded.
Following that, Zhang Fei briefly kissed his little sister before escorting Shen Yu to leave the premises, and the twins promptly brought Zhang Lin into their sect.

However, the situation in the sect was very lively, especially since there were so many prospective disciples who were registering to join the sect, and their internal competition had not finished yet.

The Hai Twins then took Zhang Lin to look around the area inside the sect, including the training area used for their competition. There, she saw Chu Xing fighting with a female disciple who was slightly older than her.

Zhang Lin could see that Chu Xing had the upper hand over her senior, especially since she had already had a hard time practicing at two times gravity some time ago. Although she still couldn't fully adapt, it had helped her a lot in surpassing her opponent's speed.
In the end, Chu Xing managed to win their fight, and she jumped up and down in celebration, but her opponent looked disappointed by her defeat.
Chu Xing suddenly looked at the three women, and she immediately waved her hands while shouting. "Lin'er! I've been waiting for you for so long! You've finally joined the sect!"

After hearing that, the other disciples glanced at the three women, but the senior disciples were genuinely taken aback by Zhang Lin's cultivation, which was already so high despite her youthful appearance.

Chu Xing immediately floated and landed in front of them, grabbing Zhang Lin's hand before introducing her to her sect sisters. "Her name is Zhang Lin, and she is my sister-in-law, so I hope you all don't harass her, okay?"

"Which of your sisters is married, Xing'er?" A female disciple in her early thirties, with long blue hair, asked in disbelief, particularly because she knew Chu Ying and Chu Qing well but had never heard of their marriage.
The woman has quite an alluring face with wide black eyes, and her curvaceous body is perfectly wrapped in their sect uniform, combined with DD-Cup breasts and plump buttocks.
"Haha." Chu Xing laughed upon hearing that. "Senior Sister Yue Lanxin! Big Sis Ying and Qing'er have already married, and they are married to Lin'er's big brother."

"What?" Not only Yue Lanxin screamed in shock after hearing that, but several other disciples also did the same. After all, the Chu Clan was one of the major clans in the western region, but two out of three of their descendants were married to the same man, which they thought was simply ridiculous.

"You guys have never met Zhang Fei, so you must be shocked by that." They immediately turned to Wei Luan, who was standing behind them. "I met him a few weeks ago, and he is indeed an extraordinary cultivator, so you don't need to be surprised about their relationship. Moreover, he was the one who exposed You Han's affair with my ex-fiancé, or I will definitely suffer."

Yue Lanxin and the others let out a heavy sigh after hearing that, and they tried to comfort Wei Luan. On the other hand, Chu Xing immediately pulled Zhang Lin away with her, and she took her sister-in-law to go find her new residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Turning Lan Zhen
paragraphs: While Chu Xing was introducing Zhang Lin to the Hidden Sea Palace environment, Zhang Fei and Shen Yu had already arrived near the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but he did not immediately bring her into the sect.

After pondering for a long time, Zhang Fei decided to try something. He immediately used his invisibility before touching Shen Yu's hand, but nothing happened. To their surprise, his ability affected her as soon as he held her hand, and she also entered the invisible state just like him.

"Wow! Your ability is really amazing, Fei!" Shen Yu exclaimed in admiration. "I thought you could enter anywhere in this realm with this ability, except for the rooms equipped with strong defensive formations."
"Yeah, you're right about that.

That's why I thought about learning about formation arrays, so I can infiltrate such rooms, but I don't have any acquaintances who understand formation arrays, so I have to wait to meet the right person." Shen Yu agreed with Zhang Fei's desire to study the field, but she herself did not have any acquaintances with the formation array master, so she could not give him a recommendation.
"This is the first time I've tested it, and my guess turned out to be right. However, it doesn't work if I just touch you, and I have to hold you like this in order to work on you."

"Well? No technique is perfect, and they have their own advantages and disadvantages. Furthermore, the effect is already good, so I don't see any issues. Anyway, I'll contact my mother now and ask her to meet us in my seclusion room." Zhang Fei agreed to that, so Shen Yu immediately contacted Shen Xueyi.

Zhang Fei then led Shen Yu into the Yin-Yang Pavilion, where he was irritated to see various red ornaments, such as lanterns, set up in various locations in preparation for Shen Yu's marriage to Shen Tianyu.

Upon their arrival at the tower, Zhang Fei immediately took Shen Yu to the lowest floor, but the two old men guarding outside did not notice their presence. Even after she waved her hand in front of their faces, they still did not react to it, so she took him inside and waited for her mother to arrive.
A few minutes later, Shen Xueyi hurriedly ran from upstairs, confusing the two old men, which prompted Shen Yang to question her. "What happened, Cousin? Why are you in such a hurry?"
"You two didn't notice, huh?" Shen Xueyi's response actually caused further confusion for Shen Yang and Shen Hao, but she didn't provide any explanation before entering the room.

Shen Yang and Shen Hao exchanged confused glances before following Shen Xueyi into the room, but they instantly froze at their spot when Zhang Fei and Shen Yu suddenly appeared in front of them, especially since they hadn't noticed their arrival.
"Hmm?" Shen Xueyi immediately took a serious look at her daughter's body after sensing her cultivation. "Is your cultivation approaching the 2-Star Earth Realm, Yu'er?"

"Yes, Mother." Shen Yu replied with a nod. "I'll probably break through to the 2-Star in two weeks if I continue to stay with Zhang Fei. Moreover, after entering seclusion with him for a month, not only my cultivation but also my strength and speed have significantly increased.
"Oh?" Shen Xueyi and the two old men were surprised to see the confident smile on Shen Yu's face.
Shen Yu then turned to look at Zhang Fei, who was reading the status of the two old men on his system. "Can I show them the results of my training, Fei?"
"Sure."

After Zhang Fei gave his consent, Shen Yu swiftly sprinted around the area without using her cultivation, leaving the three of them stunned, particularly due to her exceptionally fast speed. Moreover, her body looked so light, and her feet seemed to not touch the ground when she ran.

They were even more shocked when Shen Yu used her cultivation to increase her speed, causing their eyes to become unable to follow his movements, indicating that her speed had exceeded their ability to see.
Soon, Shen Yu returned to their front again, and he smiled amusedly at their reactions. "How about my speed, mother and uncles?"
"Unbelievable!" The three of them exclaimed loudly. Experience new stories with m v|-

Shen Yang then said to her. "Little niece, your cultivation is still in the 1-Star Earth Realm, but your speed has already surpassed the three of us who are in the Heaven Realm, and our eyes can't even follow your movements."

"Old Yang is right, Little Yu'er." Shen Hao said it, nodding in agreement. "Not just my eyes, but even my senses can't lock onto you, especially since your speed is so fast. If I think about it again, your speed has even surpassed that of your grandmother and great-grandmother, which means you are the fastest cultivator in our shen clan."

"Hehe." Shen Yu chuckled and hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "My training results are because of him, Uncle Yang and Uncle Hao. If he didn't bring me to his private training ground, then I wouldn't be able to move this fast."
"What about you, Zhang Fei? Is your speed also on par with Little Yu'er?" Shen Hao asked while looking at him.

Zhang Fei simply smiled and used his teleportation ability repeatedly, causing the two old men's jaws to drop, but he did not do so for long. "Actually, I still have another movement technique, but I can't use it in such a narrow space, and I can only use it in open spaces."
Both old men nodded in understanding, and Shen Yang then turned to Shen Xueyi. "So we can start moving, right, cousin?"

"Yes." Shen Xueyi then issued the order to the two men. "Now that Yu'er has returned, you two no longer need to guard this place. Instead, meet up with the others to prepare. As we originally planned, my mother and grandmother will return two days before the wedding day, and we will move to eliminate Shen Haoran and the others at that time."
"All right."

After the two old men left them, Zhang Fei then asked Shen Xueyi. "In any case, could you please hand Lan Zhen over to me? Since she tried to use the heart-controlling gas on me before, I have to do something about her. Moreover, you don't need to worry about the Lan Clan, as they won't know what will happen to her, and she might be useful to Yu'er."
"What do you want to do about Lan Zhen?" Shen Xueyi inquired with a frown.
Instead, Zhang Fei smiled mysteriously as he replied casually. "Bring Lan Zhen here first, and you'll find out later."
Shen Xueyi let out a soft sigh at Zhang Fei's answer, but she immediately contacted Lin Hao and asked him to bring the woman to them.

Some time later, Lin Hao had arrived at the place with Lan Zhen, but she trembled in fear as soon as she saw the evil smile on Zhang Fei's face. 'Shit! Why did they bring me here? What are they going to do to me?'

"You can leave, Elder Lin." Lin Hao nodded to her and immediately left the room, while Shen Xueyi immediately waved her hand to seal the room and prevent anyone from entering, particularly because she was certain Zhang Fei would do something unusual to Lan Zhen.

Zhang Fei himself immediately moved and knocked Lan Zhen unconscious, and he then took out the science capsule, which shocked the Shen mother and daughter after seeing such a device for the first time.

Zhang Fei didn't provide a direct explanation; instead, he placed Lan Zhen directly into the capsule, which piqued the curiosity of the two women about his motive for taking out such a device and placing her there.
{Ding}
{A human detected}
{Please insert the beast cores into the ten available holes.}
[Have you decided which beast core you want to use on Lan Zhen, Master?]
Zhang Fei didn't respond to Mei's question directly, and his eyes scanned every name of the beast cores listed in the system, but he felt confused about which one was suitable to use on Lan Zhen.

Since Zhang Fei still couldn't make up his mind, Mei then suggested it to him. [In my opinion, Master, since Lan Zhen possesses the Ice Element, you could use Frost Lynx, Ice Spider, or Snow Ape Beast cores.]
'En, you are right, Mei.' Zhang Fei then turned to Shen Yu and asked her. "Yu'er, which beast do you think is better? Frost Lynx, Ice Spider, or Snow Ape?"

Shen Yu herself felt confused by that, so she then turned to her mother, and Shen Xueyi immediately answered Zhang Fei. "Ice Spider and Snow Ape are earth-rank beasts, and Frost Lynx are heaven-rank beasts, so I think Frost Lynx is the best."

"Alright then." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement before taking ten advanced-grade beast cores from the system inventory, all of which were Frost Lynx Beast cores, and he inserted all of them into the ten holes in the capsule afterward.
{Ding}
{10 Frost Lynx Beast Cores detected.}
{Do you want to start the mutation process?}
'Yes!' Zhang Fei answered without hesitation.
{Ding}
{The mutation process begins.}

After that, the capsule's interior brightened, and the mutation process had already begun. The capsule's anesthesia and cooling systems ensured Lan Zhen would not experience any pain during the process.
Zhang Fei sighed softly and said to them. "Now we just need to wait for the process to finish."
"Please explain the truth to us, Zhang Fei. What exactly is the equipment used for? What kind of process is Lan Zhen undergoing?" Shen Xueyi really couldn't contain her curiosity any longer.
Shen Yu nodded in agreement with Shen Xueyi, as she herself was also curious about the function of the capsule, especially since Zhang Fei used the frost lynx beast cores in the capsule.

Zhang Fei pulled Shen Yu into his arms before explaining the situation to them, but he didn't tell them the truth. "Actually, this capsule is one of the pieces of equipment from my home realm, and its function is to turn humans into other beings, so-"
"What!?" Both women instantly exclaimed in shock.
Shen Xueyi then stuttered. "You... you want to turn Lan Zhen into another being?"
"Don't tell me that you want to turn Lan Zhen into a Frost Lynx, Fei?" Shen Yu asked in shock.

Zhang Fei answered them with a nonchalant nod. "She is an evil woman, and her clan is also a vassal of the Pang Clan, so I don't need to have any mercy on her, right? Regardless, once she transforms into a Frost Lynx, she will lose all memories of her past, so you guys don't need to worry about her."

Zhang Fei's answer made Shen Yu and Shen Xueyi take a deep breath, and they felt that he was too cruel in his intention to turn Lan Zhen from a human into a beast. Even so, they did not deny that she was indeed evil, but they thought it would be better if he killed her directly.

Zhang Fei himself was not surprised by the two women's reactions, but he did not say anything further and focused on checking everyone in the tower, and he found Shen Tianyu having fun with Shen Shixi in his room. 'You can have fun now, especially since you will die next week, and Yu'er will be completely mine by then.'
After they waited for a few hours, the capsule finally stopped operating, and the light that had previously enveloped it immediately disappeared.
{Ding}
{The mutation process is complete.}
{All of Frost Lynx's vital signs are stable.}
{The wake-up process is complete.}
*Swoosh*
Zhang Fei quickly opened the capsule's glass cover, revealing an adult blue Lynx standing on top, staring at him and the four women in confusion.
"Lan Zhen really turned into a Frost Lynx." Shen Xueyi muttered to herself, her gaze fixed on the beast in front of her with an expression of disbelief; even Shen Yu was shocked to see it.
Zhang Fei walked over to the frost lynx and observed her body. 'Scan her, Mei.'
[Status]
Name: Lan Zhen
Gender: Female
Age: 25 years old
Race: Lynx
Rank: Heaven Rank
Cultivation: 2-Star Core Formation Realm
Element: Ice [intermediate stage]
Core: Middle-Rank Ice Core
Physique: Lynx Physique
Abilities: Ice Breath, Ice Spike, Ice Doppelganger
Strong: Ice, Water
Weak: Lightning
'This is good. Zhang Fei nodded in satisfaction after reading Lan Zhen's status. 'Buy the beast pills, Mei.'

{You got Beast Talent Pill x1}

"Since the Du Clan is a vassal of the Pang Clan, then I will use Du Ruhui to destroy his own clan from within, so we don't have to bother and waste our time taking care of them."

Shen Xueyi agreed with that and nodded. "I think that's a viable solution for dealing with the Du Clan, but there are still the Cai and You Clans, who are also vassals of the Pang Clan. However, I am not worried about those two minor clans, especially since we can easily deal with them."

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Shen Xueyi. "Although the Cai Clan is the in-law of the Chang Clan, my mother-in-law has already informed Chang Wuhen about the clan's involvement with the Pang Clan, so I am confident that she will not prevent us from destroying that clan. However, we don't need to take care of them now, and we will focus on getting rid of Shen Haoran and the others first.
After settling everything, we will launch secret attacks on the two clans, ensuring no disturbances in this region."
"Do you want to see Du Ruhui now?"
"The sooner the better."
"All right, let's go now." Shen Xueyi then turned to her daughter. "Yu'er, you can stay here, and I will seal this room from the front, so Shen Tianhu can't disturb you."
"Yes, mother."

After that, they left Shen Yu's room, and Shen Xueyi sealed it from outside. She was taken aback when Zhang Fei suddenly hugged her waist, but his next action took her by surprise even more, particularly when they entered an invisible state. "Your ability is too terrifying, you know?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled and escorted Shen Xueyi away from the tower, while also asking Han Xuenai to meet him at the punishment hall.
In just a few seconds, they had arrived at the punishment hall, surprising Lin Hao, who was in charge of the place. He immediately brought them to see Du Ruhui, who was chained in the prison.
"Hmm?" Du Ruhui frowned as soon as he saw Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei smiled faintly when he saw Du Ruhui's expression. "Do you enjoy the effects of the item I gave you? Do you want to know who helped me give it to you?"
"Bastard!" Du Ruhui roared loudly after hearing Zhang Fei's questions. "If you are a man, let go of me and fight me!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly after hearing his challenge, and he then entered the prison before shattering Du Ruhui's pants, causing Shen Xueyi and Lin Hao to frown as they wondered about his purpose in doing so.

Zhang Fei then touched Du Ruhui's body and used his body modification ability, causing him to wince in pain as he felt the changes in his body. As a result, his dick shrank rapidly before disappearing completely, which left Shen Xueyi and Lin Hao flabbergasted.
Instinctively, Lin Hao immediately covered his lower body with both hands, and his body trembled as he imagined Zhang Fei doing that to him. 'This brat is truly absurd! How could he do such a thing?'
'Nothing about him is normal!' As she massaged her forehead, Shen Xueyi muttered in her heart.

"Look down." Zhang Fei said this to Du Ruhui, who immediately looked down and was completely shocked to see that his dick was missing. "Can a man who doesn't have a dick be considered a man? So why should I bother to let go and fight with a sissy like you?"
*Clang... Clang...*
As he tried to move his hands and feet to attack Zhang Fei, Du Ruhui shouted at him loudly. "Bastard! Return me to my original condition!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei responded to Du Ruhui with a hearty laugh. "Hey! You've fallen into our hands, so you don't have to worry about your dick. Instead, it would be better if you worried about the fate of your clan because I'm going to do something to you soon, and you will help me destroy your clan with your own hands."
Du Ruhui's face turned pale after hearing that, but he then looked at Han Xuenai, who had just arrived there, and he finally realized that it was his partner who helped Zhang Fei do all that to him.

"You must have realized that, right?" Zhang Fei inquired as he pulled Han Xuenai in front of him and groped her front body, causing her to moan, especially when he squeezed her breasts. "This woman is now my slave, so don't be surprised if she assists me.
Moreover, you will also receive a similar fate to her, and you will destroy your clan with full awareness, so you can enjoy the death of your family before you die."

'This guy is truly the embodiment of the devil! Even crueler than the demons who invaded this realm in the past.' Shen Xueyi and Lin Hao muttered in their hearts as they continued to look at Zhang Fei's back.
"Bastard!" Du Ruhui screamed in anger and shook his body when he touched him, but Zhang Fei immediately pressed him against the wall and used his demon slave mark. "No! Stop! Don't do this to me!"
"It's too late." Zhang Fei spoke as he pulled back his hand. "Your clan's decision to join the Pang Clan has sealed your fate, and you will all soon vanish from this region."
Zhang Fei then turned to Lin Hao, who immediately moved to release the prisoner, causing Du Ruhui to fall to the ground.
However, Du Ruhui immediately tried to attack Zhang Fei, but his actions caused him to experience excruciating pain instead, which was the effect of his demon slave mark. "Argh!"
"Where did you learn your slave technique from?" Shen Xueyi asked Zhang Fei as she stood beside him.

In response, Zhang Fei shook his head at Shen Xueyi. "It's my secret, so I won't tell it to anyone else. You don't have to worry about it; I'll only use it on evildoers who want to hurt me or my loved ones."
"Then what about this woman?" Shen Xueyi asked while pointing at Han Xuenai.

"This woman is his partner, and she is also familiar with the Du Clan; therefore, she will report us to that clan if I don't control her." Shen Xueyi and Lin Hao nodded in agreement with his answer, and Zhang Fei then crouched down in front of Du Ruhui before helping him stop his pain. "Your life is in my hands now, and I can kill you whenever I want.
However, I will not give you an easy death, and I will torture you cruelly for some time before killing you, so you better think twice if you want to fight me."

After that, Zhang Fei took out some pills and gave them to Du Ruhui, instructing him to perform certain tasks on his behalf. "I got these pills from Pang Hong and Pang Gui, so I want you to use them on your clan members, as well as taste them yourself."

Although he did not want to do it, Du Ruhui was powerless to refuse Zhang Fei's order due to the effects of his demon slave mark on his soul. After he stood up, Lin Hao immediately released the seal on his cultivation and gave him a change of clothes.
After he finished dressing, Du Ruhui immediately left the punishment hall, but he repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei with hatred.

Zhang Fei also told Han Xuenai to go back to her place, especially since he didn't want to touch her himself and would let his clone have fun with her after he returned from the eastern region. "Now one problem is solved, and we only need to wait for the news of the destruction of the Du Clan, so we can deal with the upcoming problem."
"Don't worry, we will sort them out in a week." Suddenly, Zhang Fei hugged Shen Xueyi's waist again, making her feel embarrassed, especially since Lin Hao was still with them.
However, Lin Hao pretended not to see it and hurriedly left them. He was shocked by Zhang Fei's boldness in hugging Shen Xueyi, and he thought that she might beat him up directly.

After Lin Hao left, Zhang Fei immediately restricted Shen Xueyi's movements with his bloodline power before pressing her against the wall, which made her frustrated and panicked at the same time, especially when he held both of her hands above her head. "Let me go!"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled and spoke to Shen Xueyi. "I heard from Luan'er that you masturbate by calling my name over and over again; does that mean you do it while imagining me satisfying you?"

Shen Xueyi immediately turned her embarrassed face to the side, cursing in her heart. 'Damn it! I was too careless to let Luan'er find out! She also told this damn brat about it! Tch! I'll punish her severely later!'

"At first, I was confused about Shen Haoran's reason to send his ten loyalists to kill me, and I finally realized the reason behind his actions after I heard about the matter from Luan'er." Shen Xueyi immediately looked at Zhang Fei again with a frown. "I don't understand how you could be so careless.

You indulged yourself without putting up any protection in your room, which allowed both of them to hear you. Moreover, that old man was always attracted to you, and he heard my name from your mouth, so he sent them to kill me because of his jealousy. Fortunately, my bloodline is higher than your race, so I can kill them easily. If I didn't have my bloodline, I would have died at their hands."
Shen Xueyi let out a heavy sigh. "Sorry, my carelessness put you in danger."

"It's okay." Zhang Fei then smiled mischievously and asked Shen Xueyi again. "Does this mean you're admitting that you imagine me when you're pleasuring yourself? How about I help you satisfy your lust now? After all, Shen Wansan has left you for so long, and you must miss the pleasure of dual-cultivating, right?"

paragraphs: After they waited for some time, Ye Qianyu finally arrived at the underwater cave, and she immediately checked the protective formation that was blocking Yue Lanxin and the others from entering the deserted valley.

Despite her old age, Ye Qianyu herself had a youthful face due to her high cultivation, which was already at the 10-Star Earth Realm. Her appearance was no less attractive and sexy than that of the Hai Twins, but her body was a bit curvaceous and covered in a long blue dress.
She has beautiful ocean-blue hair and eyes; she also has a long neck and legs, nicely defined curves, and perfectly rounded breasts around E-Cup.

After examining it for some time, Ye Qianyu spoke to Yue Lanxin. "I don't know where this protective formation came from, but it is indeed powerful. It can even obstruct my senses from looking inside, so you've made the right decision not to try to break through it."

"Yes." Yue Lanxin nodded to Ye Qianyu. "I suspected that this formation had a counterattack mechanism, so I contacted you immediately. Anyway, can you dispel this formation, Elder Ye? All the herbs in the deserted valley are the main source for increasing the strength of our disciples, and we will suffer a significant loss if we can't get in there anymore."

"That's true." Ye Qianyu replied with a nod of agreement, and she observed the formation once more before trying to dispel it. However, as soon as she attempted to dispel it, it shook violently, activating the counterattack mechanisms, prompting her to immediately stop.

"I have been studying formation arrays for a long time, but I have never seen anything like this before, and the counterattack mechanism of this formation is really sensitive. Even though I only injected a little bit of my qi, it has already triggered it, and it will definitely attack me if I forcefully remove it."
"Who do you think set up this formation, Elder Ye?"

Ye Qianyu responded to Qin Xianer's question with a head shake. "As far as I can remember, no cultivator in the southern or other regions has the ability to create a formation as powerful as this one, and I think the person who created it probably came from the Central Region."
"Central region?" All three inner disciples gasped in shock.

"Yes." Ye Qianyu nodded before continuing. "The Di Clan resides in the central region, and they focus on formation arrays, so their members are the best formation array masters in our realm, especially the young master of the clan. Even the formation that sealed the demon portal was the creation of their ancestors, so you guys should already understand their mastery in that field, right?"

After hearing that, Qin Xianer and the other two female disciples nodded repeatedly, especially considering that the formation in the demon portal had protected them from the demon invaders for hundreds or thousands of years.
"So-"

Suddenly, the giant octopus, who was none other than Polypus, swam into the underwater cave, causing the three female inner disciples to feel frightened by his true form. The three immediately hid behind their senior sister.
However, Ye Qianyu acted swiftly by taking out a blue pearl and throwing it towards Polypus, which immediately expanded before enclosing him within it.

'Crap! How could these humans find this place?' Polypus inwardly screamed in panic as he used his tentacles to free himself, but Ye Qianyu's pearl artifact was too strong for him, and his efforts were in vain. 'Shit! That woman is so strong! I have to contact my big brother, or I will die in their hands.'
Ye Qianyu immediately approached Polypus and inquired. "Can you understand my words?"

After he finished contacting Zhang Fei, Polypus immediately returned to his human form before answering Ye Qianyu's question. "Yes, I can understand you, but please let me go first. I have never attacked or killed any of you humans, and I live here because it's very comfortable for me."

"No." Ye Qianyu immediately refused Polypus. "If you want me to let you go, then you have to answer a few questions of mine first. Who was responsible for setting up the formation? How did the person find this place? The people of our sect discovered this place many years ago, so it belongs to us, and we often come here to pick herbs in the valley.
But now, the formation is blocking us from entering, so I want to know the identity of that person."

"What proof do you have that your sect owns this place, Aunty?" The muscles on Ye Qianyu's forehead bulged as soon as Polypus addressed her as an aunt, but she still held herself back from attacking him. The valley's herbs are valuable, so your sect should have protected it with a formation if they owned it.

When I discovered this location a few months ago, I found no protections, nor did I encounter any members of your sect during my stay. Doesn't that mean this place is open to the public? Since no one owned this place, my big brother decided to set up a protective formation to prevent other cultivators from finding it, and my big sister also frequently visited to pick herbs."

Ye Qianyu scowled at Polypus's response, but she also recognized their sect's error in not establishing a protective formation, particularly given its large size and the challenge of creating a formation that could encompass the entire area. "Who are your big brother and big sister?"

"Aunty, I'm sure you'll be scared if you hear their names, especially my big sister's name, since she came from the central region." Polypus' answer shocked Ye Qianyu, Yue Lanxin, and the three female inner disciples. "My big brother's name is Zhang Fei, and my big sister's name is Zhang Lingxue."
"What?" Unlike the three female inner disciples, Ye Qianyu and Yue Lanxin screamed in shock upon hearing the two names, and they were naturally familiar with their names.
"Is your big brother really called Zhang Fei?" Yue Lanxin inquired as she moved beside Ye Qianyu.
Polypus was a little confused by Yue Lanxin's question, and he turned to ask her. "Do you know my big brother, big sister?"

"Yes." Yue Lanxin nodded to Polypus. "Actually, I have never met Zhang Fei in person, but two elders of my sect are familiar with him. Moreover, his little sister, Zhang Lin, is one of our sect's disciples, and she joined us yesterday."

"I see." Polypus nodded in understanding before telling them again. Since then, he has set up that protective formation, and no one can go in there without his permission, so only me and my big sister can go in now."

"Haha." Polypus laughed at Ye Qianyu's question. "Shouldn't that be obvious, Aunty? Big Sis Lingxue is one of my big brother's wives; otherwise, he wouldn't have allowed her to enter the valley, right?"

Once again, Polypus' answer shocked Ye Qianyu and Yue Lanxin, especially since the Zhang Clan was the second-strongest clan in the central region. They were really shocked to hear the truth that Zhang Lingxue was one of Zhang Fei's wives, which meant she had to share him with his other wives.

Initially, Zhang Lingxue was still training in the training space. However, after listening to Polypus' voice transmission, Zhang Fei took her out of the training space and sent her to the deserted valley using his warp portal to take care of them.

"Why are you guys looking at me like that?" Zhang Lingxue asked with a playful look as she moved to Polypus' side before freeing him from the pearl that was confining him, and the pearl immediately shrank before flying back into Ye Qianyu's hand.
Zhang Lingxue then rubbed Polypus' head. "This little guy has already told the truth to you guys, and I am indeed one of Fei'er's wives."
"Your relationship with Zhang Fei really surprised me, Lingxue." Ye Qianyu said it with a soft sigh. "Anyway, how could you arrive here so soon from the central region?"

"Hehe." Zhang Lingxue chuckled at that. "Huh?" Ye Qianyu looked at Zhang Lingxue with a look of disbelief. "Are you serious? Since when did Ye Lian have a relationship with Zhang Fei? Furthermore, she has been Gu Zhan's fiancée for a considerable amount of time.

"I see." Zhang Lingxue nodded in understanding. "It appears that Yan Huan'er has not shared the information with anyone, including you, but Gu Zhan has been dead for a long time. He died due to his own stupidity as he attacked Ye Lian, which led to my husband's contract beast swallowing him alive."
Not only was Ye Qianyu shocked by Zhang Lingxue's confession, but Yue Lanxin was also shocked after she heard it, especially since Gu Zhan was one of the best talents of her generation.

Ye Qianyu immediately contacted her sister-in-law to confirm the truth of Zhang Lingxue's words, and Yan Huan'er promptly informed her that Gu Zhan had indeed died at the hands of Boitata. Aside from that, her sister-in-law confirmed Ye Lian's relationship with Zhang Fei, but they would only get married after Ye Yuan returned from the demon cave.
"Is Gu Zhan really dead, Elder Ye?" Yue Lanxin inquired with a look of disappointment.

"Yes." Ye Qianyu then told Yue Lanxin about the news she got from Yan Huan'er, causing her to let out a heavy sigh. "Anyway, could you please ask your husband to allow us to enter the valley? The valley herbs have helped us grow our sect for years, and without them, it will decline."

"My husband doesn't like people to pry into his personal affairs, let alone if they spread his secrets, and he will definitely do something to them if that happens."

"All right, I will definitely forbid them strictly, and they won't dare to say anything to others." Ye Qianyu immediately agreed with Zhang Lingxue, especially after she remembered the Hai Twins' story about Zhang Fei's actions towards You Han.
I will discuss the situation in this valley with the Hai Twins, and since your husband wants it, we might as well forbid the disciples from coming here for everyone's good sake."

"What do you mean by that? Why would Chu Youqian want to do something to Zhang Fei? Moreover, he himself is a member of the Chu Clan, so they are relatives now." Ye Qianyu asked in confusion.

paragraphs: After waiting for several hours, Zhang Fei finally saw Chu Youqian's name in the southern river city, so he rushed to the city, where he saw her enter an inn.

After she got a room and ordered a few things, Chu Youqian rushed to the top floor to go to her room, but she didn't realize that Zhang Fei was following her using his invisibility, and he immediately snuck in as soon as she opened the door.

"Phew! The distance from my sect to this city is too far, and I'm exhausted after flying for so long." Chu Youqian muttered to herself as she took off his sect uniform, leaving only a thin cloth covering her body.
Even though he saw such a sight, Zhang Fei had no interest in Chu Youqian, especially since everything about her was too ordinary.
Chu Youqian, who was still unaware of Zhang Fei's presence, sat on the chair beside the window before taking out a paper and brush, and she wrote a letter to Shen Haoran.

Zhang Fei immediately sneaked behind Chu Youqian and read her writing, which explained his relationship with Shen Yu, and she also asked Shen Haoran to help her suppress the Hai Twins. 'What a foolish and naive woman! Did she really think that old man would help her do that? Even if she used her grandfather's status, he would not fulfill her request and would instead take advantage of her.'
After she finished writing it, Chu Youqian immediately folded the letter and sealed it with a wax seal, but she looked confused thinking about who could be ordered to deliver it to Shen Haoran.

Chu Youqian then sent a voice transmission to her acquaintances in the southern river city, but most of them were busy with their own affairs, so they rejected her. In the end, she contacted the last person she thought would not mind helping her, who immediately agreed to her request, so she asked the person to come meet her at the inn.

"Phew!" Chu Youqian let out a sigh of relief before moving to the bed and lying there, and she smiled evilly as she looked at the ceiling of her room. "Hehe! After reading my letter, I'm sure Shen Haoran will confront Zhang Fei directly, and he will kill him immediately.
Besides, I hope he will be willing to help me suppress the Hai elders, so I can do something about Zhang Lin and seize her contract beast."

Zhang Fei shook his head as he listened to Chu Youqian's words, especially since they did not know each other, so there was no enmity between them. Unfortunately, her arrogance and jealousy were too great, leading her to make the foolish decision to become his enemy, and he was determined not to spare her.
However, Zhang Fei did not immediately do anything to Chu Youqian, and he wanted to see who was willing to deliver the letter to Shen Haoran first.
*Knock... Knock...*
"Young miss, your food and drink are ready."
Hearing that, Chu Youqian jumped out of bed and opened the door for the maidservant, who immediately brought in some dishes and a pot of tea, and she immediately left the room after that.

However, Chu Youqian refrained from eating the food immediately and instead went to the bathroom to clean herself, prompting Zhang Fei to devise a plan of action against her. 'Do you have any good ideas, Mei?'
[Master, I think there are some items that will make her suffer.]
'Oh? What kind of items are those?'
[Hehe, I'll buy them now, and you'll definitely like the effects.]
{You got Ciyang Powder x1}
{5 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Tianhua Powder x1}
{5 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.} been deducted from your balance.}

'Hmm?' Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment before taking both items from the system inventory, and a strange smile appeared on his face after he read their descriptions. He then mixed the tianhua powder into the tea jug and sprinkled the ciyang powder on the bed. 'These two powders were actually useless for other purposes, but they were quite useful for making people like Chu Youqian suffer.'

A few minutes later, Chu Youqian had finished her bath and immediately dressed, anticipating the arrival of an acquaintance. Unaware of Zhang Fei's actions, she waited for the person while enjoying her dishes and tea.

Not long after, the person finally came to the room, so Chu Youqian immediately opened the door, and Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly after noticing the person's identity. 'Isn't he Wei Luan's ex-fiance?'
"Here." Chu Youqian immediately gave the letter to Ying Xiao as soon as he entered. "I don't want to go to that sect, so I want you to send this letter for me, and this will benefit both of us."
"What do you mean by both of us? Won't this only benefit you?" As he asked, Ying Xiao frowned, eager to unfold the letter.

However, Chu Youqian immediately stopped Ying Xiao and told him directly, "Do you have any idea who told Wei Luan about your affair with You Han? That person is Zhang Fei, a disciple from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and you don't need to doubt my words, especially since this news is already known to all the disciples of my sect.
Since he ruined your engagement with her, you must want to take revenge on him, right?"

"That's for sure!" Ying Xiao replied with a small shout. "I have been looking forward to my marriage with Wei Luan for so long, but that bastard ruined everything, so I must take revenge against him."

Chu Youqian smiled faintly and pressed her index finger against Ying Xiao's chest. "Actually, I have no problem with Zhang Fei, but I feel angry because Chu Xing belittled me by saying that he is better than me. Aside from that, his little sister has a beautiful contract beast, and I want to have it for myself. Unfortunately, he is very close to the Hai elders, as well as the Liu clan's son-in-law.
That's why we can't attack him openly, and we need Shen Tianyu's help to do something about him."
"Shen Tianyu?" Ying Xiao frowned upon hearing the name. "What does that lustful bastard have to do with Zhang Fei? Have you forgotten that he won't do anything without reciprocation?"

"Naturally, I know that, but I have a piece of information that will make Shen Tianyu furious, and he will definitely be willing to help us." Ying Xiao looked at her in confusion, so Chu Youqian directly told him the truth. "Zhang Fei has snatched Shen Yu from his hands, and I heard that they've been spending a lot of time together. Do you think he won't be furious if he hears this news?"

Ying Xiao was taken aback upon hearing that, especially since their wedding was only a few days away, but Shen Yu suddenly turned to another man. "You're right; Shen Tianyu will undoubtedly be furious if he learns about Shen Yu's affair, and he will certainly attack Zhang Fei directly. Moreover, his cultivation has almost reached the Earth Realm, so he should be able to kill that bastard."

"That's right." Chu Youqian responded with a nod. "However, something seems to have happened to Shen Tianyu, and I still can't contact him until this moment, so I want you to send this letter to Shen Haoran. After all, that old man has always doted on his son and would do anything for him, so I am sure that he will kill Zhang Fei immediately after hearing about this news.
That way, we don't have to bother dealing with him ourselves; we only need to wait for the news of his death."

Hearing that, Ying Xiao's expression changed slightly. "Tch! That bastard caused me to lose Wei Luan, and my father even beat me up after Wei Jiang revealed my affair with You Han. Therefore, I would be thrilled if that bastard met his demise at the hands of Shen Haoran."

"Haha." Chu Youqian laughed softly upon hearing that. "In that case, you can go to the Yin-Yang Pavilion now and give the letter to Shen Haoran, and I'm sure he won't mind pressuring the Hai elders in exchange for this information, so both of us will benefit from this matter. You can take revenge on him, and no one will stop me from snatching that beautiful beast from Zhang Lin's hands."
After hearing that, Ying Xiao nodded repeatedly. "All right, I'll go to the sect right now and meet Shen Haoran in person."

After Ying Xiao left the room, Zhang Fei decided to follow him. On the other hand, Chu Youqian immediately finished her food and drink, took off her dress, lay down on the bed, and closed her eyes with a triumphant smile. "Haha! That bastard will die, and Zhang Lin's beast will soon be mine."
Sometime later, Ying Xiao had already arrived at the outer perimeter of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and he wanted to rush there to meet Shen Haoran.

Zhang Fei, who had been following him, immediately landed in front of him. Wasting no time, he used a bit of strength to punch the unprepared Ying Xiao in the chest, causing him to fall to the ground and roll backwards a few times.

"Argh! Damn it!" As he activated his cultivation, Ying Xiao cursed, and he immediately jumped up, looking around the area. Since he was still in an invisible state, he couldn't see Zhang Fei. "Coward! Come out and face me like a man!"

"Are you really a man?" As he appeared before him, Zhang Fei asked, causing Ying Xiao to frown and raise his guard. "You don't have to be confused about me, because I am the person you and Chu Youqian are targeting."

"So you are Zhang Fei, huh?" Seeing him nod, Ying Xiao immediately took out two small spears and pointed them at him. "I didn't expect that you had been spying on me and Chu Youqian, but it's good that you appear in front of me now. This way, I can take revenge on you for ruining my marriage with Wei Luan, and I will kill you with my own hands."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed softly at Ying Xiao's words, and he smiled faintly before speaking to provoke him. "You know what? You are such a foolish man, and you don't understand that Wei Luan is much more valuable, yet you waste her for that slut, You Han. Although her body is nothing special, she is a beautiful and gentle woman, and I enjoyed our time together.

Her soft lips and breasts—I enjoyed kissing and squeezing them so much—and her moans are also melodious to my ears. Aside from that, the way she sucked my dick was truly satisfying, and she also enjoyed it a lot when I released my cum inside her mouth. In addition, her-"
"Bastard! Wei Luan is mine! You ruined everything!" Instantly, Ying Xiao's anger became uncontrollable, and he dashed towards Zhang Fei as he stabbed his small spears at him repeatedly.

Unfortunately, Ying Xiao's speed was far below that of Zhang Fei, who had trained to level three of the gravity feature, which made gravity eight times heavier, so none of his attacks could hit his body. 'Shit! What's going on? My cultivation is several minor stages above his, but I can't land a single attack on him!'

Zhang Fei casually dodged every single one of Ying Xiao's attacks, especially since all his attacks looked like slow motion in his eyes, and he continued to do so for some time, causing his enemy to look frustrated.

Zhang Fei then grabbed the two small spears before unleashing a swift knee strike onto his enemy's abdomen, which hit his target squarely, causing Ying Xiao to bend forward as his mouth vomited. "Cough... Cough..."
"Is this all you can do?" Zhang Fei then pulled Ying Xiao's hair and threw him towards a large tree nearby, where his body immediately collided with the tree.
*Bam*

"Guah!" Zhang Fei threw two small spears towards Yang Xiao before he fell to the ground. Both spears pierced his shoulders before becoming stuck in a large tree behind him, causing him to release a painful loud scream. "Argh!"
Yang Xiao tried to grab the two small spears, but his body was stung by excruciating pain as soon as he moved both his hands, and blood profusely flowed down from his shoulders.

Zhang Fei quickly moved in front of Ying Xiao, grabbed his head, and spoke while maintaining a sharp gaze on his opponent. "Honestly, I never considered harming you, as we had never had any issues before. I only revealed your affair to Wei Luan because You Han had been insulting me.

Regrettably, you failed to recognize your own errors and sought revenge against me, even conspiring with Chu Youqian to kill me. Once you made that decision, you became my enemy, and I will never show mercy to any of my enemies."
"No... No... Please... Don't kill me!"
"It's too late." Zhang Fei immediately used his life-force absorption ability on his enemy, which made Ying Xiao groan in pain as he struggled to free himself.
Unfortunately, Ying Xiao's struggles were useless, especially since Zhang Fei kept absorbing his life force and vitality, which caused his body to rapidly become weak and wither.

sentences.text: After waiting for several hours, Zhang Fei finally saw Chu Youqian's name in the southern river city, so he rushed to the city, where he saw her enter an inn.

After she got a room and ordered a few things, Chu Youqian rushed to the top floor to go to her room, but she didn't realize that Zhang Fei was following her using his invisibility, and he immediately snuck in as soon as she opened the door.
"Phew!

The distance from my sect to this city is too far, and I'm exhausted after flying for so long." Chu Youqian muttered to herself as she took off his sect uniform, leaving only a thin cloth covering her body.
Even though he saw such a sight, Zhang Fei had no interest in Chu Youqian, especially since everything about her was too ordinary.
Chu Youqian, who was still unaware of Zhang Fei's presence, sat on the chair beside the window before taking out a paper and brush, and she wrote a letter to Shen Haoran.

Zhang Fei immediately sneaked behind Chu Youqian and read her writing, which explained his relationship with Shen Yu, and she also asked Shen Haoran to help her suppress the Hai Twins. 'What a foolish and naive woman!
Did she really think that old man would help her do that?
Even if she used her grandfather's status, he would not fulfill her request and would instead take advantage of her.'
After she finished writing it, Chu Youqian immediately folded the letter and sealed it with a wax seal, but she looked confused thinking about who could be ordered to deliver it to Shen Haoran.
Chu Youqian then sent a voice transmission to her acquaintances in the southern river city, but most of them were busy with their own affairs, so they rejected her.
In the end, she contacted the last person she thought would not mind helping her, who immediately agreed to her request, so she asked the person to come meet her at the inn.
"Phew!" Chu Youqian let out a sigh of relief before moving to the bed and lying there, and she smiled evilly as she looked at the ceiling of her room.
"Hehe!
After reading my letter, I'm sure Shen Haoran will confront Zhang Fei directly, and he will kill him immediately.
Besides, I hope he will be willing to help me suppress the Hai elders, so I can do something about Zhang Lin and seize her contract beast."
Zhang Fei shook his head as he listened to Chu Youqian's words, especially since they did not know each other, so there was no enmity between them.
Unfortunately, her arrogance and jealousy were too great, leading her to make the foolish decision to become his enemy, and he was determined not to spare her.
However, Zhang Fei did not immediately do anything to Chu Youqian, and he wanted to see who was willing to deliver the letter to Shen Haoran first.
*Knock...
Knock...*
"Young miss, your food and drink are ready."
Hearing that, Chu Youqian jumped out of bed and opened the door for the maidservant, who immediately brought in some dishes and a pot of tea, and she immediately left the room after that.

However, Chu Youqian refrained from eating the food immediately and instead went to the bathroom to clean herself, prompting Zhang Fei to devise a plan of action against her. 'Do you have any good ideas, Mei?'
[Master, I think there are some items that will make her suffer.]
'Oh?
What kind of items are those?'
[Hehe, I'll buy them now, and you'll definitely like the effects.]
{You got Ciyang Powder x1}
{5 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Tianhua Powder x1}
{5 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.} been deducted from your balance.}
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment before taking both items from the system inventory, and a strange smile appeared on his face after he read their descriptions.

He then mixed the tianhua powder into the tea jug and sprinkled the ciyang powder on the bed. 'These two powders were actually useless for other purposes, but they were quite useful for making people like Chu Youqian suffer.'
A few minutes later, Chu Youqian had finished her bath and immediately dressed, anticipating the arrival of an acquaintance.
Unaware of Zhang Fei's actions, she waited for the person while enjoying her dishes and tea.

Not long after, the person finally came to the room, so Chu Youqian immediately opened the door, and Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly after noticing the person's identity. 'Isn't he Wei Luan's ex-fiance?'
"Here." Chu Youqian immediately gave the letter to Ying Xiao as soon as he entered.
"I don't want to go to that sect, so I want you to send this letter for me, and this will benefit both of us."
"What do you mean by both of us?
Won't this only benefit you?" As he asked, Ying Xiao frowned, eager to unfold the letter.
However, Chu Youqian immediately stopped Ying Xiao and told him directly, "Do you have any idea who told Wei Luan about your affair with You Han?
That person is Zhang Fei, a disciple from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and you don't need to doubt my words, especially since this news is already known to all the disciples of my sect.
Since he ruined your engagement with her, you must want to take revenge on him, right?"
"That's for sure!" Ying Xiao replied with a small shout.
"I have been looking forward to my marriage with Wei Luan for so long, but that bastard ruined everything, so I must take revenge against him."
Chu Youqian smiled faintly and pressed her index finger against Ying Xiao's chest.
"Actually, I have no problem with Zhang Fei, but I feel angry because Chu Xing belittled me by saying that he is better than me.
Aside from that, his little sister has a beautiful contract beast, and I want to have it for myself.
Unfortunately, he is very close to the Hai elders, as well as the Liu clan's son-in-law.
That's why we can't attack him openly, and we need Shen Tianyu's help to do something about him."
"Shen Tianyu?" Ying Xiao frowned upon hearing the name.
"What does that lustful bastard have to do with Zhang Fei?
Have you forgotten that he won't do anything without reciprocation?"

"Naturally, I know that, but I have a piece of information that will make Shen Tianyu furious, and he will definitely be willing to help us." Ying Xiao looked at her in confusion, so Chu Youqian directly told him the truth.
"Zhang Fei has snatched Shen Yu from his hands, and I heard that they've been spending a lot of time together.
Do you think he won't be furious if he hears this news?"
Ying Xiao was taken aback upon hearing that, especially since their wedding was only a few days away, but Shen Yu suddenly turned to another man.
"You're right; Shen Tianyu will undoubtedly be furious if he learns about Shen Yu's affair, and he will certainly attack Zhang Fei directly.
Moreover, his cultivation has almost reached the Earth Realm, so he should be able to kill that bastard."
"That's right." Chu Youqian responded with a nod.
"However, something seems to have happened to Shen Tianyu, and I still can't contact him until this moment, so I want you to send this letter to Shen Haoran.
After all, that old man has always doted on his son and would do anything for him, so I am sure that he will kill Zhang Fei immediately after hearing about this news.
That way, we don't have to bother dealing with him ourselves; we only need to wait for the news of his death."
Hearing that, Ying Xiao's expression changed slightly.
"Tch!
That bastard caused me to lose Wei Luan, and my father even beat me up after Wei Jiang revealed my affair with You Han.
Therefore, I would be thrilled if that bastard met his demise at the hands of Shen Haoran."
"Haha." Chu Youqian laughed softly upon hearing that.

"In that case, you can go to the Yin-Yang Pavilion now and give the letter to Shen Haoran, and I'm sure he won't mind pressuring the Hai elders in exchange for this information, so both of us will benefit from this matter.
You can take revenge on him, and no one will stop me from snatching that beautiful beast from Zhang Lin's hands."
After hearing that, Ying Xiao nodded repeatedly.
"All right, I'll go to the sect right now and meet Shen Haoran in person."
After Ying Xiao left the room, Zhang Fei decided to follow him.
On the other hand, Chu Youqian immediately finished her food and drink, took off her dress, lay down on the bed, and closed her eyes with a triumphant smile.
"Haha!
That bastard will die, and Zhang Lin's beast will soon be mine."
Sometime later, Ying Xiao had already arrived at the outer perimeter of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and he wanted to rush there to meet Shen Haoran.
Zhang Fei, who had been following him, immediately landed in front of him.
Wasting no time, he used a bit of strength to punch the unprepared Ying Xiao in the chest, causing him to fall to the ground and roll backwards a few times.
"Argh!
Damn it!" As he activated his cultivation, Ying Xiao cursed, and he immediately jumped up, looking around the area.
Since he was still in an invisible state, he couldn't see Zhang Fei.
"Coward!
Come out and face me like a man!"
"Are you really a man?" As he appeared before him, Zhang Fei asked, causing Ying Xiao to frown and raise his guard.
"You don't have to be confused about me, because I am the person you and Chu Youqian are targeting."
"So you are Zhang Fei, huh?" Seeing him nod, Ying Xiao immediately took out two small spears and pointed them at him.
"I didn't expect that you had been spying on me and Chu Youqian, but it's good that you appear in front of me now.
This way, I can take revenge on you for ruining my marriage with Wei Luan, and I will kill you with my own hands."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed softly at Ying Xiao's words, and he smiled faintly before speaking to provoke him.
"You know what?
You are such a foolish man, and you don't understand that Wei Luan is much more valuable, yet you waste her for that slut, You Han.
Although her body is nothing special, she is a beautiful and gentle woman, and I enjoyed our time together.
Her soft lips and breasts—I enjoyed kissing and squeezing them so much—and her moans are also melodious to my ears.
Aside from that, the way she sucked my dick was truly satisfying, and she also enjoyed it a lot when I released my cum inside her mouth.
In addition, her-"
"Bastard!
Wei Luan is mine!
You ruined everything!" Instantly, Ying Xiao's anger became uncontrollable, and he dashed towards Zhang Fei as he stabbed his small spears at him repeatedly.

Unfortunately, Ying Xiao's speed was far below that of Zhang Fei, who had trained to level three of the gravity feature, which made gravity eight times heavier, so none of his attacks could hit his body. 'Shit!
What's going on?
My cultivation is several minor stages above his, but I can't land a single attack on him!'

Zhang Fei casually dodged every single one of Ying Xiao's attacks, especially since all his attacks looked like slow motion in his eyes, and he continued to do so for some time, causing his enemy to look frustrated.
Zhang Fei then grabbed the two small spears before unleashing a swift knee strike onto his enemy's abdomen, which hit his target squarely, causing Ying Xiao to bend forward as his mouth vomited.
"Cough...
Cough..."
"Is this all you can do?" Zhang Fei then pulled Ying Xiao's hair and threw him towards a large tree nearby, where his body immediately collided with the tree.
*Bam*
"Guah!" Zhang Fei threw two small spears towards Yang Xiao before he fell to the ground.
Both spears pierced his shoulders before becoming stuck in a large tree behind him, causing him to release a painful loud scream.
"Argh!"
Yang Xiao tried to grab the two small spears, but his body was stung by excruciating pain as soon as he moved both his hands, and blood profusely flowed down from his shoulders.
Zhang Fei quickly moved in front of Ying Xiao, grabbed his head, and spoke while maintaining a sharp gaze on his opponent.
"Honestly, I never considered harming you, as we had never had any issues before.
I only revealed your affair to Wei Luan because You Han had been insulting me.
Regrettably, you failed to recognize your own errors and sought revenge against me, even conspiring with Chu Youqian to kill me.
Once you made that decision, you became my enemy, and I will never show mercy to any of my enemies."
No...
Please...
Don't kill me!"
"It's too late." Zhang Fei immediately used his life-force absorption ability on his enemy, which made Ying Xiao groan in pain as he struggled to free himself.
Unfortunately, Ying Xiao's struggles were useless, especially since Zhang Fei kept absorbing his life force and vitality, which caused his body to rapidly become weak and wither.
