chapters.title: Chapter 287: Zhang Chen's Past
paragraphs: The two tigresses, who were chasing Quan Xun, immediately ran towards Zhang Fei. However, they no longer pounced on him as they used to, likely due to their larger bodies. Instead, they rubbed their heads against his legs in a spoiled manner.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed, then squatted down in front of them, embracing their necks and rubbing their fur. "The growth of the two of you is truly amazing, Hu Yi and Hu Er. You guys are only two months old now, but you are already as big as ordinary tigers in my home realm.
Moreover, your cultivation has also reached the 1-Star Body Realm, and you will continue to grow stronger thanks to the effects of the three pills you swallowed before."
.net
*Roar*

Both tigresses roared softly before licking Zhang Fei's cheeks at the same time to show their gratitude to him, especially since he had saved them after their mother died, and he had also given them many precious items, especially the beast pills.
"Hah... Hah...*

Zhang Fei immediately looked up at his cousin, who looked so exhausted. However, he was satisfied to see the changes in Quan Xun, especially since his body was no longer as fat as it was a month and a half ago and his cultivation had reached the 5-Star Elementary Realm. "How do you feel now? Have you gotten more used to your life as a cultivator?"

"Hah... Hah..." Quan Xun immediately bent forward with his hands supporting his body on his shoulders, and he looked at Zhang Fei to respond. "At first, my new life was really hard, but I've gotten used to everything now. Thanks to these tigresses, I can gradually change myself, but I know that my changes now are still not enough, so I have to work harder to become as strong as you, cousin."

"Your mindset is on the right track if you can think like that." Zhang Fei then stood up and patted Quan Xun's shoulder. "The life of a cultivator is truly not easy, and strength is everything. If you possess strength, you can safeguard both yourself and your mother. Conversely, if you lack power, those with greater strength will oppress you.

However, cultivating is like building a house; you can't become strong overnight, and you must pay attention to the foundation of your cultivation. If your cultivation is high but your foundation is weak, you will be the one who loses, so you must continue to stabilize your foundation every time you break through."

"Yeah, you're right, Cousin." Quan Xun replied with a nod. Agreed. "Aunt Qingyu has also explained this to me many times, and I will definitely remember your advice. Anyway, can I join your sect, Cousin?"
"Oh?" Quan Xun's request momentarily surprised Zhang Fei. "Do you know what kind of sect the Yin-Yang Pavilion is?"

Quan Xun nodded to Zhang Fei. "Aunt Qingyu said that it is a dual cultivation sect, and she also explained to me about dual cultivators, so I more or less understand the gist of it. In addition, she provided me with an overview of the sect's operations, including its missions and other activities, which has sparked my interest in joining.
This way, I can develop at a faster pace, just like you, and acquire experience at a younger age."
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before asking Quan Xun. "Do you really want to become a dual cultivator like me? Have you discussed this matter with Aunt Tan?"

"Haha." Upon hearing his questions, Quan Xun laughed wryly while rubbing the back of his head. "Actually, I have discussed this matter with my mother, and she initially did not agree to me becoming a dual cultivator, especially since she wanted me to find a good woman who would be loyal only to me.

However, I did not want to give up so easily, so I asked for help from Aunt Qingyu and Grandma Chen to convince her. Moreover, she could see for herself that your wives are good women, and they are also completely loyal to you, so she finally agreed with my decision."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Since you have already made your decision, I can send you to the Yin-Yang Pavilion. However, since your cultivation is still in the elementary realm, you are likely to be an outer disciple. Once your cultivation reaches the core realm, you will advance to the inner disciple.
Anyway, I will give you a pretty good dual cultivation technique, so you don't have to worry about that, especially since your cultivation will increase faster once you get a partner."

Although Quan Xun was his cousin, Zhang Fei still wouldn't share the Yin-Yang Flawless Arts with him, and he would only share it with his women, so he immediately asked the AI to buy another technique. 'Mei, you can buy that dual cultivation technique.'
[Yes, master.]
{You got Spiritual Couple Cultivation x1}
{1,000,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

After the technique appeared in his mind, Zhang Fei immediately shared it with Quan Xun, which made him very excited. "As for your first partner, I might be able to help you find a suitable woman. However, we can't do it now, especially since the situation in the Yin-Yang Pavilion will be chaotic soon, so I'll take you there after the chaos has subsided.
For now, focus on studying the technique, but don't neglect cultivation and training."
"Don't worry, Cousin. I will definitely not neglect my cultivation and training." Quan Xun replied with a serious nod. "Anyway, thank you for the technique, and I will go to my room to study it now."

The two tigresses immediately followed Quan Xun away, especially since Zhang Fei asked them to keep an eye on his cousin in training, and she then hurried to her grandmother's room because Zhang Chen was resting there.
*Knock... Knock...*
"Come in, Fei'er." Zhang Chen, who was leaning on the bead headrest, immediately asked her grandson. "Why are you back here? Are your matters in the Yin-Yang Pavilion finished?"

"Not yet." Zhang Fei then sat down on the side of the bed and began to massage his grandmother's feet, causing Zhang Chen to smile at her concern for him. "Yu'er and Shen Tianyu's wedding ceremony will be in six days, so I still have a lot of time. Moreover, I have something to talk to you about, so I purposely came back to see you."
"What do you want to talk to me about?"
As he continued to massage his grandmother's feet, Zhang Fei turned to Zhang Chen. "Can you tell me the reason behind your decision to use your surname for your son?"
"Why are you suddenly asking that? I already said-"

"Grandma, you don't have to lie to me anymore, and I know that my grandfather is still alive." Zhang Chen instantly stiffened after Zhang Fei said that. "Have you forgotten the ability of my demon eyes? Honestly, I didn't want to use it on you or the others, but I have long been curious about your decision.

Moreover, despite your constant claims that my grandfather passed away before you gave birth to Aunt Hanzi, you have never shown us his photo and have consistently changed the subject whenever we inquired about him. Even Zhang Hai and Aunt Hanzi have never seen his photo, so I decided to use my demon eyes ability on you, and I discovered many things that you had hidden in your soul."

After a while, Zhang Chen came back to her senses and let out a heavy sigh. She pulled Zhang Fei closer to her, then rubbed his cheeks. "You are right; your grandfather is still alive, but I haven't seen him for a long time, and the last time we met was when your father was born.
Even so, you should have heard of his name because he is one of the famous people in our country, and his name is Wang Zetian."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei was shocked after hearing the name. "You mean Wang Zetian, the most influential person in our country? That old man's popularity and authority surpass Yang Hao and Huang Rong."

"Yes." Zhang Chen nodded at Zhang Fei. "When we first met, Wang Zetian was not as rich or influential as he is now, and he was just starting his steps in politics. However, his Wang family was already wealthy at the time, and he was their main heir."

"How did you meet him, Grandma?" Zhang Fei curiously asked Zhang Chen. "After all, you have always lived in the village, and you only go to the city when you help my late great-grandparents sell their crops, right?"

"That's right." Zhang Chen nodded with a smile as she recalled those times. "I was 18 years old at the time, and Wang Zetian was already 30 years old. He came to our village to seek support from the villagers to become the provincial head, especially since our village was included in that region, and I met him for the first time at that time."
"Then?"

Zhang Chen smiled at Zhang Fei's impatient expression. "Wang Zetian was a handsome man, and his demeanor was kind and intellectual; so many women from our village dreamed of him as their husband, including me.
Back then, I was still too innocent and naive, so I quickly fell in love with him, especially after he visited our village repeatedly and established a positive relationship with the villagers."
"Did Wang Zetian try to get closer to you at that time?"

"Haha." Zhang Chen giggled as she nodded, especially since those were such beautiful times for a young girl like her. "You naturally know that this old granny was one of the most beautiful girls in our village at that time, right?"

"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei burst out laughing after hearing Zhang Chen's narcissistic remarks, but then he kissed her forehead. "Even though you're seventy years old now, you're still as beautiful as ever, Grandma. Otherwise, I, Lin'er, and Big Sis Yue wouldn't be as handsome and beautiful as we are now, right?"

"Yes, you three are indeed handsome and beautiful, and you have a plethora of beautiful wives now." Zhang Chen then recounted her story again. "After numerous meetings and Wang Zentian's persistent courtship, I finally fell deeply in love with him, immediately accepting his proposal. Unfortunately, my blinded feelings led me to make a grave mistake by sleeping with him before we got married."
Zhang Fei frowned after hearing Zhang Chen's last sentence, and her disappointed expression made him angry. "Did Wang Zetian leave you right after you two slept together?"

"No." Zhang Chen denied it, shaking her head. "After that day, my relationship with Wang Zetian got better and better each day, and your late great-grandparents also approved of our relationship. Since his political career had just begun, we didn't immediately tie the knot. However, this didn't bother me, as we continued to cherish our time together, patiently waiting for the ideal moment to marry.
Unfortunately, things became complicated when I turned 19, as I was pregnant with his son, and he took me to visit his family to seek their blessings."
Zhang Fei frowned even more after he heard that. "The result was that Wang Zetian's family rejected you, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Chen answered with a sigh of disappointment. "Wang Zetian's parents strongly opposed our relationship because I was just a village girl and didn't have a high education, so they thought I wasn't worthy to be their daughter-in-law.
Even so, he persevered and fought for our relationship, but his efforts came to a dead end when his father threatened to withdraw all his support and erase his name from their family tree."
"Then what happened after that?"

Before continuing, Zhang Chen let out a heavy sigh. "Although he did not approve of our relationship, Wang Zetian's father, Wang Jingwei, never insulted me at all and still treated me well. However, Wu Meihong, his wife, continued to insult me and even offered me a substantial sum of money in exchange for my willingness to leave her son and abort my pregnancy.

However, I refused to accept the money and promptly left their house to return to the village. Upon my arrival, I thoroughly explained the situation to your late great-grandparents, who expressed their deep disappointment. Even so, they forbade me from having an abortion, and they were the ones who helped me through my situation."
"Did Wang Zetian still see you at that time?"

"Yes." Zhang Chen nodded at him. "Actually, Wang Zetian helped us silence the villagers who were insulting our family because of my pregnancy, and he continued to provide a lot of help until our son's birth a year later.

In fact, Wang Jingwei also helped us by generously providing a substantial sum of money for our son's needs, which I gratefully accepted due to the challenging circumstances of our time. Since I never married him, I decided to name our son Zhang Hai, and I never met them again after that."
Zhang Fei nodded thoughtfully after Zhang Chen finished telling him everything. "Do you want to meet Wang Zetian again, Grandma?"
"Eh?" Zhang Chen looked at her grandson in surprise.

"Grandma, I know that you still love Wang Zetian until now; otherwise, you wouldn't have decided to live alone after giving birth to Zhang Hai, and you would have married someone else. If you want to see him, I will take you back to Earth to do so." Zhang Fei then took out two pills that he had bought earlier and put the youthful returning pill in Zhang Chen's mouth.
"However, you have to swallow these two pills first, and I'll take you to see him afterwards."

However, we can't do it now, especially since the situation in the Yin-Yang Pavilion will be chaotic soon, so I'll take you there after the chaos has subsided.
For now, focus on studying the technique, but don't neglect cultivation and training."
"Don't worry, Cousin.
I will definitely not neglect my cultivation and training." Quan Xun replied with a serious nod.
"Anyway, thank you for the technique, and I will go to my room to study it now."

The two tigresses immediately followed Quan Xun away, especially since Zhang Fei asked them to keep an eye on his cousin in training, and she then hurried to her grandmother's room because Zhang Chen was resting there.
*Knock...
Knock...*
"Come in, Fei'er." Zhang Chen, who was leaning on the bead headrest, immediately asked her grandson.
"Why are you back here?
Are your matters in the Yin-Yang Pavilion finished?"
"Not yet." Zhang Fei then sat down on the side of the bed and began to massage his grandmother's feet, causing Zhang Chen to smile at her concern for him.
"Yu'er and Shen Tianyu's wedding ceremony will be in six days, so I still have a lot of time.
Moreover, I have something to talk to you about, so I purposely came back to see you."
"What do you want to talk to me about?"
As he continued to massage his grandmother's feet, Zhang Fei turned to Zhang Chen.
"Can you tell me the reason behind your decision to use your surname for your son?"
"Why are you suddenly asking that?
I already said-"
"Grandma, you don't have to lie to me anymore, and I know that my grandfather is still alive." Zhang Chen instantly stiffened after Zhang Fei said that.
"Have you forgotten the ability of my demon eyes?
Honestly, I didn't want to use it on you or the others, but I have long been curious about your decision.

Moreover, despite your constant claims that my grandfather passed away before you gave birth to Aunt Hanzi, you have never shown us his photo and have consistently changed the subject whenever we inquired about him.
Even Zhang Hai and Aunt Hanzi have never seen his photo, so I decided to use my demon eyes ability on you, and I discovered many things that you had hidden in your soul."
After a while, Zhang Chen came back to her senses and let out a heavy sigh.
She pulled Zhang Fei closer to her, then rubbed his cheeks.
"You are right; your grandfather is still alive, but I haven't seen him for a long time, and the last time we met was when your father was born.
Even so, you should have heard of his name because he is one of the famous people in our country, and his name is Wang Zetian."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei was shocked after hearing the name.
"You mean Wang Zetian, the most influential person in our country?
That old man's popularity and authority surpass Yang Hao and Huang Rong."
"Yes." Zhang Chen nodded at Zhang Fei.
"When we first met, Wang Zetian was not as rich or influential as he is now, and he was just starting his steps in politics.
However, his Wang family was already wealthy at the time, and he was their main heir."
"How did you meet him, Grandma?" Zhang Fei curiously asked Zhang Chen.
"After all, you have always lived in the village, and you only go to the city when you help my late great-grandparents sell their crops, right?"
"That's right." Zhang Chen nodded with a smile as she recalled those times.
"I was 18 years old at the time, and Wang Zetian was already 30 years old.
He came to our village to seek support from the villagers to become the provincial head, especially since our village was included in that region, and I met him for the first time at that time."
"Then?"
Zhang Chen smiled at Zhang Fei's impatient expression.
"Wang Zetian was a handsome man, and his demeanor was kind and intellectual; so many women from our village dreamed of him as their husband, including me.
Back then, I was still too innocent and naive, so I quickly fell in love with him, especially after he visited our village repeatedly and established a positive relationship with the villagers."
"Did Wang Zetian try to get closer to you at that time?"
"Haha." Zhang Chen giggled as she nodded, especially since those were such beautiful times for a young girl like her.
"You naturally know that this old granny was one of the most beautiful girls in our village at that time, right?"
"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei burst out laughing after hearing Zhang Chen's narcissistic remarks, but then he kissed her forehead.
"Even though you're seventy years old now, you're still as beautiful as ever, Grandma.
Otherwise, I, Lin'er, and Big Sis Yue wouldn't be as handsome and beautiful as we are now, right?"
"Yes, you three are indeed handsome and beautiful, and you have a plethora of beautiful wives now." Zhang Chen then recounted her story again.
"After numerous meetings and Wang Zentian's persistent courtship, I finally fell deeply in love with him, immediately accepting his proposal.
Unfortunately, my blinded feelings led me to make a grave mistake by sleeping with him before we got married."
Zhang Fei frowned after hearing Zhang Chen's last sentence, and her disappointed expression made him angry.
"Did Wang Zetian leave you right after you two slept together?"
"No." Zhang Chen denied it, shaking her head.
"After that day, my relationship with Wang Zetian got better and better each day, and your late great-grandparents also approved of our relationship.
Since his political career had just begun, we didn't immediately tie the knot.
However, this didn't bother me, as we continued to cherish our time together, patiently waiting for the ideal moment to marry.
Unfortunately, things became complicated when I turned 19, as I was pregnant with his son, and he took me to visit his family to seek their blessings."
Zhang Fei frowned even more after he heard that.
"The result was that Wang Zetian's family rejected you, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Chen answered with a sigh of disappointment.
"Wang Zetian's parents strongly opposed our relationship because I was just a village girl and didn't have a high education, so they thought I wasn't worthy to be their daughter-in-law.
Even so, he persevered and fought for our relationship, but his efforts came to a dead end when his father threatened to withdraw all his support and erase his name from their family tree."
"Then what happened after that?"
Before continuing, Zhang Chen let out a heavy sigh.
"Although he did not approve of our relationship, Wang Zetian's father, Wang Jingwei, never insulted me at all and still treated me well.
However, Wu Meihong, his wife, continued to insult me and even offered me a substantial sum of money in exchange for my willingness to leave her son and abort my pregnancy.
However, I refused to accept the money and promptly left their house to return to the village.
Upon my arrival, I thoroughly explained the situation to your late great-grandparents, who expressed their deep disappointment.
Even so, they forbade me from having an abortion, and they were the ones who helped me through my situation."
"Did Wang Zetian still see you at that time?"
"Yes." Zhang Chen nodded at him.
"Actually, Wang Zetian helped us silence the villagers who were insulting our family because of my pregnancy, and he continued to provide a lot of help until our son's birth a year later.
In fact, Wang Jingwei also helped us by generously providing a substantial sum of money for our son's needs, which I gratefully accepted due to the challenging circumstances of our time.
Since I never married him, I decided to name our son Zhang Hai, and I never met them again after that."
Zhang Fei nodded thoughtfully after Zhang Chen finished telling him everything.
"Do you want to meet Wang Zetian again, Grandma?"
"Eh?" Zhang Chen looked at her grandson in surprise.
"Grandma, I know that you still love Wang Zetian until now; otherwise, you wouldn't have decided to live alone after giving birth to Zhang Hai, and you would have married someone else.
If you want to see him, I will take you back to Earth to do so." Zhang Fei then took out two pills that he had bought earlier and put the youthful returning pill in Zhang Chen's mouth.
"However, you have to swallow these two pills first, and I'll take you to see him afterwards."

Zhang Chen asked her grandson as she looked down, but her expression turned surprised when a transparent light enveloped her body, revealing that her wrinkled skin was slowly becoming firm again, and even the spots on her skin were gradually disappearing. "What's happening to me? Why is my body slowly becoming younger?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly and explained it to her grandmother. "The pill you just swallowed is the youthful returning pill, and its effects are indeed the ones you are experiencing now, so I specially bought it for you. Very soon, you will be young and beautiful again, just like when you were young."

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before speaking to Zhang Chen again. "Grandma, I know that you have a lot of questions about me, but I can't tell you and the others anything for now. However, I promise that I will tell you everything after I become the strongest, and no one can defeat me anymore."

Although she was still a rookie cultivator, Zhang Chen was not stupid, and she could understand the meaning behind her grandmother's words, so she gave a nod of understanding. "All right, I will wait for you to become the strongest, and you must tell us everything at that time."

"Don't worry, I won't break my promise, and I will definitely reveal everything at that time." Zhang Fei felt a sense of relief in his heart, particularly because he had always harbored guilt towards Zhang Chen and the others for concealing Mei's existence and the system from them, but he was forced to keep them in secret for their own good.
"How long will this process take to complete?"

"Are you looking forward to seeing your youthful appearance again?" Zhang Chen answered Zhang Fei with a smile. "Actually, I personally don't know how long the process of restoring your youth will take, so we can only wait for now.

This second pill is the beauty retaining pill, and you will never age again after you swallow it, so you will stay young for the rest of your life, but this pill will not affect your lifespan. Therefore, you should continue to improve your cultivation to increase your lifespan, ensuring we can live together for a very long time.

"I see." Zhang Chen nodded in understanding. "I myself want to see your children and your descendants after them, and I will educate them to be good people in the future, so I will try harder to improve my cultivation."

Zhang Fei smiled wryly at that, especially since he himself still had not thought about having children because he was still too weak, and he still could not free Hu Yue from Hu Gao's shackles, yet his grandmother had already thought so far ahead to his descendants after his children.
Meanwhile, at the Ying Clan, Sun Mei'er wept uncontrollably in her room, clutching a broken jade, a symbol of Ying Xiao's life, indicating that her son had died.

Even though she was devastated about it, Sun Mei'er immediately contacted her husband, who was on his way to the western region, as well as her daughter, who was a disciple of the Yin-Yang Pavilion. Beside them, she also contacted her parents in the Sun Clan to inform them of Ying Xiao's death, and she ordered everyone from the Ying Clan to search for his corpse.

Sun Mei'er then stood up from her seat, walked over to her son's painting that was hanging on the side of the room, and picked it up while rubbing his face. "What exactly happened to you, Son? You told me that you went to meet Chu Youqian at the inn, but you suddenly died, and I don't even know where you died."

A short while later, two women hurriedly entered Sun Mei'er's room while holding hands. One of them has short and curly black hair above her shoulders, making her look a little tomboyish, and her face is just ordinary. Her body is quite curvy, and her breasts, which are around the C-Cup, are neither small nor big.

She has waist-length brunette hair in two braids, and her appearance is quite sexy when she wears a dress that is quite open in some parts, exposing her flat abdomen. Even her breasts are a bit bigger around D-Cup.

The first woman was none other than Sun Mei'er's daughter, Ying Sha, one of the Yin-Yang Pavilion's top 10 inner disciples. On the other hand, the second woman was her partner and lover, Hong Xuan, one of the top 10 core disciples.

Ying Sha immediately sat down beside Sun Mei'er, who was still crying, and hugged her with both hands. "Mom, I know you are sad about my big brother's death, and I feel the same way too. However, you should calm yourself down first and explain to us his activities before he died. What did he do before? Or where did he go before?
That way, we can analyze everything together, and we might be able to find his corpse faster."

"At first, Xiao'er was cultivating in his room, but he told me that Chu Youqian contacted him and asked for his help, so he went to the inn to meet her." Ying Sha and Hong Xuan exchanged glances after hearing the name, and they naturally recognized her, but they were confused about her relationship with Yang Xiao.
"However, I didn't have time to ask him about her purpose, especially since he left in such a hurry."

Ying Sha then stood up, lifting her mother to her feet. "Since my big brother went to see Chu Youqian at the inn, it would be better if we went there to meet her, and we could ask her purpose for asking my brother to help her. That way, we'll know where he went next, and we'll look for him there."
"All right."
Sometime later, the three women arrived at the inn where Chu Youqian was staying, but they saw a commotion inside, and they could also smell a pungent smell from inside.
"What's going on here? Where does this pungent smell come from?"

One of them immediately turned to Ying Sha. "Young Miss Ying, this pungent smell comes from the room of a guest who just arrived some time ago. If I'm not mistaken, her name is Chu Youqian; she is the young miss of the Chu Clan, specifically the Chu Clan in the eastern region.

At first, there was nothing unusual about her, but suddenly, we smelled a foul odor emanating from her room, accompanied by her hysterical screams, which frightened us. Some of us tried to check her room, but the smell got worse in there, so we decided not to."

The three women exchanged glances with frowns, and Sun Mei'er took out an artifact that immediately enveloped the three of them. "Let's go; we have to check on Chu Youqian's condition now, or we'll be too late, and we can't get any answers about Xiao'er."
The innkeeper was relieved to see the three of them go to the upper floors, as the pungent smell had become unbearable for them, and some of his customers had even cancelled their rooms due to it.

Before long, the three of them arrived in front of the room, and Sun Mei'er immediately broke down the door. However, their expressions turned to shock upon seeing Chu Youqian, particularly due to her complete nakedness and messy appearance.

Moreover, Chu Youqian's body was covered in purulent carbuncles and scratches, including her face, especially since she kept scratching her body because of the itchiness, which was due to the effect of the two powders that Zhang Fei had used on her earlier.

The tianhua powder caused those purulent carbuncles to appear on Chu Youqian's body, and some of them were partially busted, giving off a pungent smell. On the other hand, the ciyang power made her experience a severe itching sensation all over her body, making her unable to stop scratching her body.
Chu Youqian turned to the three women and shouted at them. "Help me! Please help me!"
Instead, Ying Sha asked Chu Youqian. "What did you do to my brother? Where is he now? Did you kill him?"
"What?" Chu Youqian shouted in shock as she kept scratching her body. "I didn't kill Ying Xiao! I just asked him to deliver a letter to Shen Haoran, and he had already gone to the sect a while ago!"

"Shen Haoran?" The three women exchanged confused looks, especially since they knew that it was not easy to meet him, and they were also confused about the reason Chu Youqing asked Ying Xiao to deliver the letter to him.

"What exactly happened? Why did you ask my son to send a letter to Shen Haoran?" With a serious expression, Sun Mei'er asked and released her aura to suppress Chu Youqin, particularly since her son had died as a result of carrying out her request.

Chu Youqian trembled after sensing the pressure from Sun Mei'er's aura, but she still thought of making up a story for them. "I did it because of that damn Zhang Fei! I met him by accident, and although we had never met before, he continued to harass and even molest me.

After I escaped from him and returned to my sect, I heard news that Shen Yu was having an affair with him, so I came here to see Shen Tianyu. Unfortunately, I couldn't contact him, so I thought of seeing Shen Haoran. However, I remembered that he was a pervert and often forced women to serve him, so I didn't dare to meet him in person, and I asked Ying Xiao to send him a letter instead."

Ying Sha and Hong Xuan were shocked to hear that, but they did not believe that Shen Yu was having an affair with Zhang Fei, especially since they both knew for sure that she was still in seclusion until now.
Sun Mei'er then asked the two women. "Who exactly is Zhang Fei? Do you both know him?"

Both women nodded to Sun Mei'er, and Ying Sha explained it to her mother. "Actually, I have never met Zhang Fei in person, but I heard that he joined our sect about a month and a half ago as an outer disciple. However, he was promoted to an inner disciple about a month ago, and he now has several partners by his side.

Even so, he and his partners almost never stay in the sect, and they keep leaving to carry out many missions at once. Even some other disciples, such as Lin Dong'er and Mu Lingshu, joined his partners. Besides, I heard rumors that he is the son-in-law of Matriarch Liu Rong, but I cannot confirm whether it is true or not."

As she continued to scratch her itchy body, Chu Youqian spoke to them again. "That's right! Zhang Fei is indeed Liu Rong's son-in-law, especially since Liu Hua is his wife. In addition to her, my two cousins, Chu Ying and Chu Qing, are also his wives. I heard about their relationship from Chu Xing, so it must be true."

Chu Youqian's revelation shocked the three women, particularly because the Chu and Liu Clans were significantly stronger than their combined Ying, Sun, and Hong Clans. Despite this, Zhang Fei managed to marry three women from both clans.
"I've told you all the truth, so please help me to relieve this shit!"

Sun Mei'er let out a soft sigh before moving in front of Chu Youqian, and she knocked her unconscious because she couldn't stop scratching her body, causing those purulent carbuncles to burst one by one and emitting a pungent smell.

Sun Mei'er then contacted her clan's physician to come to the inn to check on Chu Youqian. She also contacted a member of the eastern Chu Clan who lived in the southern river city, informing them to pick her up.

"Let's go; let them take care of this girl, and we will look for Xiao'er in the area around the Yin-Yang Pavilion." Both women nodded in agreement, and they hurriedly followed Sun Mei'er out of the room.

After Sun Mei'er After explaining the situation to the innkeeper, the three of them hurriedly flew to the Yin-Yang Pavilion. However, they did not go to the sect, and they searched for Ying Xiao's corpse in the outside area.

"Where... where is Xiao'er's corpse? We've checked the entire area, but we still can't find his corpse."

"Although his character is not good, I believe that Shen Haoran would not possibly kill your brother." Hong Xuan then contacted Min Ren, who was responsible for maintaining the mission hall, and inquired about Zhang Fei. "Anyway, Elder Min told me that Zhang Fei left our sect about three weeks ago, and he still hasn't returned, so I don't think he killed your brother."
Hong Xuan's words made Ying Sha frown. "Does that mean Chu Youqian deliberately lied to us?"

"That's possible." Hong Xuan replied with a nod. "Honestly, I've never liked Chu Youqian, especially since she's too arrogant and jealous, and I've heard from my friends in the Hidden Sea Palace about her bad behavior, especially her attitude towards her junior sisters.

Even her relationship with her cousin was never good, even though they were both descendants of Senior Chu Liuxiang and joined the same sect. Furthermore, we both know that Zhang Fei has so many partners, and most of them are prettier than her, like Du Xuan and Ning Xiang. In addition, she told us before that he was the son-in-law of Matriarch Liu Rong, and two of her cousins were also his wives.
That's why I didn't believe her when she claimed that he harassed and molested her, but I'm not sure why she lied to us."

After hearing Hong Xuan's words, Sun Mei'er immediately spoke to her daughter. "You can ask Wei Luan about this matter; I'm sure she knows something about Chu Youqian's purpose in lying to us. Aside from that, you can also ask Chu Xing about Zhang Fei's relationship with the Liu and Chu Clans."

Ying Sha nodded to her mother and sent a voice transmission directly to the two women, but their response made her frown even more, prompting her to inform them immediately. "Luan'er told me that Chu Youqian has never met Zhang Fei, so he couldn't possibly do such a thing to her.

Regardless, she harbored jealousy towards his younger sister, Zhang Lin, because she possessed a pretty beast contract, and that woman wanted to snatch it from her. As for his relationship with the Liu and Chu Clans, Chu Xing confirmed that he was indeed the son-in-law of both clans because Liu Hua, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing were his wives."
Both women also frowned after knowing Chu Youqian's reason for lying to them. With doubt on her face, Hong Xuan questioned Ying Sha. "Did you ask them about Zhang Fei and Shen Yu's relationship?"

"Yes." Ying Sha nodded to her lover. "Luan'er told me that she didn't know anything about it, and Chu Xing also said that she had never heard of her brother-in-law's relationship with Shen Yu, so I don't know whether their relationship is true or not.

Actually, their answers made me think that Chu Youqian deliberately made up a story about their relationship, and she wanted to take advantage of Shen Haoran and Shen Tianyu doing something to Zhang Fei, so she could do something to Zhang Lin and her contract beast."

"Yeah, I thought the same as you." Hong Xuan replied while nodding in agreement. "As far as I know, Shen Yu has never left her seclusion since she returned from the Blazing Volcano Mountain, so I don't believe that she knows Zhang Fei, let alone having an affair with him."
Unfortunately, Hong Xuan was wrong about it, especially since she did not know that Blazing Volcano Mountain was the place where Shen Yu and Zhang Fei first met.

"Mom, I think it would be better if we returned to our clan first and let our people search for my brother's corpse." However, Sun Mei'er seemed to still want to search for Ying Xiao's corpse, especially since she would not be able to rest easy before finding him. Therefore, Ying Sha spoke to her again. "Mom, I understand your feelings, as I myself also want to find his corpse immediately.

However, we have searched every area, but we have not been able to find him, so let our people look elsewhere. Furthermore, you have contacted your clan, and they will be here soon. Given their large numbers, I am sure they will be able to find him soon."
Sun Mei'er sighed heavily before nodding in agreement. "Moreover, your father is on his way home, so I will wait for him to return before continuing our search."
"Sha'er! Aunt Mei'er! You two can go back first, and I'll go back to the sect to check something."
After the two women agreed, the three of them immediately parted ways, and the two women returned to the Ying Clan to wait for Ying Feng.

Zhang Chen stood in front of the mirror in a daze, as her eyes kept staring at her reflection in the mirror and her hands kept stroking her face, which had become young again.

Zhang Fei then hugged his grandmother from behind. "Do you like the pill's effects, Grandma? Look at you; you now look like a woman of Lin'er's age, and people will definitely think that you are our sister."

"I like it very much, Fei'er." However, Zhang Chen was astounded by her own voice, particularly because it was no longer as hoarse as before, indicating that not only her appearance but her entire body had rejuvenated. "Your pill is incredibly magical, and everyone, especially Hanzi, will definitely be shocked when they see me later."

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed before putting the beauty retaining pill in his grandmother's mouth, which she immediately swallowed. Unlike before, Zhang Chen didn't feel anything happening to her body, but she believed that the effects of the pill were as her grandson had told her before. "Speaking of Aunt Hanzi, where did you find her, Grandma? Who are her biological parents?"

Upon hearing this, Zhang Chen turned to Zhang Fei and relayed the information. "Hanzi is my friend's daughter, and her mother died shortly after giving birth because she suffered heavy bleeding during childbirth.

As for her father, Lei Jun, I'm unsure of his current location, but he suffered a mental breakdown following the death of his wife, leading his family to repeatedly send him to mental hospitals. Consequently, he was unable to care for her, and both of her parents' grandparents had passed away.
As for her parents' families, they were reluctant to care for her, but since my life was much better when she was born, I decided to adopt her."
"Does Aunt Hanzi know about this matter?"

"Yes." Zhang Chen nodded at Zhang Fei. "Not only Hanzi, but also your parents are aware of this matter, but I have forbidden them from discussing it. Even though I consider her my biological daughter, she still has the right to know about everything, so I revealed everything to her once she grew up.

At first, she was shocked to learn that she was not my biological daughter, but she finally accepted it after I explained her parents' situation to her. She had even repeatedly searched for her father's whereabouts, but she still had not succeeded in finding him."

"Don't worry, I will help Aunt Hanzi find her father, and I will help cure him if he is still alive in such a condition." Zhang Fei then took Zhang Chen's hand and asked Mei to open the gate to earth. "I will take you back to earth now, but we will go straight to shopping to buy a lot of new clothes for you. After all, you are young again now, so you can't possibly wear your old clothes anymore."
"All right."
Moments later, they had arrived on earth, and it was already night there, so Zhang Fei took his grandmother to the best shopping mall in the city.

Although she had become young again, she was still an old woman who had many grandchildren, so Zhang Chen felt embarrassed to walk around the shopping mall with his young grandson, and the men also kept staring at her in fascination.

Zhang Fei smiled amusingly at his grandmother's awkwardness, so he pulled Zhang Chen closer and hugged her waist to make her more comfortable. This action made the people present feel jealous of him, but he couldn't care less about them.

Zhang Fei then took his grandmother to some of the best clothing stores, and he allowed Zhang Chen to choose clothes that fit his taste. Even so, she always asks for his opinion on every outfit she chooses, especially since she doesn't understand the style of today's youth.
Zhang Fei himself was not a man who thought too much about style, and he preferred to wear simple clothes, so he also chose for Zhang Chen some clothes that he thought suited him.
After they bought some clothes, and Zhang Chen had already worn one of them, Zhang Fei immediately took his grandmother to look for other items, such as hats, shoes, and several other items.
Zhang Chen herself really enjoyed her grandson's company and attention, especially since they had never done such activities with her before due to her old age, so she really enjoyed their time.

Not only that, Zhang Fei also brought his grandmother to enjoy various snacks that she had never eaten before, and they spent a lot of time like lovers, with Zhang Chen always hugging his arm while occasionally resting her head on his shoulder.

After they spent so long in the shopping mall, Zhang Fei took his grandmother to leave the place. "It's getting late, so I'll take you to Beijing now, but we'll go to the Wang House tomorrow morning, Grandma."
"Fei'er-"

"Are you hesitant to meet Wang Zetian, Grandma?" Zhang Chen nodded at Zhang Fei. "You don't have to hesitate anymore, okay? I'm with you, and I'll protect you, so they won't be able to do anything to you. Otherwise, your feelings will never settle down, and you'll keep thinking about him for the rest of your life."
Zhang Chen sighed softly and nodded to him. "All right, let's go to Beijing right now."
When he heard that, Zhang Fei immediately hugged Zhang Chen, led her to a quiet place, and used his Nine Cloud Steps to take her away to Beijing.

Since the distance from their city to Beijing was not as far as the cities in the Sky Jade Realm, they had already arrived in the city in a few minutes, and Zhang Fei immediately took his grandmother to the best hotel in the city.
At first, Zhang Fei wanted to rent two rooms, but Zhang Chen forbade him and asked him to rent only one room. He chose to follow his grandmother's wishes.
When they arrived at their room, Zhang Fei asked his grandmother to rest, and he himself immediately floated to the highest point in the hotel via the balcony.

Zhang Fei then opened his map and searched for the location of the Wang family's residence, and he had no difficulty finding them. After that, he tried to find the location of Zhang Hanzi's father, Lei Jun. Unfortunately, the country's population was too large, so he had difficulty finding him.

Zhang Fei decided to get in touch with Huang Rong, Hong Yao, and Yang Lu'er, but the three women welcomed him with complaints, particularly because he hadn't been back to Earth for more than a week and they were sorely missing him.
In the end, Zhang Fei asked the three women to gather at Yang Lu'er's penthouse tomorrow, and he also asked her to invite Zhou Ling and the others to join them.

However, Yang Lu'er told him that Tang Ziyu still hadn't returned, and she seemed to have disappeared into thin air, which made the people from her agency panic, especially since she also deliberately turned off her phone.

After the three women agreed to help him find Lei Jun's whereabouts, Zhang Fei immediately searched for Tang Ziyu's location on his map, and it was not a big deal for him, especially since they had sex before, so her location was marked with a golden dot like his wives' locations. "Japan, huh? I didn't expect Ziyu to be hiding there; no wonder they couldn't find her.
Since that wind weasel beast resides in that country, I'll go there now to catch it and meet her at the same time."

After closing the map, Zhang Fei immediately returned to the hotel room to tell his grandmother about Tang Ziyu and the wind weasel. Their relationship surprised her, especially since Tang Ziyu was one of her idol actresses and she really enjoyed her movies. Consequently, Zhang Chen asked him to pick her up immediately.

paragraphs: In an old hotel, Tang Ziyu was soaking in an open-air hot spring facing Mount Fuji, accompanied by several small bottles of sake to warm his body even more. Her eyes kept looking at the mountain, but her expression clearly showed that her mind was filled with various complicated problems, and she also repeatedly let out soft sighs.

As she thought, Tang Ziyu continued to stroke a long-tailed white weasel curled up on her right shoulder, and the weasel seemed to enjoy her caress. "Thank you for spending these two weeks with me, You Bai. I actually feel so lonely, but your presence can ease the loneliness in my heart a little."
"Chirp... Chirp..." The weasel made a small sound as it held Tang Ziyu's fingers and rubbed its head.

"Hehe." Tang Ziyu chuckled at the weasel's actions. "At first, I thought you were a wild weasel, and I was afraid that you would bite me, so I didn't dare to approach you. However, you turned out to be a tame weasel, and I felt that you seemed to be able to understand my words."
"Chirp... Chirp..."

However, I still haven't found an answer to my relationship with my husband, and I still don't have the courage to meet him, let alone divorce him." Tang Ziyu then finished the small bottle of sake before throwing it forward.

"Honestly, I like Zhang Fei so much, especially since he treated me so gently back then when we had sex. He didn't hesitate to give me stimulation and oral sex, which I never got from my husband, especially since he always treated me as a sex object that he could use whenever he wanted."

Remembering that, coupled with the heat from the water and sake, Tang Ziyu felt her body heat up. She sank her body a little deeper into the hot spring, and both hands began to rub her two private parts.
"Mhmm!" Soft moans quickly emerged from Tang Ziyu's mouth, confusing the white weasel who heard them.
However, the white weasel suddenly sensed the arrival of another person, so it turned back, donned a fierce look, hissed, and displayed its sharp fangs to Zhang Fei, who had just arrived.
Instead, Zhang Fei responded to the white weasel's attitude with a smile, but he immediately released a little of his heavenly fox aura, causing it to tremble slightly. 'Scan that beast, Mei.'

'Oh? This weasel's age and rank are no different from Hai Ma's, but Jie Yuan is older and stronger than them. However, I didn't expect to find both of them in one place, and the beast looked comfortable around Ziyu.' Zhang Fei then spoke to You Bai. 'Hey! You don't need to be so aggressive towards me; I didn't come here to cause harm to you two, but rather to bring her home.'

You Bai was stunned for a moment after hearing Zhang Fei's voice in her mind, but his heavenly fox aura made her realize that the man in front of her was a beast like her. However, she also realized that he was much stronger than her, especially since her bloodline trembled after he released his aura.

Zhang Fei then floated behind them and rubbed You Bai's little head, and he used his light element to calm her down, making her lower her guard immediately. 'You should have realized it, right? I am a beast like you, but I am a fox beast. Moreover, Ziyu is my woman, and you two seem to like each other, so I won't hurt you.'
'Are you really not going to hurt me and separate me from Ziyu?' You Bai asked with a doubtful look.

'No.' Zhang Fei shook his head at You Bai. 'If you like Ziyu that much, then I'll take you with us. After I take care of my other business, I will take you two to the new world, and you can meet the other beasts who live with me there, such as two tigresses, a hippocampus, a dragon serpent, and a golden monkey.'

Upon hearing Zhang Fei mention other beasts, You Bai's expression looked excited, particularly because she was the only one of her kind living on earth, which left her feeling perpetually lonely. That's why she approached Tang Ziyu, who also appeared lonely, and their companionship made each other happier.
'All right, I'll go with you, but you have to convince Ziyu first, because I won't go without her.'
'I'll definitely convince her, and we'll go together later.' You Bai nodded to Zhang Fei and jumped down from Tang Ziyu's shoulder.

Zhang Fei slowly floated in front of Tang Ziyu as he undressed before entering the water, but he let out a soft sigh at the sight of her self-indulgent fantasies. He then grabbed both of her hands and lifted them up, startling her. When she opened her eyes and saw his face, she was stunned.

"You... how did you find me in this place?" Tang Ziyu immediately asked after coming out of her daze, but she held back her excitement, as she was afraid that the Zhang Fei in front of her was not real but just her hallucination, especially since she missed him too much.

sentences.text: Du Ruhui looked frustrated in his room, especially since Zhang Fei ordered him to mix his pills into his clan's water source and food supplies.
However, he still couldn't do it because his family kept coming to him one by one for the past two days, especially his mother.
Du Ruhui himself did not want to do that, but Zhang Fei's demon slave mark had already been planted in his soul, so his order was absolute, and he could not refuse it. 'Damn it!
All this happened because of Tu Li's stupidity and Xuenai's betrayal!
Otherwise, I wouldn't have suffered this fate, and that bastard even ordered me to harm my own family.'

After waiting for a considerable amount of time, Du Ruhui could no longer hear the people in his clan wandering around, indicating that they had all returned to their respective rooms to rest, especially since it was already midnight.
Therefore, he immediately left his room and headed to the drinking water source behind his clan.
.net
Upon his arrival, Du Ruhui immediately took out Zhang Fei's pills, crushed them into powder, and scattered them into the water.
After that, he immediately went to his clan's kitchen, which was located nearby, and sprinkled the powders into their food supplies.
After he had done everything, Du Ruhui returned to his room with a heavy heart, especially since Zhang Fei had also ordered him to experience the effects of the pills himself.

Furthermore, Zhang Fei did not tell him about the pills' effects, but Du Ruhui was completely certain that they would be extremely deadly, especially since he obtained them from Pang Hong and Pang Gui, who were clearly members of the heretic clan. 'Damn it!
What will happen to us after this?
Will the effects of his pills cause us to die?'

Shen Xueyi gathered her loyalists in a special location under the protection of a powerful formation, particularly because they were having serious discussion about finalizing their plans to eliminate Shen Haoran and the others.
Some of them kept glancing at Shen Xueyi with strange looks, particularly after sensing Zhang Fei's yang qi in her body and realizing that she had become his partner.
However, they were also confused by that because they had never seen the two of them together before, except for one person, Lin Hao.
After they all reported everything to her, Shen Xueyi told them directly.
"Their wedding will take place in five days, and we must ensure that we wipe them out by the roots to prevent any future troubles."
"Mistress Shen, I received some unusual news before, but I feel that the incident is really strange." Shen Xueyi and the others quickly turned to Min Ren, who promptly informed them of the news.
"Previously, Hong Xuan contacted me and asked about Zhang Fei, and she suspected that he killed Ying Xiao around our sect.
However, I told her that he had left the sect three weeks ago and had not returned yet, so I thought it was impossible that he killed him."
Shen Xueyi was quite surprised to hear that, but she didn't show any reaction, especially since only a few of them knew that Zhang Fei had returned before.
The three old men, Shen Yang, Shen Hao, and Lin Hao, who knew about Zhang Fei's return, also did not show any reaction and waited for Shen Xueyi's reaction.
Shen Xueyi then asked Min Ren again.
"Have you asked Hong Xuan about the details of the incident?"
"Yes." Min Ren then relayed to them the information he received from Hong Xuan, a revelation that shocked them all because of its connection to their archenemy.
"Since Ying Xiao died and no one could find his corpse, Chu Youqian's letter never reached Shen Haoran."
Upon hearing that, Shen Xueyi and the others let out a sigh of relief, especially since their plan would fall apart if Shen Haoran found out about Shen Yu's relationship with Zhang Fei.
Just like Shen Xueyi, the three old men were also certain that Zhang Fei was the one who killed Ying Xiao.
"Then what about Chu Youqian's condition?"
Chu Youqian, according to Hong Xuan, contracted a strange disease that covered her body in purulent carbuncles and emanated a pungent odor.

Moreover, she experienced constant itching throughout her body, causing her body to be covered by scratch wounds as well." Shen Xueyi and the others raised their eyebrows after hearing Min Ren's answer, and they guessed that it was Zhang Fei who had done that to her.
"Anyway, I can confirm that the news is accurate, and multiple healers in the Duan Clan are treating her, particularly considering that her aunt, Chu Guangxi, is Duan Ling's wife."
"I see." Shen Xueyi nodded in understanding before speaking to them.
"All right, we don't need to bother with their affairs, and we just need to focus on our plans.
You guys can go back now, and we will execute our plans in five days."
"Yes, Mistress."
After that, most of them immediately left the room, but four of them stayed there, especially since they were curious about the existence of Zhang Fei's yang qi inside Shen Xueyi's body.
Shen Yang asked Shen Xueyi directly.
"Cousin, when did you dual-cultivate with Zhang Fei?"
'Tch!
I figured they'd ask that.' Shen Xueyi then responded to Shen Yang.
"Two days ago, Yu'er also agreed to our relationship."
"Huh!?" Following that, the three women let out soft cries, and Yan Luan'er asked Shen Xueyi.
"Did Zhang Fei really return to the sect two days ago?"

"He did return two days ago, and I dual-cultivated with him after he did something to Lan Zhen and Du Ruhui." Shen Yang and the three women were intrigued by his actions towards the two people, but Shen Xueyi was unable to reveal to them that he had transformed the woman into a beast due to its connection to his secret.
"He used his enslavement technique on that Du brat, and he intended to use it to destroy the Du Clan from within, which should have begun by now."
"Zhang Fei is always like that." Shi Yue made this statement while shaking her head.
"He can be very kind to people who are nice to him, but he will be a nightmare to those who are his enemies.
Du Ruhui will undoubtedly suffer greatly for destroying his own clan, and he will likely commit suicide afterwards."
Xi Zihua then spoke to them.
"At first, I couldn't believe that Zhang Fei killed Ying Xiao, especially since I knew that he left the sect a long time ago.
However, I am now convinced that he indeed killed him, and he must also have caused Chu Youqian's suffering.

In addition to them, he was also responsible for the strange behavior of Shen Tianyu and Shen Shixi, especially considering that all three of us had already experienced the effects of his abilities, and those two continued to behave like lustful beasts."
"Haha." Shen Yang laughed upon hearing the words of the two women.
"Despite his cultivation still being in the soul realm, Zhang Fei is indeed terrifying.
If it weren't for my cousin, Old Hao and I wouldn't have realized that he had brought Yu'er back to her seclusion room.
This is due to his ability to conceal his aura and presence so thoroughly, a feat that even senior cultivators like us find challenging, and we can only accomplish it with the aid of artifacts."
"So, where is Zhang Fei now?
Why didn't he meet the three of us?" Yan Luan'er asked as she pointed at Xi Zihua and Shi Yue.
"I don't know." Shen Xueyi answered with a shake of her head.
"After he left my room two days ago, Zhang Fei went straight to Yu'er's room and accompanied her for quite a while.
However, he left immediately after Shen Haoran noticed the strangeness of Shen Tianyu and Shen Shixi, so I thought he had returned to the western region by now.
Anyway, he told me that he would come to the wedding, especially since he will help us to clean them up, so you three can meet him on that day."

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Unresolved Issues
paragraphs: Duan Ling and Chu Guangxi were stunned for a moment after hearing Liu Hua's questions. "Is Zhang Fei really your husband, Second Miss Liu?"
"Yeah, Zhang Fei is indeed my husband." Liu Hua replied with a nod. "Can someone explain to us what's really going on here? Why do you all seem desperate to fight?"

"Second Miss Liu, my son died because of Chu Youqian, so I came here to seek revenge for his death, but they stopped me." Ying Feng then recounted the entire incident to the Liu Sisters, based on Wei Luan and Chu Xing's confessions to his daughter.

Given their familiarity with Zhang Fei's character, the Liu Sisters quickly deduced that he was indeed the one who killed Ying Xiao upon hearing the details, and they also believed that he was doing the same to Chu Youqian.

"Honestly, I have heard about your son's failed marriage from my second daughter, and my son-in-law revealed Ying Xiao's affair to Wei Luan when they were hunting an adult owl bear in the forest about a month ago, which started because You Han kept insulting him and his partners." Ying Feng and his family were surprised to hear Liu Qingyu's words, especially since Wei Jiang told them that he heard about the matter from Chu Xing, corroborated by the Hai Twins.

"As for Chu Youqian, I am well versed in the characteristics of those from the Eastern Chu Clan, and her character closely resembles that of her grandmother, Wang Xiaoyi. Furthermore, Zhang Lin's contract beast is indeed pretty, so it's no wonder she's eager to snatch it from her, especially since her jealousy is simply too high.
That's why I don't find it surprising if she disclosed the matter to your son and purposefully used him to send the letter to Shen Haoran.

Chu Guangxi's expression turned ugly after listening to Liu Qingyu's remarks about her niece and clan, but she couldn't refute her words, especially since she herself was familiar with the characters of her mother and niece.

However, she suddenly raised her eyebrows after listening to Chu Xing's reply, especially since the sequence of events she told her was exactly the same as Ying Sha and Hong Xuan's story. "Husband, she just replied to me, and her answer corroborated their story."

After hearing that, Duan Ling took a deep breath and looked at Ying Feng, who appeared even more eager to capture Chu Youqian. Unfortunately, he couldn't possibly hand her over to him because his parents-in-law would be furious if he did that, especially his mother-in-law, Wang Xiaoyi.

"Anyway, Chu Youqian did not lie to all of you about my son-in-law's relationship with Shen Yu, and both of us have witnessed their relationship ourselves." All of them were shocked by Liu Qingyu's revelation, including Hong Xuan, who had previously believed that there was no way they could have a relationship.

"However, you guys should not disclose their relationship to anyone else, or I will dispatch members of my Liu Clan to destroy your clans, and you all know that they are capable of doing so. Even if my father-in-law, Chu Liuxiang, steps in to save you guys, he still won't be able to save you."

All of them held their breath at Liu Qingyu's threat, and they instinctively understood that the people from the Liu Clan could indeed crush them easily, especially since they were the second largest and strongest after the Shen Clan. Finally, they nodded in agreement with her, and the two clan patriarchs ordered their people to immediately forget about it.

Liu Hua smiled faintly at seeing their reactions, and he immediately spoke to the people from the Ying Clan. "My husband is in the eastern region right now, and he has been there for three weeks, so there's no way he could have killed your son.

Furthermore, I am certain that Shen Haoran would not kill a young cultivator like him, especially with his high self-esteem, so I think the culprit is someone else. However, it is undeniable that Chu Youqian was the one responsible for Ying Xiao's death, particularly since he passed away while delivering her letter, so she should bear responsibility for his death."
"Second Miss Liu, we-"

"I just convey my opinion on this matter, but the decision is still up to you." Liu Hua interrupted Duan Ling as she turned to him, but she then glanced at the people from the Duan Clan before speaking to him. "Wouldn't it be better if you sacrificed one person for the lives of many?

If you don't hand over Chu Youqian, then this clan will be destroyed in their hands, and Chu Liuxiang will undoubtedly destroy their Ying clan after learning about the destruction of your clan. In such a scenario, the number of victims resulting from this issue will undoubtedly be substantial, right?
Our world is indeed cruel, but this is the reality of our lives: blood for blood, eyes for eyes, and life for life."
After she said that, Liu Hua turned to Liu Qingyu, who nodded at her, and the two immediately bade their farewells before leaving the Duan Clan.

Ying Feng wanted to say something to Duan Ling and Chu Guangxi, but Sun Mei'er immediately stopped him by shaking her head, especially since making such a decision was indeed not easy. Furthermore, they would face the wrath of Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi if they handed Chu Youqian over to them, which would undoubtedly complicate their decision-making process.

Chu Guangxi immediately grabbed her husband's hand and spoke to him through voice transmission. 'What should we do now? Should we hand Youqian over to them? However, my parents, my brother, and my sister-in-law will definitely be angry with us if we do that.'

Duan Ling himself found it difficult to decide on the matter, and he kept racking his brains for the best way to resolve the problem between them. However, he suddenly had an idea, so he immediately conveyed it to Ying Feng and the others. "I understand your desire to avenge your son's death, but I really can't hand Youqian over to you, especially since it would put us in a difficult situation, so-"
"You-"
"Stop it, husband." Sun Mei'er once again halted her husband before questioning Duan Ling. "Do you have any other ideas?"

"Yes." Duan Ling nodded to Sun Mei'er. "My parents-in-law will be here in two days, especially since they will be attending the wedding invitation from the Shen Clan, and we can explain the truth to them at that time. That way, they will be the ones to make decisions on this matter, and we can prevent many deaths."

After hearing that, Sun Mei'er nodded repeatedly, then turned to her husband. "Husband, I believe his idea is the most effective way to resolve this issue, because taking Chu Youqian by force would destroy both of our clans. Therefore, I believe it would be better for us to wait for Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi to reach this city."

Ying Sha herself certainly did not want to die, especially since she had some understanding of Chu Liuxiang and his Eastern Chu Clan's strength, so she also tried to persuade Ying Feng. "Dad, I agree with my mother, and we should wait for their arrival before taking the next step."
Hong Xuan also wanted to persuade Ying Feng because she didn't want Ying Sha to die, but she immediately gave up her intention and swallowed her words back, especially since she was an outsider.

After mulling over the situation, Ying Feng let out a heavy sigh and decided to accept Duan Ling's proposal. Even though he was aware that his chances of avenging his son's death would be slimmer, especially since Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi would be unlikely to be willing to hand Chu Youqian over to him, he also could not possibly sacrifice his family and clan members to fulfill it.
"All right, I agree with you, and we will discuss this matter again once they arrive in this city."

After he said that, Ying Feng immediately led his family and clan members to leave the Duan Clan, but the anger in his heart still couldn't disappear because he had not managed to take revenge for his son's death.

On the other hand, Hong Xuan, who followed behind them, kept wondering about Zhang Fei and Shen Yu's relationship, especially since she didn't know about their first meeting. However, that fact made her realize something serious, which worried her.
'Her marriage with Shen Tianyu will take place in five days, and I'm sure the situation in our sect will be completely chaotic that day, so it would be best if I stay away for a while.'

Duan Ling then instructed his clan members to disperse, guiding Chu Guangxi to their niece's room. However, he purposefully left Chu Youqian unconscious, as her incessant itching was causing her to scratch her body uncontrollably. They even had to cover her room with a special formation to prevent her body's pungent odor from spreading throughout the clan.

Chu Guangxi sighed heavily as she watched Chu Youqian's body become increasingly covered in purulent carbuncles, including her face. "What exactly happened to her? How did she get this kind of disease? We have invited many healers, but none of them can cure her. Moreover, what will happen to her?
My mother would never hand her over to the Ying Clan, but my father is different, and he might let her die in their hands."

"We have no other choice, right?" Duan Ling responded with a heavy sigh. "It's not that I don't care about Youqian, but she was too rash in meddling in other people's affairs because of her greed and jealousy.

Moreover, she already knew that Zhang Fei had such relations with the Liu and Western Chu Clans, and the Shen Clan was also the strongest clan in this region, but she still decided to pit them against each other. That's why it would be better for all of us if my father-in-law decided that way, so none of us would have to die except for her."

"Yeah, you're right." Chu Guangxi replied with a nod of agreement. "Even so, I still hope that my father won't hand Youqian over to the Ying clan, or my brother and sister-in-law will be completely devastated, especially since she's their only daughter."

"Forget it; we just need to wait for them to arrive in two days, and we will know their decision then." After that, Duan Liang took his wife out of Chu Youqian's room and returned to theirs, but none of them could sleep because the matter kept bothering their minds.
Unknowingly, it was already dawn on earth, which meant another day had passed in the Sky Jade Realm, especially since six hours on earth were equivalent to one day in that realm.

[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,400 Qi]

[Reward: 54 green jewels sent to inventory.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 240 Demons.]
[Reward: 24,000 female essences.]
The two notifications woke Zhang Fei, who was sleeping while hugging Tang Ziyu. He immediately turned to her, planting a soft kiss on her lips.

Feeling his kiss, Tang Ziyu immediately wrapped his arms around Zhang Fei's neck and returned the kiss. They continued kissing for some time before she opened her eyes. "Ugh! It's still dawn! I'm exhausted after you fucked me for so long last night."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed upon hearing that, but he immediately picked Tang Ziyu up and carried her to the bathroom. "Even so, you were completely satisfied with last night, right? Unfortunately, we have to go back to China now, especially since my grandmother is waiting in Beijing. She is one of your biggest fans, so I'm sure she will be excited to see you."
Instead, Tang Ziyu pouted her lips. "Honestly, I am ashamed to meet your family, especially since I am an old woman, but I have an affair with a young man who is not even 20 years old."

"Hehe! You don't have to worry about that, especially since I can help you become young again, and you'll be shocked to see your new appearance later." Tang Ziyu looked at Zhang Fei with raised eyebrows after she saw the mysterious smile on his face, and soon they were already in the bathroom. 'Hey, Mei, buy those two pills.'
[Yes.]
{You got Youthful Returning Pill x1}
{250,000 green jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Beauty Retaining Pill x1}
{250,000 green jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

After that, Zhang Fei took both pills and asked Tang Ziyu to swallow the youthful returning pill first, which made her curious about its effects, but she immediately did as he asked without any hesitation.

Zhang Fei then used his qi to dissolve and spread the effects of each pill throughout his body, but Tang Ziyu's process of becoming young again took longer than Zhang Chen's, especially since he was not a cultivator yet.

As he waited for the process to be completed, Zhang Fei thought about his next plans for Chu Youqian, particularly after the Liu Sisters informed his clone about the incident at the Duan Clan. 'Unfortunately, Ying Feng doesn't have the guts to force Duan Ling to hand her over to him, so I have to take care of her myself.
Furthermore, there were four days left before Yu'er and Shen Tianyu's wedding, so I had to get back there before midnight and take care of her at the same time.'

Furthermore, they would face the wrath of Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi if they handed Chu Youqian over to them, which would undoubtedly complicate their decision-making process.
Chu Guangxi immediately grabbed her husband's hand and spoke to him through voice transmission. 'What should we do now?
Should we hand Youqian over to them?
However, my parents, my brother, and my sister-in-law will definitely be angry with us if we do that.'
Duan Ling himself found it difficult to decide on the matter, and he kept racking his brains for the best way to resolve the problem between them.
However, he suddenly had an idea, so he immediately conveyed it to Ying Feng and the others.
"I understand your desire to avenge your son's death, but I really can't hand Youqian over to you, especially since it would put us in a difficult situation, so-"
"You-"
"Stop it, husband." Sun Mei'er once again halted her husband before questioning Duan Ling.
"Do you have any other ideas?"
"Yes." Duan Ling nodded to Sun Mei'er.
"My parents-in-law will be here in two days, especially since they will be attending the wedding invitation from the Shen Clan, and we can explain the truth to them at that time.
That way, they will be the ones to make decisions on this matter, and we can prevent many deaths."
After hearing that, Sun Mei'er nodded repeatedly, then turned to her husband.
"Husband, I believe his idea is the most effective way to resolve this issue, because taking Chu Youqian by force would destroy both of our clans.
Therefore, I believe it would be better for us to wait for Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi to reach this city."
Ying Sha herself certainly did not want to die, especially since she had some understanding of Chu Liuxiang and his Eastern Chu Clan's strength, so she also tried to persuade Ying Feng.
"Dad, I agree with my mother, and we should wait for their arrival before taking the next step."
Hong Xuan also wanted to persuade Ying Feng because she didn't want Ying Sha to die, but she immediately gave up her intention and swallowed her words back, especially since she was an outsider.
After mulling over the situation, Ying Feng let out a heavy sigh and decided to accept Duan Ling's proposal.

Even though he was aware that his chances of avenging his son's death would be slimmer, especially since Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi would be unlikely to be willing to hand Chu Youqian over to him, he also could not possibly sacrifice his family and clan members to fulfill it.
"All right, I agree with you, and we will discuss this matter again once they arrive in this city."

After he said that, Ying Feng immediately led his family and clan members to leave the Duan Clan, but the anger in his heart still couldn't disappear because he had not managed to take revenge for his son's death.
On the other hand, Hong Xuan, who followed behind them, kept wondering about Zhang Fei and Shen Yu's relationship, especially since she didn't know about their first meeting.
However, that fact made her realize something serious, which worried her.
'Her marriage with Shen Tianyu will take place in five days, and I'm sure the situation in our sect will be completely chaotic that day, so it would be best if I stay away for a while.'
Duan Ling then instructed his clan members to disperse, guiding Chu Guangxi to their niece's room.
However, he purposefully left Chu Youqian unconscious, as her incessant itching was causing her to scratch her body uncontrollably.
They even had to cover her room with a special formation to prevent her body's pungent odor from spreading throughout the clan.
Chu Guangxi sighed heavily as she watched Chu Youqian's body become increasingly covered in purulent carbuncles, including her face.
"What exactly happened to her?
How did she get this kind of disease?
We have invited many healers, but none of them can cure her.
Moreover, what will happen to her?
My mother would never hand her over to the Ying Clan, but my father is different, and he might let her die in their hands."
"We have no other choice, right?" Duan Ling responded with a heavy sigh.
"It's not that I don't care about Youqian, but she was too rash in meddling in other people's affairs because of her greed and jealousy.

Moreover, she already knew that Zhang Fei had such relations with the Liu and Western Chu Clans, and the Shen Clan was also the strongest clan in this region, but she still decided to pit them against each other.
That's why it would be better for all of us if my father-in-law decided that way, so none of us would have to die except for her."
"Yeah, you're right." Chu Guangxi replied with a nod of agreement.
"Even so, I still hope that my father won't hand Youqian over to the Ying clan, or my brother and sister-in-law will be completely devastated, especially since she's their only daughter."
