chapters.title: Chapter 293: Wang Zetian
paragraphs: [Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,500 Qi]
[Reward: 55 green jewels.]
A new notification appeared in Zhang Fei's mind as the sun shone into their room, but he ignored it and watched Tang Ziyu, who stood frozen in front of the bathroom mirror.

Zhang Fei then hugged Tang Ziyu from behind, looked at her through the mirror, and stuffed the beauty retaining pill into her mouth, which she happily swallowed. "See? You are no longer an old woman, and you are no different from a woman in her early twenties. However, with your current appearance, you might not be able to return to the entertainment world.
People in this world will be shocked by your appearance, and they will pester you to discover the secret."

Tang Ziyu nodded at Zhang Fei, turning to face him while wrapping her arms around his neck. "Honestly, it is hard for me to leave the entertainment world that gave me so many things, but I have decided to be your wife. As a wife, I have to stay by my husband's side, and you live in another world, so I decided to leave everything behind and follow you into that world."
"Are you really okay with that, Ziyu?"

"Yes." Tang Ziyu nodded to Zhang Fei. "After ten years of marriage, I failed to find happiness in my marriage, so I immersed myself in the entertainment world to alleviate the sadness and loneliness in my heart. However, everything has changed, and I believe that you will give me a better life and happiness that I have longed for for so long, so I don't mind leaving it for a better future."
Zhang Fei was truly satisfied with Tang Ziyu's answer, and he then lifted her chin before kissing her lips. "Don't worry, you will never regret making this decision."
"I believe in you." Tang Ziyu then pulled Zhang Fei into the shower. "Let's take a bath; we can't let your grandma wait for us for too long."

Sometime later, they had arrived at the hotel, and Zhang Chen was ecstatic to see Tang Ziyu. However, she couldn't help but steal a glance at her grandson, especially since her idol actress had returned to her youthful appearance.
"Aunt Chen, I-"

"All right, you don't have to say anything." Zhang Chen stopped Tang Ziyu and grabbed her hand. "Originally, I was surprised to hear about your relationship with my grandson, but he has told me a lot about you, and he himself has many wives by his side, so I have no problem with the relationship between you two.
Instead, I am happy that he has taken you away from your husband, especially considering how poorly he has treated you."
Tang Ziyu was relieved to hear that, and she immediately hugged Zhang Chen. "Thank you, Aunt Chen."

Not only was Zhang Fei happy, but You Bai, who was lying on his head, was also happy for Tang Ziyu and herself, especially since he would take her away to another realm soon, and she was looking forward to meeting the other beasts.

After a while, Zhang Fei spoke to the two women. "Let's check out of this hotel, and I'll take you two to the Wang House first. Then, we will meet Ziyu's husband to end their marriage, and I will send you two to the Sky Jade Realm after that."

"I didn't expect that you were Wang Zetian's grandson, Fei'er." Tang Ziyu commented as she observed the Wang residence. "I met him twice a few years ago, and he was actually a nice guy, even though he always looked serious and stern."

Zhang Fei just smiled upon hearing that, especially since Zhang Hai did not know that Wang Zetian was his father. "I only found out about our relationship yesterday after forcing my grandmother to tell me everything; otherwise, I would never have known that he was my grandfather.
Honestly, I was disappointed because he chose his family status over her, but I didn't blame him for taking such a decision, especially since life at that time was not easy."

Zhang Fei then led the two women to the residence, but Zhang Chen hugged his right arm tightly as her body stiffened. After all, her last meeting with Wang Zetian was half a century ago, but today she will meet her first love, who is also the father of her son, after so long.
Moreover, Zhang Chen's appearance has significantly changed, and she is worried that her ex-lover will be shocked upon seeing her.
"Relax, Grandma." Zhang Fei spoke softly as he rubbed Zhang Chen's hands. "I'm by your side now, and I won't let anything bad happen to you or my grandpa."

"I know you'll protect me, but I'm afraid that Zetian will be shocked by my appearance." Zhang Fei naturally knew that, so he assured Zhang Chen not to worry about it. After she inhaled and exhaled a few times, she led them with firm steps towards the residence. "Let's go; I'll just talk to him for a while, and we'll go see Ziyu's husband afterwards."
When they arrived at the residence's gate, two men dressed in military uniforms immediately stopped them, and they asked the three of them to provide their identification cards.
The two men were shocked after they read their identity cards, especially when they read Zhang Chen and Tang Ziyu's, especially since their photos on them were old, but they were so young now.

Zhang Fei silently activated his demon eyes before speaking to the two men. "Tell Wang Zetian that Zhang Chen came here to see him, and she just wants to talk to him for a while, so we won't waste too much of his time."

"All... all right..." One of them answered with a stutter and called into the house through their post's intercom. He informed the person inside about their arrival, but the other person, particularly after hearing Zhang Chen's name, asked him to chase them out.

After all, Zhang Fei's five senses were too sharp, so he could clearly hear the person's answer, which made him furious. He then grabbed their identity cards, quickly led the two women into the residence, and explained the person's words to them.
"Wait! Stop! You can't go in there!" The two men shouted as they chased after them, but Zhang Fei immediately waved his hand, causing them to fall to the ground, unconscious.
When she saw that, Zhang Chen panicked, fearing that her grandson might harm Wang Zetian and his family. "Fei'er, we-"

"Don't worry, Grandma. I will take you to see Wang Zetian, and I won't let anyone stop us." After he said that, Zhang Fei brought the two women to the residence's main building using his teleportation. Despite his anger at the person's words, he remained composed and refrained from making a scene, while Tang Ziyu promptly pressed the residence bell.
*Clack...*

Soon, a middle-aged man in his late forties opened the door for them, but he immediately pointed a gun at Zhang Fei. "I have asked my guards to chase you out, but you insist on trespassing on my residence, so I have the right to kill you."

"Is that so?" With a slight smirk, Zhang Fei asked, pulling his right hand out of Zhang Chen's embrace before grabbing the gun and pressing it against his forehead. "You want to kill me, right? I dare you to shoot me, but I assure you that you will suffer if you do."

Zhang Chen wanted to say something, but Tang Ziyu immediately grabbed her hand and pulled her back a few steps as she whispered to her. 'Aunt Chen, you have to trust him; I believe he won't do anything excessive.'

Unfortunately, Tang Ziyu did not fully understand Zhang Fei's character, so she did not know that he could be so cruel when facing problems that concerned him and those closest to him. He had even killed his own big brother with his own hands, not to mention the many other people he had killed on earth and in the Sky Jade Realm.

Zhang Chen didn't say anything in response to Tang Ziyu, but she kept looking at Zhang Fei while clasping her hands together. 'Fei'er! Please don't kill him; he is still your grandfather's descendant.'

'This idiot!' The middle-aged man was truly shocked by Zhang Fei's actions, especially considering that he had only intended to scare him into leaving. Instead, he challenged him to shoot him. He tried to remove his gun, but his grip was too strong. 'Damn it! How can he have such a strong grip?'

"Don't you have the guts to do it? Anyway, let me help you; you can shoot me directly." Zhang Fei then grabbed the gun's hammer and pulled it down. "See? Now you just need to pull the trigger and shoot me; it should be easy for you, right?"
'Madman! This guy is truly a mandman!' The middle-aged man screamed in his heart as he kept trying to pull back his gun.

"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted softly and covered his forehead with qi. He used his aura to move the man's finger, causing the gun to immediately fire its bullet, which shocked the two women and the other people in the residence.
*Bam*
*Thud*

The middle-aged man instantly released his gun and fell on his buttocks, and his eyes widened in shock as his body trembled violently; even urine began to wet his pants. After all, Zhang Fei was still standing straight in front of him, even though he shot him from such close range, and not a drop of blood was dripping from his forehead.

"Honestly, I came here just to reunite my grandma with Wang Zetian, but you insulted us and threatened me instead." Zhang Fei then clenched the gun in his hand, shattering it into two pieces, and hurled it between the middle-aged man's legs, causing his face to turn pale and cold sweat to drench his body.

"Normally, I would kill anyone who dared to threaten me, but I don't want to dirty this place today because this will be their first meeting after half a century, so you should be thankful that you are still alive. However, if you dare to do the same thing again one day, then I will make you choose death over life."
*Drap... Drap...*

Hearing several rapid footsteps, Zhang Fei immediately looked up at their owner. He saw a middle-aged woman running hurriedly, followed by a young man and a young woman, who were about the same age as him or his big sister.

However, Zhang Fei did not pay attention to them, and his gaze was more focused on the old man walking at the very back. Although Wang Zetian was already 82 years old, his body still looked healthy, and he could even walk upright without the support of a walker or a person.
"Husband!"
"Father!"
The three people shouted loudly as they helped the middle-aged man up. The young man wanted to shout at Zhang Fei, but Wang Zhentian stopped him, and his eyes did not move from his grandson's face.
However, Tang Ziyu's bringing Zhang Chen forward immediately diverted Wang Zetian's gaze, filling his expression with a variety of complex feelings, including longing, regret, guilt, and many more.
Even though they had not met for half a century, Wang Zetian could never forget the face of his first love, but he was confused by Zhang Chen's youthful appearance.
As he continued to stare at her, Wang Zetian staggered to Zhang Chen before reaching out her cheeks, and Tang Ziyu immediately moved aside so as not to disturb them.
Unknowingly, tears fell from Wang Zetian's old eyes as he asked her. "Is this really you, Chen'er? I can never forget this face of yours; it reminds me of our first meeting decades ago."

After hearing the nickname and observing Wang Zetian's reaction, the middle-aged woman and her two children realized that the woman in front of him was his ex-lover, whom he had been forced to leave in the past, particularly because his wife had frequently told them about Zhang Chen.
Since her husband's condition looked bad and he was frightened, the middle-aged woman asked her son to help her carry him away to their room.

However, the young woman did not leave her spot, and she repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei, who had moved to Tang Ziyu's side while hugging his waist. 'Huh? Isn't she a well-known actress? How could she be so young? Could it be that she had plastic surgery to restore her youth? Could the young man be this granny's grandson?
Moreover, this granny is also as young as me, making me doubt that she is my grandpa's ex-lover.'

Zhang Chen let out a soft sigh before grabbing Wang Zetian's hands and pressing them to her cheeks. "It's me, Brother Zetian. We haven't met for five decades, and I'm glad that we still have the chance to meet each other."

Instead of responding to her, Wang Zetian drew her into his embrace and let out a loud, mixed-feeling cry, which further complicated Zhang Chen's emotions. However, she instantly returned the hug, sobbing in his arms.
'Hey, they seem to really love each other.'

'That's true.' Zhang Fei replied with a nod of agreement before turning his attention elsewhere. He saw an old woman standing by the window as she rubbed her watery eyes. He knew that she was Wang Zetian's wife, but he sensed something unusual about her. 'Can you feel that, Mei?'

After hearing the nickname and observing Wang Zetian's reaction, the middle-aged woman and her two children realized that the woman in front of him was his ex-lover, whom he had been forced to leave in the past, particularly because his wife had frequently told them about Zhang Chen.
Since her husband's condition looked bad and he was frightened, the middle-aged woman asked her son to help her carry him away to their room.
However, the young woman did not leave her spot, and she repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei, who had moved to Tang Ziyu's side while hugging his waist. 'Huh?
Isn't she a well-known actress?
How could she be so young?
Could it be that she had plastic surgery to restore her youth?
Could the young man be this granny's grandson?
Moreover, this granny is also as young as me, making me doubt that she is my grandpa's ex-lover.'
Zhang Chen let out a soft sigh before grabbing Wang Zetian's hands and pressing them to her cheeks.
"It's me, Brother Zetian.
We haven't met for five decades, and I'm glad that we still have the chance to meet each other."
Instead of responding to her, Wang Zetian drew her into his embrace and let out a loud, mixed-feeling cry, which further complicated Zhang Chen's emotions.
However, she instantly returned the hug, sobbing in his arms.
'Hey, they seem to really love each other.'
'That's true.' Zhang Fei replied with a nod of agreement before turning his attention elsewhere.
He saw an old woman standing by the window as she rubbed her watery eyes.
He knew that she was Wang Zetian's wife, but he sensed something unusual about her. 'Can you feel that, Mei?'

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Dou Luotian
paragraphs: [Master, that old woman is unique; I will show you her status now.]
'Show me.'
Name: Dou Luotian
Gender: Female
Race: Half-Human, Half-Winged Race
Rank: lower order
Element: Light
Physique: Half-Human, Half-Winged Race
Abilities: healing light, rejuvenation, angelic protection, etc.
Strong: Light
Weak: Darkness
'Hmm? Wnged-race are angels, right, Mei?'
[Yes, Master. Earthlings call them angels, but cultivators call them the winged race.]

I see.' Zhang Fei responded with a slight nod, but he was still surprised that Wang Zetian's wife was a descendant of a human and an angel, and she even had healing and rejuvenating abilities. 'It's no surprise that they are still healthy despite their advanced age; it turns out she is a mix breed and possesses such abilities. Do you have any information about their rank?'

[The winged race has several ranks, dividing the low level into three categories: lower order, middle order, and high order. The middle level is divided into: first order, second order, and third order. The top level is also divided into three: power, virtue, and dominance. The throne is the last and highest.]
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment after hearing that. 'So the lower order is equivalent to the lesser demon, and the throne is equivalent to the demon emperor, right?'

[Yes, master. Although Dou Luotian has the winged race bloodline, her bloodline power is only equivalent to that of the lesser demon, so she cannot maintain her youth, unlike the winged race at the middle and top levels.]

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, especially since demons are no different from them, and cultivators can also maintain their youth as their strength increases. 'Her existence makes me even more curious to go to the Tian Realm, but I will not go there in the near future, especially since I still have many matters on hand, and I still have to increase my strength.'
Wang Zetian finally let go of Zhang Chen and wiped away her tears, followed by his own. He then turned to his grandson, but was slightly surprised to see Tang Ziyu. "You're Miss Ziyu, right?"
When Tang Ziyu heard that, she laughed softly. "Haha! I'm glad that someone like you still remembers me, Mr. Wang."
"Although I'm this old, I'm not senile, and I always remember the identities of people I've met before." Wang Zetian then asked his grandson. "You are Hai'er's second son, Zhang Fei, right?"

"Hmm?" After hearing that, Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows, but he remembered that his grandfather was one of the most influential people in their country, and his influence was even greater than that of Yang Hao and Huang Rong. "I didn't expect that you would use your influence to monitor us, old man."

"Haha." Wang Zetian laughed at Zhang Fei's reply. "I know quite a lot about you, including your relationships with Hong Yao, Huang Rong, Yang Lu'er, and several other women. Besides that, I also know about your other deeds against Zhang He and the Qin family."
Zhang Fei immediately stood up from his seat and glanced at Duo Luotian before asking his grandfather. "Did your wife tell you all that, old man?"

"You seem to know my wife's secret, huh?" Wang Zetian said as he also looked at Duo Luotian. "You are right; she was the one who told me everything, but she does not have that kind of ability, and someone else told her those matters."

Suddenly, Zhang Fei pulled his grandmother behind him, confusing Zhang Chen, and he immediately stood right in front of Wang Zentian with a serious expression. "Old man, you may be my grandfather, but I don't like it when other people pry into our personal lives. I don't know why that person is watching us, but you should tell him or her to stop.
Otherwise, I will stop that person myself, and I guarantee that you guys won't like it."
"Hey! You-"

"Zhuxian , you don't need to interfere in this; go inside right now." Wang Zuxian frowned at Zhang Fei for a moment before following Wang Zetian's orders and going back inside. "No one has dared to challenge me for the past few decades, so I must admit that your courage is far greater than mine or your father's, and you even dare to do those things without the slightest hesitation."

"That's for sure, old man." Zhang Fei replied to his grandfather with a shake of his head. "Unlike you, I am a man of my own will, and I will never let others control my life. No matter who they are, I will destroy them if they intend to control my life; even people of your wife's race won't be able to stop me."
Wang Zetian let out a soft sigh before nodding to Zhang Fei. "All right, I don't want to have any trouble with my own grandson, so I'll ask that person to stop monitoring you guys."
"That's good." Zhang Fei then turned to Zhang Chen. "Grandma, I won't disturb your reunion with him, so I'll take Zhiyi to meet her husband, and I'll pick you up later."

After she agreed, Zhang Fei took Tang Ziyu to leave the Wang residence, and Zhang Chen immediately spoke to Wang Zetian. "I hope you don't take his attitude to heart, brother. For the past two years, Fei'er has experienced a lot of suffering in her life, and the incident that happened two months ago has changed her character to some extent.

Even so, he is still a good man, and he has always cared for all of us. However, he will not hesitate to be cruel to those who have malicious intentions toward him and us, just as he did when he killed He'er."

Wang Zetian nodded at Zhang Chen, indicating understanding. "To be frank, I requested that person monitor you guys because I was feeling remorse about you and our son. I've always wanted to meet you guys in person, but I'm too weak compared to our grandson, and I never had the courage to do so."

"It's okay; you don't have to think about that because we have a better life now, and Fei'er will make our lives even better in the future." Zhang Chen then looked towards Dou Luotian's room. "Why don't you invite your wife to join us?"

"My wife already knows that you will be here, and she didn't want to disturb our reunion." Wang Zetian then led Zhang Chen on a walk around the garden. "Anyway, what exactly happened to you and Tang Ziyu? How could you two be this young now?"

"This is thanks to our grandson, but I can't tell you the truth without Fei'er's permission." Zhang Chen then asked Wang Zetian back. "Who exactly is your wife? How could she and her family have such abilities?"
"Have you ever heard the tales of demons, angels, and gods?"
"Yes." Zhang Chen nodded to Wang Zetian. "Actually, I have met demons myself, so I believe that angels and gods really exist."

Wang Zetian was not surprised to hear Zhang Chen's answer, especially since he had already obtained a lot of information about them, including about Zhang Fei. "According to my wife, our world is connected to three other worlds called Diyu, Tian, and Xian. These three are the residences of demons, angels, and gods.

As for my wife, she is a mixed breed between a human and an angel, commonly referred to as nephilim. Despite the fact that she is not a complete angel, she still inherited the abilities of an angel, and she is the one who helped me become who I am today."

Zhang Chen was not surprised about the three realms, especially since she had heard about them from Zhang Fei and the two Dryads. She then stopped walking and faced Wang Zetian, telling him directly about the decision she had made long ago. "Honestly, I didn't want to come here, but Fei'er forced me to meet you because he knew that my feelings would never be at ease until I met you again.
However, today will be our last meeting, and we will never meet again in the future, especially since I have decided to follow wherever our grandson goes."
"What do you mean by that? Where are you guys going?" Wang Zetian asked with a raised eyebrow.

Zhang Chen sighed softly before responding to Wang Zetian's questions with additional ones. "Didn't that person watch over us? So that person should have told you about our frequent disappearances, right?"

"That's right." Wang Zetian replied with a nod. "Honestly, I'm curious about that myself, especially since that person also told us about our grandson's other identity. Does that imply that he's going to take you to the Diyu Realm?"

"No." Zhang Chen shook her head at Wang Zetian. "Since the person you sent to monitor us came from the Tian Realm, you should know that humans won't be able to stay in the Diyu Realm for too long, or they will become demons like them. Anyway, Fei'er forbade me from revealing it to anyone else, so I won't tell you the details for everyone's sake, and I hope you can understand that."

"All right, I understand." Wang Zetian responded with a gentle sigh. "Though I'm sad I won't be able to see you again, I'll always hope for the best for you and others. As for our son, I know that his mental condition is awful after he lost a lot of things in his life, so I have ordered people to provide the best care for him."
"Thank you, Brother."

After that, Zhang Chen and Wang Zetian did not talk about those things anymore, and they preferred to reminisce about their past. After all, their time together was not much longer, especially since Zhang Fei would send her back to the Sky Jade Realm soon, and she had also decided not to return to earth anymore.
Zhang Fei had already brought Tang Ziyu back home, and her lawyer was already waiting nearby, so she led them into the house.

Tang Ziyu's lawyer was shocked when he saw the changes in her, but he didn't intend to ask her anything, especially since their relationship was only a professional one, and he thought that she had disappeared for so long to have plastic surgery.
When they arrived at the main door, they discovered that Tang Ziyu's husband had brought another woman into the house, and they could also hear the woman's moans from outside.
Hearing that, You Bai, who was previously lying on Zhang Fei's head, immediately jumped onto Tang Ziyu's shoulder and rubbed her head against her cheeks to comfort her.
*Bam*

The two people were shocked when Zhang Fei blasted the house door open, and they were even more shocked when they saw Tang Ziyu walking in while glaring at them, especially after she found out the identity of the woman who was with her husband.
When he saw them, Tang Ziyu's husband immediately got off the sofa and covered his lower body, as did the woman, particularly after she caught sight of Zhang Fei and the lawyer.

"I didn't expect that you would also have an affair with him, Dugu Yuexia." Tang Ziyu then hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "Anyway, I've found someone who truly loves me, so I'll divorce Song Yun today, and you can share him with his other mistresses."
Dugu Yuexia was stunned by Tang Ziyu's words, but Song Yun immediately rejected her wishes. "I refuse! I will never divorce you, and you will be my wife for the rest of your life."

"Do you think you can refuse?" Song Yun frowned at Zhang Fei and wanted to curse him, but he immediately moved in front of him and strangled his neck, causing his face to turn red from his strong choking.
"Stop!" Dugu Yuexia shouted and wanted to help Song Yun, but Zhang Fei immediately restricted her movements as he used his demon eyes, causing her to tremble and become dizzy.
Zhang Fei then looked at Song Yun again. "Trash like you is not worthy of Ziyu, so you better fulfill her request to divorce you, or I will make your life a living hell."
"You- Ugh"
Zhang Fei stopped Song Yun and strangled his neck even more forcefully. "If it wasn't for Ziyu, I would have sent you to hell."
*Bam*
"Argh!" Song Yun screamed in pain as Zhang Fei slammed her in front of Tang Ziyu, but she didn't have time to get up as he immediately moved to his side and stepped on his back. "Argh!"
"Fei'er, please stop it." Tang Ziyu begged with a soft sigh.
"Don't worry, I won't kill him." Zhang Fei then said to the lawyer. "Hey, take out those documents, so this trash can sign them directly."

"All... right..." The lawyer wiped the sweat off his forehead before taking out some documents, as he did not expect that Zhang Fei would treat Song Yun so harshly, making him wonder about his identity.
"Sign them!"
"Argh!" Song Yun screamed in pain again. "Please! Stop it! I'll sign them now!"

Tang Ziyu felt relieved once Song Yun started signing those documents, and she immediately told his lawyer. "I'll leave the rest to you, and you can also help me take care of my resignation from the entertainment world."

Although he was shocked to hear her decision, the lawyer still nodded in agreement with her. Zhang Fei then helped Tang Ziyu pack up her personal belongings before taking her away from the house, but he didn't take her straight to the Wang House, and he took her somewhere else to freshen up her mood.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Conversation
paragraphs: As she watched her husband and Zhang Chen, Dou Luotian asked the man who had just walked out of the portal that appeared on the wall of her room. "What do you think of Zhang Fei, Micah? Do you think he can help us fight them?"

"Zhang Fei isn't bad, and he may be our key to stopping them. However, I feel something different from him, and he seems to be more terrifying than we imagined." Micah then took out a sheepskin scroll, handing it to Dou Luotian.

"Those people have already started to move, and I heard that Janette has fallen into the hands of the Amaris Twins, so we need to act faster before they can absorb the power of the demon lord seed in her body. Otherwise, chaos will ensue, and they may take over the Diyu Realm."

"Hmm?" Dou Luotian raised her eyebrows as she read the text on the scroll. "Although I don't know Zhang Fei personally, I feel that he is not reckless but rather cunning and calculating, and he seems cautious in his actions. Janette had previously stayed by his side, and she was the one who brought him to the Diyu Realm, so he wouldn't be that calm if she fell into their hands."
Micah asked her directly. "Do you think that the Janette in the hands of the Amaris Twins is fake? In fact, Theo didn't see her in person; he heard about it from the white Amaris."

"For now, that's my guess, and we need more information to confirm." Dou Luotian then turned to face Micah before continuing. "However, I have a hunch that my guess is correct, and the only person who can give us an answer is Zhang Fei."
"Are you thinking of talking to Zhang Fei directly?"

"Yes." Dou Luotian replied with a nod. "I'm not sure if he'd be willing to meet and talk to us, especially after his reaction to my husband earlier, but we should still try to talk to him. After all, this matter will affect not only the future of the Tian and Diyu realms but also the future of the human realm, and I do not want my descendants to live in misery under their oppression."
Micah nodded in agreement with that. "In that case, we have to meet Zhang Fei now, or he will disappear again, and we don't know when he will come back here."
After she sent a message to her husband, Dou Luotian immediately left the Wang residence, and Micah flew with her towards Zhang Fei's location.

Zhang Fei, who was accompanying Tang Ziyu to lighten her mood, raised his eyebrows, particularly because he had used his senses to monitor Dou Luotian, allowing him to hear her conversation with Micah. 'It seems that something happened in the Tian Realm, and it might be related to the disappearance of the first demon lord, which is also the reason Oz faked his disappearance.'
Noticing Zhang Fei's expression, Tang Ziyu immediately asked him. "What are you thinking about, Fei'er?"

"Two guests are coming soon, but we can't talk to them in this place, and we have to find a quiet place to talk to them." Without asking further, Tang Ziyu let Zhang Fei take her to a quiet place where almost no one passed by.

Not long after they arrived there, Tang Ziyu was surprised by the appearance of Micah, who had just landed with Dou Luotian, and he stole a glance at Zhang Fei while muttering in his heart. 'I shouldn't have been surprised by the angel's presence, especially since Fei'er himself is an incubus."
"Zhang Fei, I want to talk to you, and this matter is very serious." Dou Luotian spoke directly without beating around the bush.

"I know the matter you want to talk to me about." Dou Luotian and Micah were surprised to hear Zhang Fei's reply. "I am indeed one of the earthlings, but their futures and lives are none of my business, especially since I don't know them, and they must be responsible for their own lives.
However, I am quite interested in matters in the Tian Realm, and I guess some of those winged races want to rebel, right?"

Dou Luotian let out a soft sigh and nodded to Zhang Fei. "Honestly, the situation in the Tian realm is no longer like it was in the past, especially after the first demon lord obtained the ten demon lord seeds. The higher-ups have always been afraid of his strength, and their ambition to eliminate the demons has grown stronger.

Their ambition extends beyond conquering the Diyu Realm; they also aspire to seize control of the Xian and Human Realms, and they have already made preparations for this. Many of us oppose their decision, particularly because it will disrupt the balance between the four realms.
The people of the Xian Realm will be unable to remain silent, which could lead to great chaos in the human realm if the battle between them erupts.
"Let me ask you one thing."
"What do you want to ask us?"
"Is the first demon lord in your race's hands?"
"No." Micah responded to Zhang Fei with a head shake. "My higher-ups did plan to capture the first demon lord, but they never managed to do it."

Micah's answer made Zhang Fei look at them doubtfully, especially since Oz suspected that the disappearance of the first demon lord had something to do with the people of the Tian and Xian Realms, and he also suspected that there was a traitor among the twelve rulers. "If he is not in your hands, then where is he now? Are the Amaris Twins part of their plan?"

"Only the white Amaris." Zhang Fei nodded slightly after Micah said that, which confirmed Oz's suspicions about him. "Our higher-ups gave her something to use against the first demon lord, and they found it in a very ancient place, but that place no longer exists because they destroyed it.
Anyway, I don't know for sure about that thing, but I heard that it swallowed him and sent him to another place, so no one knows about his whereabouts."
'Hey, Mei, does the winged race have such an item? Or is that thing perhaps an artifact belonging to an ancient cultivator who once lived on earth?'

[Master, I think the winged race in the Tian Realm should have been cultivators in the past, but after the Qi disappeared, they may have become non-cultivators, like the demons in the Diyu Realm. If this is indeed the case, they should have numerous artifacts, one of which they used against the first demon lord.]
'If they have such artifacts, how can they activate them without Qi?'
[Master, not all artifacts require Qi, and many of them can be used with other sources, such as jewels or others.]
'I see.' Zhang Fei then asked them again. "Who is the leader of the rebels?"

Dou Luotian shook her head at Zhang Fei. "For now, I won't tell you that person's identity, especially since it would jeopardize our plans if they found out his identity. However, I can assure you that he cares deeply about other living beings, be they demons or humans, so he founded the rebel group to stop their plans."

Zhang Fei frowned after hearing that. "To be frank, I am not interested in the problems among you, especially since I still have a lot of problems myself, and my enemies are much stronger than the people from the four realms. Even so, I still have interests on earth, so if they dare to cause chaos here, I might take action.
However, I will not directly be involved in these issues, and I will only intervene if the situation becomes truly chaotic.
Despite Zhang Fei's response not meeting their expectations, they expressed relief that he was willing to act. Micah then asked him. "Can you show us your true strength?"
"Do you doubt me?" Zhang Fei posed this question as he activated his cultivation and used his killing intent to suppress Micah.
Not only Micah, but Dou Luotian also looked trembling after Zhang Fei did that, and sweat began to pour down their bodies.

Fortunately, Zhang Fei immediately retracted both of them, and he then said to them. "For now, my strength may still not be enough to fight your higher-ups, but I can tell you that I have people who are much stronger than me, and some of them can stop those people."

"All right, I understand, and I hope you are really willing to help us if a big mess happens here." Zhang Fei did not respond to Dou Luotian's words. "Anyway, is Janette in the hands of the Amaris Twins a fake?"

"Oh?" Zhang Fei was a little surprised by her question. "I didn't expect that you could also get information from the Diyu Realm, but you are right that the Janette in their hands is a fake, and the real her is with my wives now."

"That's good." Dou Luotian and Micah felt relieved after hearing that, especially since they were worried that the Amaris Twins had managed to absorb the power of the demon lord seed in Janette's body.

"Anyway, you don't have to worry about the Amaris Twins, especially since I will do something to them soon." Dou Luotian and Micah looked at Zhang Fei with curious looks, especially since they knew that the twins were very strong, and their higher-ups also supported the white Amaris. "Haha! You guys don't have to look at me like that, and I'm not doing this for anyone else.
I have my own goals for the twins, and you'll find out the results soon."

Dou Luotian and Micah could only sigh in their hearts because Zhang Fei did not want to open up to them, but Micah then told him. "Anyway, the white Amaris often contacts one of them, and the person who usually goes to see her is Theo."
"All right, leave that matter to me, and I'll do something about Theo too." After they talked about a few other things, Micah immediately took Dou Luotian away from that place.
Tang Ziyu, who had been silently listening to them all along, finally asked Zhang Fei. "Are you really going to help them?"
"Not really." Zhang Fei replied while hugging Tang Ziyu's waist. "You know what? I am a selfish person, and I have no concern for the safety or lives of others.

However, my safety and the safety of all of you are different, so I will do whatever it takes to ensure that we can live safely and peacefully, even if it means staining my hands with blood from all living creatures, whether they are humans, demons, angels, or beasts.
"Does that mean you've killed a lot?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then told Tang Ziyu the truth about the identities of the people he had killed, which not only shocked her but also shocked You Bai. "Honestly, I never intended to kill Zhang He, especially since he was my big brother, and I had given him several opportunities to change.
Unfortunately, he never wanted to change, and instead he conspired with many others to kill me, so I was forced to kill him."
"Then what about the other people?"

Zhang Fei immediately hugged Tang Ziyu. "You may think that I'm cruel, but the world of cultivation is much crueler than you can imagine. Despite not knowing each other, many of them attempted to kill me, motivated by their greed and jealousy. That's why I killed everyone who came to kill me, and I will continue to do so to ensure our safety.
As for the demons, I haven't killed a single one of them, and I've only taken down numerous demon beasts. I might start killing them soon, but I will only kill those who try to kill me first."

Tang Ziyu couldn't comment on that matter, especially since he himself wasn't a cultivator yet, so his knowledge of the cultivation world was almost non-existent. "Fei'er, you must always take good care of yourself, okay? You already have me and the others, and we would be sad if something bad happened to you."

"That's for sure." Zhang Fei kissed Tang Ziyu's lips briefly before continuing. "I also want to continue living with all of you, and I want to have children with all of you in the future, so I will definitely take good care of myself."

Hearing Zhang Fei mention children, Tang Ziyu's expression turned sad, especially since she had been married for ten years. Unfortunately, she was never able to conceive, so she doubted that she could give him a child."
*Flick*
"Ouch! Why are you flicking my forehead?" Tang Ziyu complained while rubbing her forehead.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that. "Trust me, okay? I'll definitely get you pregnant when I'm ready to be a father."
"Can you really do it?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei answered with a nod. "You just need to wait for me to be ready, and you'll have some children in the future."
"All right, I will wait for the time to come."
After that, Zhang Fei took Tang Ziyu to another place, and they spent some time together as they waited for Zhang Chen to finish reuniting with Wang Zetian.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: The Eastern Chu Clan
paragraphs: After they spent some time having fun, Zhang Fei took Tang Ziyu to the Wang residence to pick up his grandmother, especially since Zhang Chen had already asked him to. When they arrived there, she was talking to Wang Zetian and his family, except for his son, who did not dare to come out of his room after his previous actions.
Zhang Chen then got up from her seat. "Brother, the time has come to say goodbye, and I hope you and your family live well."
"Don't worry, we will live well." Wang Zetian then turned to Zhang Fei. "Fei'er, you must always take care of and protect your grandmother, okay?"

Zhang Fei immediately hugged his grandmother's waist before answering Wang Zetian. "Old man, she is my dear grandmother, so you don't need to ask, and I will continue to protect her. Rather than thinking about us, it would be better if you thought about your family situation, especially since their higher-ups are not weak."
"Yeah, you're right." Wang Zetian replied with a nod of understanding. "All right, you can take Chen'er away, or I won't be willing to let her go."

Since Wang Zetian and Dou Luotian already knew a lot about him and his family, Zhang Fei immediately asked Mei to open the gate to the Sky Jade Realm in front of them. However, their daughter-in-law and grandchildren were shocked to see a huge gate appear out of thin air, but he ignored their expressions and sent Zhang Chen, Tang Ziyu, and You Bai there directly, which shocked them further.

"I still have some business, so I won't stay any longer, and I will leave now." Zhang Fei immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps and disappeared from their sight, rushing to Yang Lu'er's apartment, especially since she and the others were already waiting for him there.

"Grandma! Grandpa! How did he manage to do all that?" Wang Zhuxian abruptly questioned them while hugging Dou Luotian from behind, and it was evident that she was deeply intrigued by Zhang Fei's abilities.
Not only her, but their daughter-in-law and grandson also looked at them with curious looks, especially since their son was still afraid of Zhang Fei.

Dou Luotian laughed softly as she told them. "Hehe! Long ago, there were so many people with great abilities in this world, and they called themselves cultivators; even the winged race and demons could cultivate like them."
"Cultivators?" Wang Zhuxian and the other two looked at Dou Luotian with puzzled looks.

"Yes." Dou Luotian nodded to them. "Unfortunately, one day, this world underwent a drastic change, and Qi disappeared completely from it, so they could no longer cultivate. Without Qi, the number of cultivators has decreased worldwide. Those who are strong choose to leave, and those who are weak eventually die like the others, especially after their lifespan runs out."
"Does that imply that Zhang Fei is a cultivator, Grandma? How can he become one if you say there is no Qi in this world?"

"I am sure that Zhang Fei and Zhang Chen are cultivators, Xiaofeng." Dou Luotian then fell silent for a moment. "However, I don't know for sure how they managed to cultivate, but I think that they probably met a cultivator from another world, and he or she probably taught them to become cultivators."

Wang Xiaofeng and the others were no longer surprised to hear about other worlds, especially since Dou Luotian had already told them about the other three realms in addition to the human realm. Furthermore, they frequently met Micah when he visited her, so they believed that there were indeed other worlds out there.
"Grandma! Does that mean Grandma Chen can be so young because she is a cultivator?"

"Hehe." Dou Luotian laughed softly, hearing the jealousy in her granddaughter's tone. "I've never met any other cultivators, so I don't know much about cultivators. However, I once heard from your great-grandfather that cultivators have a long lifespan depending on their cultivation level, and they can also maintain their youth by using Qi and many other things."

Hearing that, Wang Zhuxian immediately turned to Wang Zetian. "Grandpa! Could you please persuade Zhang Fei to teach me how to be a cultivator? After all, we are all your descendants, so it shouldn't be a problem for him to teach us to be one, right?"

"Unfortunately, I don't have the ability to persuade him, Zuxian." Wang Zetian replied to his granddaughter with a heavy sigh. "You know that I have done many wrongs to Chen'er, and I have never gone to see them after our son was born.

Although Fei'er didn't say anything, I could see that he only regarded us as strangers, and he came here only for his grandmother, so I'm sure that he wouldn't be willing to teach you to be a cultivator."

Wang Zhuxian immediately put on a disappointed look after hearing Wang Zetian's answer. Although she was still very young now, and she had the winged race bloodline in her body, she would still age as she grew older. That was why she wanted to become a cultivator like Zhang Fei, so she could maintain her youth and not age. "Grandpa, which city do they live in?
I want to see Zhang Fei and beg him personally to teach me to become a cultivator."

Wang Zetian wanted to refuse Wang Zhuxian , but Dou Luotian stopped him before telling her granddaughter. "They live in village xxx in the east of Guangzhou, but I'm not sure that you can meet him, especially since he has taken Zhang Chen and the others to another world, and they rarely return to this world."
"I see." Wang Zhuxian nodded in understanding to her grandmother, but she didn't want to give up so easily. "Brother Xiaofeng! You must accompany me to Guangzhou, and we will leave there today!"
"All right." Wang Xiaofeng immediately agreed with his sister, especially since he was also curious about cultivators and the like, and he was also tempted to stay young.

The two immediately went back to their room to pack up, causing their mother to sigh helplessly and inquire with her parents-in-law. "Is it really okay for them to go see him? Although they are half-siblings, they don't know each other. Moreover, Zhang Fei doesn't seem to like us, especially after Tianfeng threatened him before."

"I understand your concerns, Gou Zhongwen." Dou Luotian responded to her inquiry. "However, you don't have to worry about them, especially since Xiaofeng and Zuxian are different from their father. They won't act recklessly if they meet Zhang Fei, so I'm confident that he will not harm them. Instead, their meeting could be beneficial if they could convince him to teach them cultivation."
Gou Zhongwen seemed to have no doubts about Dou Luotian's answer. "Since you've said so, I'll let them go see Zhang Fei, mother."

Wang Zetian then contacted someone to bring a helicopter to his residence, especially since it was the fastest way for his grandchildren to arrive in Guangzhou, or they would be too late to meet Zhang Fei.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,500 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 55 green jewels sent to inventory.]
Zhang Fei ignored the notification and asked Yang Lu'er, who was waiting for him along with six other women, including Huang Rong. "How did it go? Have you discovered Lei Jun's whereabouts?"

"Hey! You must know that our country is so big, right?" Yang Lu'er answered Zhang Fei in an annoyed tone. "I have asked my connections to find Lei Jun's whereabouts, as well as my mother and Hong Yao's connections, but they still haven't managed to find him.
Furthermore, there are many people with the same name in our country, so we still need some time to find him, and you can come see us again after a few days.

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding to Yang Lu'er, but Huang Rong suddenly walked up behind him and helped him take off his clothes, and she informed him of something else. "The stock of goods in your shop has decreased a lot, especially after all our advertisements on air, which makes the number of buyers coming every day increase.
That's why you must send Zhong Yan to replenish our stock as soon as possible, or we won't be able to serve our customers."

"All right, I will send Zhong Yan over right after I get back." Zhang Fei then pulled Huang Rong in front of him, stripped her naked, and looked at the other women. "I still have a lot of business to handle, so I can't stay here for too long. However, I will satisfy all of you first, and I will leave immediately after you are all exhausted."
Hearing that, Hong Yao and the others hurriedly took off their clothes, especially since they had not seen Zhang Fei for a long time, and they were looking forward to having sex with him.
Without wasting any time, Huang Rong pulled Zhang Fei to the sofa and pushed him to sit there. She, along with the other women, moved quickly to stimulate him.

Zhang Fei initially intended to use his demon touch and demon pheromone on them, but he changed his mind and decided to satisfy them naturally instead, ensuring that they would be fully satisfied without his abilities affecting their minds.
When Zhang Fei was having fun with his sex partner, it was already another day in the Sky Jade Realm, and a luxurious flying artifact was hovering above the Duan Clan residence.

Soon, a man and a woman descended from the flying artifact, and three other people followed behind them. Despite their old age, their appearance does not look too old, and they look like they are still middle-aged instead.

"Father! Mother!" Chu Guangxi was the first to greet them, hugging both people, who were none other than Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi. "I'm glad you two finally arrived, especially since we were so helpless with Youqian's condition, and his illness seemed to be getting worse."
"Where is my daughter now, Guangxi?" A sturdy middle-aged man, who was none other than Chu Yaoqin's father, asked her. "Take us there right now, and my friend will check on her condition."

"Brother Chongzi, Youqian is in that room now, and my husband is accompanying a new healer to check on her condition." Hearing that, Chu Chongzi immediately led the other two people and rushed to his daughter's room; Chu Guangxi also led her parents to the room while recounting the root of the problem between the Duan and Ying Clan.

"Humph!" Wang Xiaoyi snorted coldly after hearing that. "If Ying Feng dares to touch a single hair on you, I will raze his Ying Clan to the ground, and I will kill his family members before his eyes, which will make him regret it until the afterlife!"

Unlike his wife, Chu Liuxiang was curious about something else. "Are Ying'er and Qing'er really married to Zhang Fei? Why didn't Hong'er and Qingyu inform me of their marriage? They didn't even invite their mother to attend their wedding."

"I don't know for sure about that, Father." Chu Guangxi replied with a shake of his head. "I only found out about their marriage two days ago, and I heard it from Hong Xuan. At first, I didn't believe it, so I asked Chu Xing, and she confirmed their marriage. Furthermore, the Liu Sisters also came to this clan two days ago, and Liu Hua is one of Zhang Fei's wives, which she herself admitted."

Chu Liuxiang frowned after he heard that. "Where did that Zhang Fei come from? To the best of my memory, the Zhang Clan only exists in the central regions, and from what I've learned about its members, senior Zhang Long only has a son and a daughter. Zhang Wuji is married to Zi'er, and their daughter is named Zhang Xiaoling.
As for Zhang Lingxue, she is still unmarried, especially since she is crazy about alchemy."

"All right, husband, you don't have to think about that man." Wang Xiaoyi spoke to stop her husband, especially since she never liked Chu Liuxiang's other wives, let alone his offspring from them. "For now, we just need to focus on Youqian, and we will go to the Ying Clan after this. If they still insist on taking revenge on my dear granddaughter, then I will kill them on the spot."

Chu Liuxiang just shook his head in response to his second wife's words, but he secretly sent a voice transmission to Liu Qingyu and asked her to meet him, especially since he was curious about Zhang Fei's identity. After all, Chu Youqian's matter was also related to him, even if indirectly, so he hoped to meet him in person.

Soon, they arrived inside Chu Youqian's room, but Chu Liuxiang and Wang Xiaoyi immediately covered their bodies with qi, especially since the pungent smell emanating from her body was getting stronger.
"How was the result of your examination of my granddaughter, Zhu Xuejun?" Wang Xiaoyi immediately inquired about the healer they had brought from the eastern region.

Zhu Xuejun let out a heavy sigh and shook his head at Wang Xiaoyi. "Madam, I have been a healer for decades, but I have never encountered this kind of illness before, so I can't do anything for now. However, I am confident that I can cure Young Miss Youqian, but I need some time to research her illness, and I will also conduct further examinations on her."
"All right, you can start doing it from now, or my granddaughter will continue to suffer like this." Wang Xiaoyi then asked her husband. "Shall we go to the Ying Clan now?"

sentences.text: After they spent some time having fun, Zhang Fei took Tang Ziyu to the Wang residence to pick up his grandmother, especially since Zhang Chen had already asked him to.

Zhang Chen then got up from her seat.
"Brother, the time has come to say goodbye, and I hope you and your family live well."
"Don't worry, we will live well." Wang Zetian then turned to Zhang Fei.
"Fei'er, you must always take care of and protect your grandmother, okay?"

"Yeah, you're right." Wang Zetian replied with a nod of understanding.

However, their daughter-in-law and grandchildren were shocked to see a huge gate appear out of thin air, but he ignored their expressions and sent Zhang Chen, Tang Ziyu, and You Bai there directly, which shocked them further.

"I still have some business, so I won't stay any longer, and I will leave now." Zhang Fei immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps and disappeared from their sight, rushing to Yang Lu'er's apartment, especially since she and the others were already waiting for him there.
"Grandma!

Dou Luotian laughed softly as she told them.
"Hehe!

"Cultivators?" Wang Zhuxian and the other two looked at Dou Luotian with puzzled looks.
"Yes." Dou Luotian nodded to them.
"Unfortunately, one day, this world underwent a drastic change, and Qi disappeared completely from it, so they could no longer cultivate.
Without Qi, the number of cultivators has decreased worldwide.
Those who are strong choose to leave, and those who are weak eventually die like the others, especially after their lifespan runs out."

"However, I don't know for sure how they managed to cultivate, but I think that they probably met a cultivator from another world, and he or she probably taught them to become cultivators."
Wang Xiaofeng and the others were no longer surprised to hear about other worlds, especially since Dou Luotian had already told them about the other three realms in addition to the human realm.
Furthermore, they frequently met Micah when he visited her, so they believed that there were indeed other worlds out there.
"Grandma!
Does that mean Grandma Chen can be so young because she is a cultivator?"
"Hehe." Dou Luotian laughed softly, hearing the jealousy in her granddaughter's tone.
"I've never met any other cultivators, so I don't know much about cultivators.

However, I once heard from your great-grandfather that cultivators have a long lifespan depending on their cultivation level, and they can also maintain their youth by using Qi and many other things."
Hearing that, Wang Zhuxian immediately turned to Wang Zetian.
"Grandpa!
Could you please persuade Zhang Fei to teach me how to be a cultivator?
After all, we are all your descendants, so it shouldn't be a problem for him to teach us to be one, right?"
"Unfortunately, I don't have the ability to persuade him, Zuxian." Wang Zetian replied to his granddaughter with a heavy sigh.
"You know that I have done many wrongs to Chen'er, and I have never gone to see them after our son was born.

Although Fei'er didn't say anything, I could see that he only regarded us as strangers, and he came here only for his grandmother, so I'm sure that he wouldn't be willing to teach you to be a cultivator."
Wang Zhuxian immediately put on a disappointed look after hearing Wang Zetian's answer.
Although she was still very young now, and she had the winged race bloodline in her body, she would still age as she grew older.
That was why she wanted to become a cultivator like Zhang Fei, so she could maintain her youth and not age.
"Grandpa, which city do they live in?
I want to see Zhang Fei and beg him personally to teach me to become a cultivator."
Wang Zetian wanted to refuse Wang Zhuxian , but Dou Luotian stopped him before telling her granddaughter.

"They live in village xxx in the east of Guangzhou, but I'm not sure that you can meet him, especially since he has taken Zhang Chen and the others to another world, and they rarely return to this world."
"I see." Wang Zhuxian nodded in understanding to her grandmother, but she didn't want to give up so easily.
"Brother Xiaofeng!
You must accompany me to Guangzhou, and we will leave there today!"
"All right." Wang Xiaofeng immediately agreed with his sister, especially since he was also curious about cultivators and the like, and he was also tempted to stay young.
The two immediately went back to their room to pack up, causing their mother to sigh helplessly and inquire with her parents-in-law.
"Is it really okay for them to go see him?
Although they are half-siblings, they don't know each other.
Moreover, Zhang Fei doesn't seem to like us, especially after Tianfeng threatened him before."
"I understand your concerns, Gou Zhongwen." Dou Luotian responded to her inquiry.
"However, you don't have to worry about them, especially since Xiaofeng and Zuxian are different from their father.
They won't act recklessly if they meet Zhang Fei, so I'm confident that he will not harm them.
Instead, their meeting could be beneficial if they could convince him to teach them cultivation."
Gou Zhongwen seemed to have no doubts about Dou Luotian's answer.
"Since you've said so, I'll let them go see Zhang Fei, mother."

chapters.title: Chapter 297: Dispute
paragraphs: Just as they were about to go to the Ying Clan, Liu Qingyu and her two daughters suddenly walked into the Duan Clan, and they immediately greeted Chu Liuxiang at the same time.
"Father-in-law."
"Grandpa!"
"Grandfather."

"Hahaha!" Chu Liuxiang laughed as she hugged Chu Ying and Chu Qing. "You two are becoming more beautiful now, and your cultivation has increased quite a bit compared to the last time we met. Ying'er is almost breaking through to the earth realm, and Qing'er has also reached the 4-Star Core Realm.
However, it saddens me that you two married without informing or inviting me or your grandmother, nor have you introduced Zhang Fei to me."

"Hehehe." Chu Qing giggled as she acted spoilingly. "Grandpa, we have already gotten married according to tradition, but we haven't held our wedding banquet yet, so only certain people know about our marriage. In fact, Sister Xing also didn't know about our marriage before, but she knows now."

Chu Ying also joined in talking to his grandfather. "Actually, we plan to hold our wedding banquet after our father returns from the demon cave, grandfather. At that time, we will definitely invite you and our grandmother, so you two must attend our wedding banquet." Your next read awaits at mvl

"All right, we will definitely attend your wedding party, so you two must make sure not to forget to invite us, understand?" The Chu sisters nodded to their grandfather, and Chu Liuxiang questioned her daughter-in-law. "Is Zhang Fei a member of the Zhang clan? Their branch clan, perhaps?"

"You are wrong about that, Father. Fei'er is not a member of the Zhang Clan's branch clan, but he is a member of their main clan." Chu Liuxiang not only raised his eyebrows upon hearing Liu Qingyu's response, but Wang Xiaoyi's expression also darkened, revealing a hint of jealousy and envy.

"Anyway, he is not a direct member of their main clan because he is not their descendant, even though he shares the same surname. However, Zhang Lingxue is one of his wives, so he is now part of their main clan."
"What?" Chu Liuxiang, Wang Xiaoyi, and the four people from the Duan Clan screamed in shock after hearing that.

The Chu Sisters smiled in amusement at their reactions, and Chu Qing immediately told his grandfather. "Grandpa, my mother didn't lie to you; Big Sis Lingxue is truly one of our husband's wives, and we have spent so much time together in seclusion before."
Chu Ying informed Chu Liuxiang, "Grandfather, our husband actually has twelve wives, and Aunt Hua is also one of us."
(A/N: This does not include Liu Qingyu or Janette. The Chu Sisters are still unaware of Zhang Fei's relationship with their mother, and he has not yet included Janette in his harem.)

They weren't surprised to hear about Liu Hua, especially since she had already admitted it herself. However, the number of Zhang Fei's wives truly surprised them, especially since Zhang Lingxue was also among them, making his harem the strongest harem.

'Damn it! How could such a brat get so many wives with the support of powerful clans? Even my children and grandchildren are not as lucky as that brat! All of them married into minor clans, just like the Duan Clan! In her heart, Wang Xiaoyi muttered angrily to herself.

However, Wang Xiaoyi's expression did not escape Liu Qingyu's observation, causing her to shake her head slightly. 'This woman has never changed; her jealousy and envy are still as intense as ever. It's not surprising that her descendants have such poor character, particularly given the profound impact she has had on them.'

'Tch!' Wang Xiaoyi gritted her teeth as she pulled her husband's hand. "Let's go, husband! We must settle our scores with the Ying Clan and teach them a lesson about wanting to kill our granddaughter."
Liu Qingyu immediately stopped them. "Father-in-law, you shouldn't go to the Ying Clan, especially since their clan is under my mother's protection."

Wang Xiaoyi turned to Liu Qingyu with an angry expression, but Chu Liuxiang immediately stopped his wife, particularly because Liu Rong and the Liu Clan were stronger than them. "Is your mother really protecting the Ying Clan?"

"Yes." Liu Qingyu nodded to Chu Liuxiang. "Duan Ling and Chu Guangxi must have explained the root of the problem to you, right? Chu Yaoqian has never met my son-in-law, but she accused him of harassing and molesting her. In reality, she was jealous of his little sister, Zhang Lin, because she possessed such a beautiful beast, and she wished to steal it from her.

Moreover, she already knew about Zhang Fei's relationship with my little sister, so he was a member of my Liu Clan. Unfortunately, she was blinded by her jealousy, and she wanted to pit him against the Shen Clan, resulting in Yang Xiao's death while delivering her letter for Shen Haoran.
Since this matter is related to him, my mother decided to protect the Ying Clan, and she has ordered our clan members to ensure their safety from anyone who wants to harm them, including you."

In fact, it was not Liu Rong who decided that, but Liu Qingyu and Liu Hua who decided it themselves, especially since they were very familiar with Wang Xiaoyi's character and wanted to prevent unnecessary bloodshed.

Duan Ling and Chu Guangxi became tense once Liu Qingyu brought up the Shen Clan, especially since she and Liu Hua had already told them about Zhang Fei and Shen Yu's relationship, but both of them strictly forbade them from disclosing it to anyone else, so they didn't dare tell Chu Liuxiang about it.
Wang Xiaoyi's anger immediately erupted after hearing that. "You-"

"You what?" Liu Qingyu immediately interrupted Wang Xiaoyi without the slightest fear, even though her cultivation was much higher than hers. "If there is anyone to blame for this matter, it is you. You are the one who caused all your descendants, including Chu Youqian, to develop such arrogance.

Yet, you turn a blind eye to your own mistakes and the bad character of your descendants, and you want to blame others for your own granddaughter's stupidity. If your granddaughter had not gone to Ying Xiao and told him to do that, I am sure that he would not have died, so his death was entirely her fault. As a cultivator and a grown woman, she should be held accountable for her mistakes.
Eye for an eye, blood for blood, and life for life!"
*Boom*
After hearing her last sentence, Wang Xiaoyi's anger instantly exploded, and she disappeared from their sight before reappearing behind Liu Qingyu a second later and attempting to attack her.
"Shit!" Chu Liuxiang cursed and wanted to stop his wife, but he didn't have the chance to do so because another woman suddenly appeared behind Wang Xiaoyi.
"Argh!" The woman quickly swung her right leg before hitting Wang Xiaoyi's head extremely hard, and the kick threw her to the side.

Even so, Wang Xiaoyi was still a strong and experienced cultivator, and she immediately used her cultivation to stop herself just before her body hit the large rock behind her, causing it to explode instantly.
*Boom*
Wang Xiaoyi was shocked, but so were her husband, her family, and two people from the Duan Clan.

They immediately looked at The woman who was already standing in front of Liu Qingyu had a playful smile on her face, but she ignored their gazes, and the Chu Sisters immediately moved to their mother's side as they glared at Wang Xiaoyi with hostility.

"Fortunately, Liu Hua told my husband that you brought Ying'er and Qing'er to see this old man, and he predicted that something like this would happen, so he purposely sent me here to protect you guys."
"Thank you, Boitata." Liu Qingyu spoke with a sigh of relief in her heart, especially since she couldn't see Wang Xiaoyi's movements due to the huge difference in their cultivation levels.

Understanding his wife's character, Chu Liuxiang immediately moved in front of Wang Xiaoyi to stop her, but his attention was on Boitata instead. 'This woman is as strong as Shen Xueyi and the others. Moreover, her qi has already experienced fluctuations, indicating that she will break through to the sovereign realm soon.' "Can you tell me who you are? Why are you meddling in our affairs?"

"As you have heard, my name is Boitata, and Zhang Fei is my husband, so it is natural for me to meddle in your affairs because that idiot old woman wants to attack my family, right?" Boitata's answer made the people even more shocked and confused about Zhang Fei's relationship, but she suddenly released her aura and pressed Wang Xiaoyi from above, forcing her to kneel on the ground.

'Damn it! How can such a brat have such a powerful wife? Even this woman surpasses both me and my husband in strength.' Wang Xiaoyi grumbled in her heart as she tried to fight back against Boitata's aura, but instead she increased her pressure on him, causing the floor beneath her to start cracking.
Chu Liuxiang also tried to help his wife dispel Boitata's pressure, but he couldn't do it either, especially since his cultivation was several minor levels below hers.

Boitata suddenly retracted her pressure, causing Wang Xiaoyi to fall to the ground and sweat to drench her body. "Old man, my husband usually orders me to kill anyone who dares to attack his family, but he makes an exception for that idiot old woman because she is your wife, and he doesn't want to ruin your relationship with the western Chu Clan.

However, he only gave her one chance, and he ordered me to kill her immediately if she dares to attack any of them for the second time, so you better educate her well if you don't want her to die in my hands."

After hearing that, Chu Liuxiang took a deep breath and nodded in understanding to Boitata before helping his wife up. Unfortunately, Wang Xiaoyi's character was very bad, so she glared at him with a murderous look because of her humiliation just now, but she ignored her because Zhang Fei forbade him to kill her.

Then, Boitata spoke with Liu Qingyu and the Chu Sisters. "It would be better if the three of you returned to the western region now, especially since my husband will return soon, and he already has his own plans regarding the matter."
"All right." Liu Qingyu and the Chu sisters immediately said goodbye to Chu Liuxiang. "Father, you can come to our residence if you have time, and we can discuss many things there."
"Grandpa! Don't forget to bring our grandma with you if you come to our residence!"
Chu Ying agreed with her little sister. "It's been a long time since we've seen our grandmother, so you can bring her to visit us, grandfather."

Chu Liuxiang naturally would not refuse the request of his two granddaughters, and he immediately agreed to their request. "All right, I'll ask Yuan Manqiu to leave for this region today, and then I'll take her to the western region after Shen Yu and Shen Tianyu's wedding."
After that, Liu Qingyu brought his two daughters back to the Liu Clan, and she ordered some people from her clan to go to the Ying Clan just in case Wang Xiaoyi really wanted to attack them.
Boitata also disappeared from their sight, but she did not leave the region, especially since Zhang Fei asked her to continue monitoring the movements of those people, particularly Wang Xiaoyi.
After they all disappeared, Wang Xiaoyi immediately told her husband. "Let's go! We must go to the Ying Clan."

"Forget it." Chu Luxiang replied with a heavy sigh. "Are you still unaware of our situation? Do you think we can fight the Liu Clan? Although Liu Rong and Liu Ming are not there now, they still have many cultivators who are stronger than us. Furthermore, I suspect that the woman known as Boitata remains in this region, and Zhang Fei may have instructed her to safeguard the Ying Clan.
Therefore, it would be futile for us to go there, as it would only cause harm to ourselves."

"So what are you going to do? Are you going to hand Youqian over to them to kill?" Wang Xiaoyi inquired in a raised voice. "If you dare to do that, I will break off relations with you and fight you myself."
Wang Xiaoyi's words immediately caused Duan Liang, Chu Guangxi, and Chu Youqian's parents to hold their breath.

On the other hand, Chu Luxiang was instantly furious after hearing that and released his pressure to suppress his own wife. "I have always tolerated your volatile temper for so many years, but your attitude this time really makes me sick. If you are so eager to end your relationships with me, then I will fulfill your wish, and we will no longer have any in the future.
If you are so anxious to die, then you can go to the Ying Clan by yourself."

Following that, Chu Liuxiang immediately went back to Chu Youqin's room, contacted Yuan Manqiu, and asked her to leave immediately for the southern region. However, he had not yet decided on his granddaughter's fate.

Seeing Wang Xiaoyi dumbly sunned in her spot, Chu Guangxi let out a heavy sigh before speaking to her. "Mother, you shouldn't say such things to my father; your words just now made him so angry, which is your own loss."

However, Wang Xiaoyi remained silent due to her shock at her husband's recent remarks, particularly considering Chu Liuxiang's habit of prioritizing her over his other wives and consistently fulfilling her requests.
