All of them married into minor clans, just like the Duan Clan!
In her heart, Wang Xiaoyi muttered angrily to herself.
However, Wang Xiaoyi's expression did not escape Liu Qingyu's observation, causing her to shake her head slightly. 'This woman has never changed; her jealousy and envy are still as intense as ever.
It's not surprising that her descendants have such poor character, particularly given the profound impact she has had on them.'
'Tch!' Wang Xiaoyi gritted her teeth as she pulled her husband's hand.
"Let's go, husband!
We must settle our scores with the Ying Clan and teach them a lesson about wanting to kill our granddaughter."
Liu Qingyu immediately stopped them.
"Father-in-law, you shouldn't go to the Ying Clan, especially since their clan is under my mother's protection."
Wang Xiaoyi turned to Liu Qingyu with an angry expression, but Chu Liuxiang immediately stopped his wife, particularly because Liu Rong and the Liu Clan were stronger than them.
"Is your mother really protecting the Ying Clan?"
"Yes." Liu Qingyu nodded to Chu Liuxiang.
"Duan Ling and Chu Guangxi must have explained the root of the problem to you, right?
Chu Yaoqian has never met my son-in-law, but she accused him of harassing and molesting her.
In reality, she was jealous of his little sister, Zhang Lin, because she possessed such a beautiful beast, and she wished to steal it from her.
Moreover, she already knew about Zhang Fei's relationship with my little sister, so he was a member of my Liu Clan.
Unfortunately, she was blinded by her jealousy, and she wanted to pit him against the Shen Clan, resulting in Yang Xiao's death while delivering her letter for Shen Haoran.
Since this matter is related to him, my mother decided to protect the Ying Clan, and she has ordered our clan members to ensure their safety from anyone who wants to harm them, including you."

In fact, it was not Liu Rong who decided that, but Liu Qingyu and Liu Hua who decided it themselves, especially since they were very familiar with Wang Xiaoyi's character and wanted to prevent unnecessary bloodshed.

Duan Ling and Chu Guangxi became tense once Liu Qingyu brought up the Shen Clan, especially since she and Liu Hua had already told them about Zhang Fei and Shen Yu's relationship, but both of them strictly forbade them from disclosing it to anyone else, so they didn't dare tell Chu Liuxiang about it.
Wang Xiaoyi's anger immediately erupted after hearing that.
"You-"
"You what?" Liu Qingyu immediately interrupted Wang Xiaoyi without the slightest fear, even though her cultivation was much higher than hers.
"If there is anyone to blame for this matter, it is you.
You are the one who caused all your descendants, including Chu Youqian, to develop such arrogance.
Yet, you turn a blind eye to your own mistakes and the bad character of your descendants, and you want to blame others for your own granddaughter's stupidity.
If your granddaughter had not gone to Ying Xiao and told him to do that, I am sure that he would not have died, so his death was entirely her fault.
As a cultivator and a grown woman, she should be held accountable for her mistakes.
Eye for an eye, blood for blood, and life for life!"
*Boom*
After hearing her last sentence, Wang Xiaoyi's anger instantly exploded, and she disappeared from their sight before reappearing behind Liu Qingyu a second later and attempting to attack her.
"Shit!" Chu Liuxiang cursed and wanted to stop his wife, but he didn't have the chance to do so because another woman suddenly appeared behind Wang Xiaoyi.
"Argh!" The woman quickly swung her right leg before hitting Wang Xiaoyi's head extremely hard, and the kick threw her to the side.

Even so, Wang Xiaoyi was still a strong and experienced cultivator, and she immediately used her cultivation to stop herself just before her body hit the large rock behind her, causing it to explode instantly.
*Boom*
Wang Xiaoyi was shocked, but so were her husband, her family, and two people from the Duan Clan.

They immediately looked at The woman who was already standing in front of Liu Qingyu had a playful smile on her face, but she ignored their gazes, and the Chu Sisters immediately moved to their mother's side as they glared at Wang Xiaoyi with hostility.

"Fortunately, Liu Hua told my husband that you brought Ying'er and Qing'er to see this old man, and he predicted that something like this would happen, so he purposely sent me here to protect you guys."
"Thank you, Boitata." Liu Qingyu spoke with a sigh of relief in her heart, especially since she couldn't see Wang Xiaoyi's movements due to the huge difference in their cultivation levels.

Understanding his wife's character, Chu Liuxiang immediately moved in front of Wang Xiaoyi to stop her, but his attention was on Boitata instead. 'This woman is as strong as Shen Xueyi and the others.
Moreover, her qi has already experienced fluctuations, indicating that she will break through to the sovereign realm soon.' "Can you tell me who you are?
Why are you meddling in our affairs?"

"As you have heard, my name is Boitata, and Zhang Fei is my husband, so it is natural for me to meddle in your affairs because that idiot old woman wants to attack my family, right?" Boitata's answer made the people even more shocked and confused about Zhang Fei's relationship, but she suddenly released her aura and pressed Wang Xiaoyi from above, forcing her to kneel on the ground.
'Damn it!
How can such a brat have such a powerful wife?

Even this woman surpasses both me and my husband in strength.' Wang Xiaoyi grumbled in her heart as she tried to fight back against Boitata's aura, but instead she increased her pressure on him, causing the floor beneath her to start cracking.
Chu Liuxiang also tried to help his wife dispel Boitata's pressure, but he couldn't do it either, especially since his cultivation was several minor levels below hers.
Boitata suddenly retracted her pressure, causing Wang Xiaoyi to fall to the ground and sweat to drench her body.

"Old man, my husband usually orders me to kill anyone who dares to attack his family, but he makes an exception for that idiot old woman because she is your wife, and he doesn't want to ruin your relationship with the western Chu Clan.

However, he only gave her one chance, and he ordered me to kill her immediately if she dares to attack any of them for the second time, so you better educate her well if you don't want her to die in my hands."
After hearing that, Chu Liuxiang took a deep breath and nodded in understanding to Boitata before helping his wife up.
Unfortunately, Wang Xiaoyi's character was very bad, so she glared at him with a murderous look because of her humiliation just now, but she ignored her because Zhang Fei forbade him to kill her.
Then, Boitata spoke with Liu Qingyu and the Chu Sisters.
"It would be better if the three of you returned to the western region now, especially since my husband will return soon, and he already has his own plans regarding the matter."
"All right." Liu Qingyu and the Chu sisters immediately said goodbye to Chu Liuxiang.
"Father, you can come to our residence if you have time, and we can discuss many things there."
"Grandpa!
Don't forget to bring our grandma with you if you come to our residence!"
Chu Ying agreed with her little sister.
"It's been a long time since we've seen our grandmother, so you can bring her to visit us, grandfather."
Chu Liuxiang naturally would not refuse the request of his two granddaughters, and he immediately agreed to their request.
"All right, I'll ask Yuan Manqiu to leave for this region today, and then I'll take her to the western region after Shen Yu and Shen Tianyu's wedding."
After that, Liu Qingyu brought his two daughters back to the Liu Clan, and she ordered some people from her clan to go to the Ying Clan just in case Wang Xiaoyi really wanted to attack them.
Boitata also disappeared from their sight, but she did not leave the region, especially since Zhang Fei asked her to continue monitoring the movements of those people, particularly Wang Xiaoyi.
After they all disappeared, Wang Xiaoyi immediately told her husband.
"Let's go!
We must go to the Ying Clan."
"Forget it." Chu Luxiang replied with a heavy sigh.
"Are you still unaware of our situation?
Do you think we can fight the Liu Clan?
Although Liu Rong and Liu Ming are not there now, they still have many cultivators who are stronger than us.
Furthermore, I suspect that the woman known as Boitata remains in this region, and Zhang Fei may have instructed her to safeguard the Ying Clan.
Therefore, it would be futile for us to go there, as it would only cause harm to ourselves."
"So what are you going to do?
Are you going to hand Youqian over to them to kill?" Wang Xiaoyi inquired in a raised voice.
"If you dare to do that, I will break off relations with you and fight you myself."
Wang Xiaoyi's words immediately caused Duan Liang, Chu Guangxi, and Chu Youqian's parents to hold their breath.
On the other hand, Chu Luxiang was instantly furious after hearing that and released his pressure to suppress his own wife.
"I have always tolerated your volatile temper for so many years, but your attitude this time really makes me sick.
If you are so eager to end your relationships with me, then I will fulfill your wish, and we will no longer have any in the future.
If you are so anxious to die, then you can go to the Ying Clan by yourself."
Following that, Chu Liuxiang immediately went back to Chu Youqin's room, contacted Yuan Manqiu, and asked her to leave immediately for the southern region.
However, he had not yet decided on his granddaughter's fate.
Seeing Wang Xiaoyi dumbly sunned in her spot, Chu Guangxi let out a heavy sigh before speaking to her.
"Mother, you shouldn't say such things to my father; your words just now made him so angry, which is your own loss."

However, Wang Xiaoyi remained silent due to her shock at her husband's recent remarks, particularly considering Chu Liuxiang's habit of prioritizing her over his other wives and consistently fulfilling her requests.

chapters.title: Chapter 298: The wives Are Jealous
paragraphs: "Father, are you really going to hand my daughter over to the Ying Clan?" Chu Chongzi inquired as soon as he entered Chu Youqian's room, along with his wife.

Chu Liuxiang let out a soft sigh and turned to his son and daughter-in-law. "Chongzhi and Yao Chi, I don't want to lie to you, and I find it difficult to make a decision, but I am considering handing Youqian over to the Ying Clan. Moreover, you can see that her condition is getting worse, and I'm not sure that Xuejun can cure her.

In addition, you two have heard for yourselves that the Liu Clan is protecting them, and Zhang Fei also has connections with the Zhang Clan, which is much stronger than the Liu or Shen Clans. Besides, Shen Haoran will be furious if he finds out that she is trying to set them against each other, and we won't be able to do anything against such powerful opponents.
Even if we persist, I'm afraid they'll destroy our clan, which is why I considered doing that.
Chu Chongzhi and Yao Chi could understand her father's worries, but their hearts were heavy to hand over their daughter to the Ying Clan, especially since Chu Youqian was their only daughter.

Chu Liuxiang let out a soft sigh and patted their shoulders. "You two are still young, and you may have more children in the future. However, I won't decide right now, giving you ample time to consider your options before I make a final decision. I trust that you will make the best decision for the future of many people, particularly considering the potential harm to many if we become their enemies."
Experience new tales on mvl

After their father left, Yao Chi sat by her daughter's bedside, but she didn't dare touch her because Zhu Xuejun forbade her from doing so. "What should we do now, husband? I knew our daughter was arrogant and jealous like her grandmother, but I didn't expect that she would do something so stupid, and now we have to face serious problems with several powerful clans."
"What do you think about our father's plan?" Instead, Chu Chongzi questioned his wife, particularly because he was struggling to decide upon their daughter.
Yao Chi shook her head at him. "I don't have the answer yet, and I want to think things over first."

"All right, we still have a few days, so we don't need to rush into making a decision and think things over first." Yao Chi simply nodded in response to her husband, and Chu Chongzi promptly left the room.
However, Wang Xiaoyi abruptly stopped Chu Chongzi, dragging her son to a quiet place before questioning him. "Are you crazy? Are you also considering handing Youqian over to the Ying Clan?"

"Mother, you should have realized that we have no other choice, right? Since the matter has come to this, what else can we do to save her?" Chu Chongzi responded with a bitter smile. "I certainly don't want Youqian to die, as she is my only daughter. However, the people involved in this matter are powerful; even you and my father were helpless under pressure from the woman named Boitata.
So I think that fighting them would result in excessive casualties, as well as the destruction of our eastern Chu and Wang clans."

Upon hearing that, Wang Xiaoyi fell silent and racked her brains to find another solution to save Chu Youqian from death. "What if I took her away from this clan and brought her to the northern region? I know that region is dangerous, but people from other regions won't go there, so I think that region is the safest place for now."

"Do you think Boitata will let you take my daughter away?" Wang Xiayoi raised her eyebrows at that, making Chu Chongzi sigh. "Just like my father, I am also sure that woman is still watching us from somewhere else, and she won't let you take Youqian away from this clan. Instead, your actions will cause a chain reaction, and she might attack us directly before destroying our clan."
Wang Xiaoyi was truly frustrated with their situation, especially since all the paths they chose would only end in loss for them, so she left her son and went to see her husband.
However, Chu Liuxiang deliberately set up a formation in her room, making it impossible for Wang Xiaoyi to enter, and despite her persistent screams, he didn't even respond to her.
In the end, Wang Xiaoyi gave up and went to another room to rest, but she kept racking her brains to look for another way out.

After they returned to the Chu Clan, the Chu Sisters immediately joined the others in formation in the back garden. However, Chu Qing continued to circle around Zhang Chen and Tang Ziyu, not only because she was still shocked by their appearance after Zhang Fei sent them there yesterday but also because she felt jealous of their beauty and youthfulness.

Actually, Chu Ying and Zhang Fei's other wives were also jealous of them, but they did not express their feelings as openly as Chu Qing did, primarily because they were confident that their husband would never forget them.
Even senior women like Liu Qingyu and Liu Hua were not free from jealousy, but they were completely sure that he would give them the same pill later, so they just had to wait for him to come back.

Zhang Chen laughed softly at seeing her act like that, so she grabbed Chu Qing and rubbed her cheeks. "You don't have to be jealous like this, okay? Fei'er is still busy, but he will come back soon, and he will definitely give you the beauty retaining pill, so you will never grow old."
"I also want to take the youthful returning pill, Grandma Chen."
"Isn't that useless?" Zhang Chen asked him. "Look at you—you're young and beautiful, so the youthful returning pill won't have any effect on you."

Chu Ying nodded in agreement with Zhang Chen before speaking to her little sister. "Grandma Chen is right, Qing'er. We are indeed still young, so we don't need the pill. However, the pill will definitely be useful for Sister Ru Xue and the others, and all of us will be equally young after they take the youthful returning pill."

Chu Qing let out a soft sigh as she realized the truth of their words, and she immediately forgot about her desire to swallow the youthful returning pill. She then put her arm around Zhang Chen's shoulders and spoke to her. Dear Grandma Chen, you're so young now that Fei may be interested in you. You must be careful with him, or he'll eat you."
"Qing'er!" Liu Hua and the others yelled at Chu Qing, who immediately shut her mouth in response to their shout.

In fact, Zhang Chen herself also had concerns about this in her heart, but she chose to believe that Zhang Fei would not have such thoughts towards her, especially since he had always loved and respected her.

"Fei'er contacted me and asked you to buy the supplies for your shop on Earth, so you can go see the Wen Twins at Hua Lou, and they will help you buy everything." Zhong Yan nodded in understanding at Liu Hua, who suddenly spoke to her.
"Ru Xue, the building that will be your clinic has been renovated, so you can check the place out now, and you can let me know if you need any adjustments to the building."
"Thank you, Sister Hua. I will go with Zhong Yan to check out the building and buy some shop supplies now."
After they left, Liu Hua asked Tang Ziyu. "How do you feel after becoming a cultivator like us?"

"I feel great, Sister Hua." Tang Ziyu replied with a smile, especially since she could feel the significant changes in her body after she became a cultivator. "Honestly, I still feel like everything is a dream, especially since I never knew about cultivators, demons, or anything else before.

I didn't expect my life to change drastically after meeting Fei'er, and I was also frightened when he showed me his incubus form for the first time. However, I feel really happy now, and I believe that my life will get better and better in the future."

Liu Hua smiled after hearing that. "That's for sure; Fei'er will make all of us live happier lives in the future. Anyway, since your cultivation is the lowest among us, you should concentrate on cultivating in this formation for the time being. Once you dual-cultivate with our husband, your cultivation will significantly increase, especially since his cultivation is high enough to assist you."
"Yes, Sister Hua."
After that, Tang Ziyu and the others immediately started cultivating inside the qi gathering formation, and Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu left them.

However, the Liu Sisters smiled in amusement at seeing the two tigresses continue to chase after You Bai, but the wind weasel's movements were too fast for them. Even Jie Yuan, who was stronger than her, had difficulty catching up with her, especially when she used her wind abilities.

"Big Sis, this clan has become more lively with their presence." Liu Qingyu nodded in agreement with her little sister, particularly considering that the Chu Clan only had a few members in the past. "Do you think Chu Liuxiang will hand Chu Youqian over to the Ying Clan?"

"Yes." Liu Qingyu answered her little sister confidently. "My father-in-law isn't stupid, and he must have been fully aware of their situation, so he had no choice but to hand over Chu Youqian. On the contrary, Wang Xiaoyi's arrogance would definitely not allow him to give up just like that, so she must be thinking of a way to save her granddaughter.
However, Fei'er must have ordered Boitata to keep an eye on her, and he would never let her take her granddaughter away."

Unlike Liu Qingyu, Liu Hua understood Zhang Fei's character better, and she thought that her husband must have other plans for Wang Xiaoyi and Chu Youqian. "Big Sis, that old woman attacked you before, and we both know Fei'er's character. Moreover, Boitata must have told his clone about it, which means he also knows about it, and I think he might change his plans for them."

After hearing that, Liu Qingyu raised her eyebrows for a moment. Although she was still not his woman completely due to her status as Chu Hong's wife, he already regarded her as his wife just like the others, and she then let out a soft sigh. "I can't predict Fei'er's plans for them next, but I think Wang Xiaoyi will suffer, and he may kill Chu Youqian.
Forget it; let him take care of the two of them, and I'm sure my father-in-law won't think about it either."
In her seclusion room, Shen Yu kept smiling to herself, and Shen Xueyi was helping her try on her wedding dress.

After all, her wedding with Shen Tianyu would be held in three days, and the entire area of the Yin-Yang Pavilion was already filled with the red accessories that were usually used as decorations for weddings; even the guests they had invited had also started to arrive and filled the guest area.
Unfortunately, the wedding that will take place in two days will not go well, and there is a big surprise waiting for the invited guests.
"Is Fei's wedding dress ready, mother?"
"Yes." Shen Xueyi answered with a nod. "I've been preparing it for a few days, so we just need to wait for him to come back to try it on, and you'll marry her in three days."

"Hehe." Shen Yu laughed happily as she imagined her marriage to her true love. "Shen Tianyu hasn't yet woken up, so Shen Haoran will definitely use a substitute to replace his son's position in our marriage. Unfortunately, he still doesn't fully understand the situation, and Zhang Fei will take action to replace him and marry me.

Shen Xueyi smiled sincerely as she listened to her daughter's joy. "We will ensure your marriage to Zhang Fei goes smoothly, and we will immediately get rid of them once your wedding ceremony with him is over."
"Yes." Shen Yu nodded to her mother. "Actually, I'm not worried about them, especially since Fei has already told me some of his plans, and no one can stop us from getting married."

"Are you looking forward to dual-cultivating with him?" Shen Yu's face instantly turned red because of Shen Xueyi's question, and she shyly nodded at her mother. "Do you want me to teach you how to satisfy Zhang Fei?"

"You are shameless, mother!" Shen Yu said it with a soft cry. "Anyway, I've seen him dual-cultivate with his other wives, and they've also told me a lot about his preferences when dual-cultivating. However, I find some of it strange, especially when he does it with them through their back door, and I think it must be painful."

"That's true." Shen Xueyi nodded in agreement with her. "In fact, I did the same thing with him during our first dual-cultivation, but he used his tail for that." Fortunately, I was already too aroused at that time, so I didn't feel any pain, and instead I got the pleasure that I had never gotten when I dual-cultivated with your father in the past."

Shen Yu raised her eyebrows as she stared at her mother in amazement, especially since Shen Xueyi had changed a lot after she dual-cultivated with Zhang Fei, and she was not even shy about telling her about their sexual activities.
Abruptly, two additional women entered the room, prompting Shen Xinya to ask her daughter a startling question. "Have you really dual-cultivated with Zhang Fei, Xueyi?"

"Big Sis, that old woman attacked you before, and we both know Fei'er's character.
Moreover, Boitata must have told his clone about it, which means he also knows about it, and I think he might change his plans for them."
After hearing that, Liu Qingyu raised her eyebrows for a moment.
Although she was still not his woman completely due to her status as Chu Hong's wife, he already regarded her as his wife just like the others, and she then let out a soft sigh.
"I can't predict Fei'er's plans for them next, but I think Wang Xiaoyi will suffer, and he may kill Chu Youqian.
Forget it; let him take care of the two of them, and I'm sure my father-in-law won't think about it either."
In her seclusion room, Shen Yu kept smiling to herself, and Shen Xueyi was helping her try on her wedding dress.

After all, her wedding with Shen Tianyu would be held in three days, and the entire area of the Yin-Yang Pavilion was already filled with the red accessories that were usually used as decorations for weddings; even the guests they had invited had also started to arrive and filled the guest area.

"Is Fei's wedding dress ready, mother?"
"Yes." Shen Xueyi answered with a nod.
"I've been preparing it for a few days, so we just need to wait for him to come back to try it on, and you'll marry her in three days."
"Hehe." Shen Yu laughed happily as she imagined her marriage to her true love.
"Shen Tianyu hasn't yet woken up, so Shen Haoran will definitely use a substitute to replace his son's position in our marriage.
Unfortunately, he still doesn't fully understand the situation, and Zhang Fei will take action to replace him and marry me.
Shen Xueyi smiled sincerely as she listened to her daughter's joy.
"We will ensure your marriage to Zhang Fei goes smoothly, and we will immediately get rid of them once your wedding ceremony with him is over."
"Yes." Shen Yu nodded to her mother.
"Actually, I'm not worried about them, especially since Fei has already told me some of his plans, and no one can stop us from getting married."
"Are you looking forward to dual-cultivating with him?" Shen Yu's face instantly turned red because of Shen Xueyi's question, and she shyly nodded at her mother.
"Do you want me to teach you how to satisfy Zhang Fei?"
"You are shameless, mother!" Shen Yu said it with a soft cry.
"Anyway, I've seen him dual-cultivate with his other wives, and they've also told me a lot about his preferences when dual-cultivating.
However, I find some of it strange, especially when he does it with them through their back door, and I think it must be painful."
"That's true." Shen Xueyi nodded in agreement with her.

"In fact, I did the same thing with him during our first dual-cultivation, but he used his tail for that." Fortunately, I was already too aroused at that time, so I didn't feel any pain, and instead I got the pleasure that I had never gotten when I dual-cultivated with your father in the past."

Shen Yu raised her eyebrows as she stared at her mother in amazement, especially since Shen Xueyi had changed a lot after she dual-cultivated with Zhang Fei, and she was not even shy about telling her about their sexual activities.
Abruptly, two additional women entered the room, prompting Shen Xinya to ask her daughter a startling question.
"Have you really dual-cultivated with Zhang Fei, Xueyi?"

chapters.title: Chapter 299: Wang Xiaoyi's Decision
paragraphs: Shen Xueyi smiled bitterly at the jealousy in her mother's voice, but she had already guessed that Shen Xinya would react like that if she knew about her relationship with Zhang Fei. "Yes, Mother. I dual-cultivated with him five days ago, and I also took the same pills he gave to Yu'er."

Shen Xinya's expression turned jealous after she heard that, especially since she herself wanted those pills so badly. However, she was aware that Zhang Fei would not give them to her if she did not become his partner, and she was actually willing to do that to get them, but her mother kept stopping her.

Naturally, Shen Huang also noticed her daughter's expression, but she chose not to comment on it and asked her granddaughter instead. "Has your cultivation reached the barrier to the sovereign realm?"

"Yes, Grandma." Shen Xueyi responded with a nod. "I can already feel the barrier, but I still need a little time to be able to touch it, and I might be able to break through to that stage in one to two weeks, but that also depends on the situation.

If Zhang Fei comes to me and dual-cultivates with me again, then I might be able to break through faster with the boost from his yang qi, especially since his yang qi as a mythical beast is really strong for ordinary beasts like us."

Shen Huang was actually jealous of her granddaughter and great-granddaughter, particularly since she had cultivated much longer than them, but she still hadn't managed to break through to the sovereign realm. Unlike her daughter, she never considered accepting Zhang Fei's offer, so she refrained from expressing her jealousy towards them. "That's good for you, Xueyi.
Once you break through to the sovereign realm, you can solidify your position in our clan, and no one will dare to oppose you again like Shen Haoran."

However, Shen Huang's words actually made Shen Xueyi let out a heavy sigh. "Actually, I wanted to give the leadership of our clan to Zhang Fei and Yu'er after they got married, but he has already rejected my wishes, especially since he wants to live an unfettered life."

"I see." Shen Huang nodded in understanding before speaking to her granddaughter again. "I am not surprised by Zhang Fei's decision, especially since all heavenly foxes are selfish creatures who prioritize themselves over others. Moreover, the situation in our clan will be calmer after we get rid of Shen Haoran, so you don't need to do that and keep leading our clan."
"Yes, grandma, I have no other choice either."
"Where is Zhang Fei right now? When will he come here?" Shen Xinya suddenly asked her daughter.
Seeing her grandmother acting out of character, Shen Yu spoke to Shen Xueyi through voice transmission. 'Mother, my grandma seems really jealous of us, and she's also impatient to meet Fei.'

Shen Xueyi responded to her daughter with a slight nod before telling Shen Xinya. "Mother, Zhang Fei should still be in the western Chu Clan right now, but he will definitely come here in a day or two, especially since Yu'er's wedding will take place in three days, and he already informed us that he would help clean up Shen Haoran, so there won't be many casualties."
"I see." Shen Xinya replied briefly before disappearing from their sight again, causing the three women to sigh helplessly at her attitude.
Shen Xueyi then approached her grandmother before touching her forehead, and she shared the Yin-Yang Soul Refining art with her, especially since she had already gotten Zhang Fei's approval for it.
Even so, Zhang Fei did not allow Shen Xueyi to share the Yin-Yang Flawless Art with anyone; he would only share the dual cultivation technique with women who were willing to become his wives.

After she read the name of the technique that appeared in her mind, Shen Huang's expression turned to shock, and her eyes trembled in disbelief, especially since she had been searching for a technique to cultivate her soul but had never managed to obtain it. "Did you get that soul technique from Zhang Fei?"
"Yes, great-grandmother." Instead, Shen Yu answered Shen Huang. "I've tried the soul cultivation technique myself, and the results are quite good, even though I only cultivated my soul once.

Unfortunately, Fei told me that we can't cultivate our souls quickly without external help, but the items to cultivate our souls don't exist in this realm, and we have to go to the middle or upper realms to get them. So for the time being, we cultivate our souls by dual-cultivating."

"I see." Shen Huang nodded in understanding, but she still had no interest in accepting Zhang Fei's offer. "In that case, I will go somewhere else to learn this technique first, and I will be back before the wedding ceremony."
After Shen Huang disappeared from her room, Shen Yu asked Shen Xueyi directly. "What do you think will happen to my grandma? Will she also hand herself over to Fei?"

"That might be possible." Shen Xueyi replied while nodding a few times. "Feelings mean nothing to your grandmother, and she will never hesitate to use herself to achieve her goal of becoming stronger.

Moreover, she has tried to break through to the sovereign realm several times, but she has always failed to do so, and Zhang Fei's yang qi is the best shortcut for her to break through to that stage, so I'm sure she has thought about it."

Shen Yu could understand her grandmother's frustration, especially since she herself had felt so frustrated when she repeatedly failed to break through to the Earth Realm, and she might not have broken through if it weren't for Zhang Fei.
"Honestly, I would feel strange if my grandma gave herself to Fei, but I think it's not a big deal, and it would actually be beneficial for the future of our clan."

Naturally, Shen Xueyi also thought the same thing as her daughter, but she chose not to do anything and let Shen Xinya decide for herself. "All right, I'll help you take off your wedding dress now, and you can wear it again two days from now."
"Yes."

After she thought things through carefully, Wang Xiaoyi finally decided to bring Chu Yaoqian away from the Duan Clan, especially since she didn't want her dear granddaughter to die at the hands of the Ying Clan.

Wang Xiaoyi then took out an artifact to suppress her aura as neatly as possible, so that no one, including her husband, would know of her actions. After making sure that no one was in Chu Youqian's room, she immediately snuck in there.

Wang Xiaoyi forgot that Boitata had been watching her from a distance, but she had no intention of stopping her, especially since Zhang Fei had already told her that he had other plans for them. That's why he asked her to allow the old woman to take Chu Yaoqian away, while also instructing her to follow them.
Not long after, Boitata saw Wang Xiaoyi carrying Chu Youqian using her aura, and she took her away from the Duan Clan, so she immediately followed them.

Shortly after they left, Chu Liuxiang came out of his room, and he looked towards her granddaughter's room while letting out a heavy sigh. "I have warned her sternly, but her character has always been like that. Since she doesn't want to listen to my words, I can no longer care about her, and I don't care whether she dies or not."

Chu Liuxiang then returned to his room, but he did not immediately tell his son and daughter-in-law about Wang Xiaoyi leaving with Chu Yaoqian, and he only told them after the two had been gone for quite some time, which caused them to panic.

Chu Chongzi and Yao Chi wanted to chase after them, but Chu Liuxiang immediately stopped them and asked them to forget about the two of them, and he also asked them to focus on giving birth to a new generation for their eastern Chu Clan.

Even so, Chu Chongzi and Yao Chi did not obey Chu Liuxiang's words, and they still went to chase Wang Xiaoyi. Regrettably, their mother had disappeared for some time, and she had also erased her tracks.
"What should we do now, husband? Should we follow them to the northern region?" Yao Chi asked Chu Chongzi.

"No." Chu Chongzi immediately rejected his wife's idea. "The northern region is too dangerous, especially since the Pang Clan controls the entire area, and our strength is not enough to fight them, so we will only die in vain if we meet them there."

Unlike her husband, Yao Chi is a woman and a mother, and she was the one who carried Chu Youqian for nine months. Moreover, she also raised her by herself, so it was difficult for her to let go of her daughter just like that.

Chu Chongzi let out a heavy sigh and hugged his wife, who had started to cry. "Wife, I understand your feelings, and I myself feel heavy about losing Youqian. However, our father is right; she can no longer be saved, so we should forget about her, and we can try to have another child." Explore hidden tales at mvl
"Sob... Sob..." Instead, Yao Chi hugged her husband back and started crying so hard, and Chu Chongzi kept holding her while waiting for her to calm down.
After some time, Yao Chi had calmed down, so Chu Chongzi took her back to the Duan Clan before going to see their father, and they discussed some things for the future of their eastern Chu Clan.

Wang Xiaoyi kept looking at her granddaughter, who was still sleeping above the flying artifact. She wanted to try waking her up, but she immediately abandoned her intention after recalling her daughter's explanation about Chu Yaoqian's condition. "Youqian, the northern region is dangerous, but I will protect you, and I will continue to look for a much better healer to cure you.
After you recover, we will return to this region to take revenge on the people who made you like this, and I will also destroy the Ying Clan for you."

Unfortunately, Wang Xiaoyi still doesn't realize that her plan won't work out well, and her actions of taking Chu Youqian away will only lead them into endless trouble, especially since Zhang Fei already ordered Pang Hong, who was still in the northern region, to deal with them.

"As expected, Wang Xiaoyi took Chu Youqian to the northern region, but I don't have time to deal with them, and I have to take care of Shen Haoran first."

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Bring The Wang Sibling
paragraphs: "Unfortunately, I don't have time for that, as I have many matters to attend to, so you guys should return to Beijing now, or our grandpa will worry about you two." Zhang Fei immediately pulled his hand out of Wang Zhuxian's grasp. 'Open the gate, Mei.'

[Master, why won't you give this girl a chance? Her talent still can't compare to that of Zhang Lin, but she's much better than some of your closest people, like Guo Lan and Qing Tan. As for her brother, his talent isn't bad, but it's not that good either. At least, he's better than Quan Xun.
Moreover, you have already checked them using your demon eyes before, so you should already know that they are not bad people, and they can actually help you secure this planet.]

After hearing that, Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh, knowing that Wang Zhuxian and Wang Xiaofeng were indeed not bad. However, Wang Zetian's decision to leave Zhang Chen made him not want to have any relationship with them, so he also felt reluctant to teach his half-siblings to become cultivators like him.

Seeing him continue to hesitate, Wang Zhuxian suddenly did something that surprised not only Zhang Fei but also Wang Xiaofeng, especially since she immediately kneeled down in front of him. "Brother Fei! Please! Give me a chance; I will definitely prove myself to you."

'This woman! She's really persistent!' Zhang Fei grumbled inwardly before lifting Wang Zhuxian to her feet. "Fine! I'll give you a chance to prove yourself, but we can't cultivate on earth, so I'll take you two to another world called the Sky Jade Realm. However, I warn you both not to ever consider harming someone close to me or betraying us, as I will make you both suffer.
You need not doubt my words, as I have personally killed Zhang He."

Wang Zhuxian and Wang Xiaofeng were stunned for a moment after hearing Zhang Fei's last sentence, and they naturally knew that Zhang He was his blood brother. However, they never knew that he was dead, and his killer was his own little brother.
"Do you guys understand?" After the two nodded at him, Mei immediately opened the gate to the Sky Jade Realm, and Zhang Fei took them directly there.

"Woahh! This world really is like ours in the past, brother Fei!" As soon as they arrived at the Chu Clan's back garden, Wang Zuxian immediately expressed his admiration and took a deep breath of the fresh air. "Moreover, the air here is really clean, and I can breathe more easily than in Beijing, which is so full of pollution."

Zhang Fei shook his head in response to that statement. "There is no technology or machinery in the Sky Jade Realm, so there is no pollution.
